00750|   public async fetchModelsFromServer(): Promise<void> {
00751|     const cfg = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw');
00752|     const ollamaUrls = this._services.getOllamaUrls(cfg);
00753|     this._callbacks.log(`fetchModelsFromServer: ${ollamaUrls.join(', ')}`);
00754|     // 清除 context length 快取，讓 LM Studio 等 context 設定變更立即生效
00755|     if (this._services.clearModelCtxCache) { this._services.clearModelCtxCache(); }
00756| 
00757|     const liveModels: { id: string; label: string }[] = [];
00758|     let copilotModels: { id: string; name: string; multiplier: string }[] = [];
00759|     let connectionOk = false;
00760|     let connectionMessage = '連線失敗';

00762| 
00763|     for (const url of ollamaUrls) {
00764|       try {
00765|         const models = await this._services.ollamaListModels(url);
00766|         for (const model of models) {

00768|             id: this._services.encodeOllamaModelId(url, model, ollamaUrls),

00771|         }
00772|         if (!connectionOk) {
00773|           connectionOk = true;
00774|           connectionMessage = ollamaUrls.length > 1 ? `${ollamaUrls.length} 台伺服器已連線` : 'OK';
00775|           connectionUrl = url;
00776|         }
00777|         this._callbacks.log(`fetchModelsFromServer OK from ${url}`);
00778|       } catch (error: unknown) {
00779|         const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
00780|         if (!connectionOk) {
00781|           connectionMessage = message;
00782|           connectionUrl = url;
00783|         }
00784|         this._callbacks.log(`fetchModelsFromServer error from ${url}: ${message}`);
00785|       }
00786|     }
00787| 
00788|     const openaiUrls = cfg.get<string[]>('openaiUrls') ?? [];

00790|     for (const url of openaiUrls) {

00793|         for (const model of models) {
00794|           const sep = model.indexOf('||');
00795|           const cleanLabel = sep !== -1 ? model.slice(sep + 2) : model.replace(/^openai::/, '');
00796|           liveModels.push({ id: model, label: cleanLabel });
00797|         }
00798|         if (!connectionOk) {
00799|           connectionOk = true;
00800|           connectionMessage = 'OpenAI-compatible OK';
00801|           connectionUrl = url;
00802|         }
00803|         this._callbacks.log(`fetchModelsFromServer OpenAI-compatible OK from ${url}`);
00804|       } catch (error: unknown) {
00805|         const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
00806|         if (!connectionOk) {
00807|           connectionMessage = message;
00808|           connectionUrl = url;
00809|         }
00810|         this._callbacks.log(`fetchModelsFromServer OpenAI-compatible error from ${url}: ${message}`);
00811|       }
00812|     }
00813| 
00814|     try {

00854|   public async ensureModelReady(baseUrl: string, model: string): Promise<void> {
00855|     if (!isOllamaModel(model)) {
00856|       return;
00857|     }
00858| 
00859|     const previousUrl = this._lastOllamaUrl;
00860|     const previousModel = this._lastOllamaModel;
00861|     this._lastOllamaUrl = baseUrl;
00862|     this._lastOllamaModel = model;
00863| 
00864|     if (!previousModel || previousModel === model) {
00865|       return;
00866|     }
00867|     if (previousUrl && previousUrl !== baseUrl) {
00868|       this._callbacks.log(`Model switch: ${previousModel}@${previousUrl} -> ${model}@${baseUrl}，不同 server，跳過 VRAM 釋放`);
00869|       return;
00870|     }
00871| 
00872|     const fromShort = previousModel.split('/').pop();
00873|     const toShort = model.split('/').pop();
00874| 
00875|     // 先查目前執行中的模型 VRAM 用量，決定是否需要強制卸載
00876|     const runningInfo = await this._services.ollamaGetRunningModels(baseUrl);
00877|     const prevFamily = previousModel.split(':')[0];
00878|     const newFamily  = model.split(':')[0];
00879|     const oldModelInfo = runningInfo.find(m => m.name === previousModel || m.name.startsWith(prevFamily));
00880|     const newAlreadyLoaded = runningInfo.some(m => m.name === model || m.name.startsWith(newFamily));
00881| 
00882|     if (newAlreadyLoaded) {
00883|       this._callbacks.log(`Model switch: ${previousModel} -> ${model}，新模型已載入，跳過卸載`);
00884|       return;
00885|     }
00886|     if (!oldModelInfo || oldModelInfo.size_vram === 0) {
00887|       this._callbacks.log(`Model switch: ${previousModel} -> ${model}，舊模型不佔 VRAM（CPU 模式），跳過卸載`);
00888|       return;
00889|     }
00890| 
00891|     this._callbacks.log(`Model switch: ${previousModel} -> ${model}，舊模型佔用 VRAM ${(oldModelInfo.size_vram / 1024 ** 3).toFixed(1)} GB，正在卸載`);
00892|     await this._services.ollamaUnloadModel(baseUrl, previousModel);
00893|     this._callbacks.postToWebview({
00894|       type: 'assistant',
00895|       text: `⏳ 模型切換 ${fromShort} → ${toShort}，等待 VRAM 釋放…`,
00896|     });
00897| 
00898|     for (let seconds = 90; seconds > 0; seconds--) {
00899|       const runningModels = await this._services.ollamaListRunningModels(baseUrl);
00900|       const stillLoaded = runningModels.some((name) => name === previousModel || name.startsWith(prevFamily));
00901|       if (!stillLoaded) {
00902|         const waited = 90 - seconds;
00903|         this._callbacks.log(`VRAM 已釋放，等待結束（用時 ${waited}s）`);
00904|         this._callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'assistant', text: `✅ VRAM 釋放完成（${waited}s），載入 ${toShort}…` });
00905|         break;
00906|       }
00907|       await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
00908|     }
00909|   }

00911|   /**
00912|    * Ask 模式對話歷史自動摘要壓縮。
00913|    * 超過 threshold tokens 時，將較舊的訊息壓縮為一則摘要。
00914|    * 直接 mutate chatHistory 陣列（splice），不需要 setChatHistory。
00915|    */
00916|   private async autoSummarizeHistory(
00917|     chatHistory: QueryEngineChatMessage[],
00918|     model: string,
00919|     baseUrl: string
00920|   ): Promise<void> {
00921|     const cfg = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw');
00922|     const enabled = cfg.get<boolean>('autoSummarizeHistory', true);
00923|     const cfgThreshold = cfg.get<number>('autoSummarizeThreshold', 8000);
00924| 
00925|     // 向 Ollama/vLLM 查詢實際 context window；Copilot 模型回傳 0
00926|     if (!isCopilotModel(model)) {
00927|       const ctxLen = await this._services.ollamaGetContextLength(baseUrl, model);
00928|       if (ctxLen > 0) { this._modelContextLength = ctxLen; }
00929|     } else {
00930|       this._modelContextLength = 0;
00931|     }
00932| 
00933|     // 觸發摘要的門檻：60% 不夠，需預留 tool defs (~7K tokens) + 程式碼密度差異 (3 vs 4 chars/token)
00934|     const threshold = this._modelContextLength > 0
00935|       ? Math.floor(this._modelContextLength * 0.45)
00936|       : cfgThreshold;
00937| 
00938|     if (chatHistory.length < 4) { return; }
00939| 
00940|     const totalTokens = this._services.estimateTokens(chatHistory.map(m => m.content ?? '').join(''));
00941|     if (totalTokens < threshold) { return; }
00942| 
00943|     // 保留最新 4 則，對前面的摘要
00944|     const keepTail = chatHistory.slice(-4);
00945|     const toSummarize = chatHistory.slice(0, chatHistory.length - 4);
00946|     if (toSummarize.length < 2) {
00947|       // Too few old messages to summarize; truncate the longest recent messages to free context
00948|       for (const msg of chatHistory) {
00949|         if ((msg.content?.length ?? 0) > 8000) {
00950|           msg.content = (msg.content ?? '').slice(0, 8000) + '\n…（截斷以釋放 context）';
00951|         }
00952|       }
00953|       return;
00954|     }
00955| 
00956|     this._callbacks.postToWebview({
00957|       type: 'agentStep',
00958|       icon: '📝',
00959|       title: `對話歷史過長（≈${totalTokens} tokens），自動摘要舊訊息中…`,
00960|       fullPath: '',
00961|     });
00962| 
00963|     const summaryMessages: QueryEngineChatMessage[] = [
00964|       {
00965|         role: 'system',
00966|         content: '你是對話摘要助手，只輸出繁體中文純文字，禁止呼叫工具。',
00967|       },
00968|       {
00969|         role: 'user',
00970|         content: `**重要：只能輸出純文字，禁止呼叫任何工具。**
00971| 
00972| 你的任務是對以下對話記錄產生一份詳細的繁體中文摘要，此摘要將取代舊訊息，因此必須捕捉所有重要資訊。
00973| 
00974| 請先在 <分析> 標籤內草擬你的分析，然後在 <摘要> 標籤內產生結構化摘要，包含以下 9 個段落：
00975|

00977| 2. **關鍵技術概念**：討論過的技術、框架、設計模式與慣例

00989| 
00990| ` + toSummarize.map(m => `[${m.role}]: ${(m.content ?? '').slice(0, 800)}`).join('\n\n').slice(0, 12000),
00991|       },

01001|         summary = formatCompactSummary((resp?.content ?? '').trim());
01002|       }

01015|       return;
01016|     }
01017| 
01018|     const compressed: QueryEngineChatMessage[] = [
01019|       { role: 'user', content: `[自動摘要—先前 ${toSummarize.length} 則對話重點]\n${summary}` },
01020|       { role: 'assistant', content: '已了解先前對話的進度與重要資訊，繼續回答。' },

00204|   str?: string;
00205|   weight: number;
00206| }
00207| 
00208| function CP(str: string, weight: number): ChoicePattern {
00209|   return { re: null, str: str.toLowerCase(), weight };
00210| }
00211| function CR(src: string, weight: number): ChoicePattern {
00212|   return { re: new RegExp(src, 'i'), weight };
00213| }
00214| 
00215| /**
00216|  * 收緊判定：需同時滿足「選擇指示詞」+「待執行動作」才計分。
00217|  * 單一 "option a" 不足以判定。
00218|  */
00219| const CHOICE_INDICATORS: readonly ChoicePattern[] = [
00220|   P2('選項 a', 3), P2('選項 b', 3), P2('選項 c', 3),
00221|   P2('option a', 3), P2('option b', 3), P2('option c', 3),
00222|   P2('若無異議', 3), P2('若您同意', 3), P2('如果您同意', 3),
00223|   P2('如果沒有問題', 2), P2('請確認是否', 3), P2('請問是否要', 3),
00224|   P2('是否要我', 3), P2('shall i', 4), P2('should i', 4),
00225|   P2('do you want me to', 3), P2('would you like me to', 3),
00226|   P2('please confirm if', 3), P2('可以開始嗎', 3),
00227|   P2('我可以開始', 3), P2('可以繼續嗎', 3),
00228| ];
00229| 
00230| function P2(str: string, weight: number): ChoicePattern {
00231|   return { re: null, str: str.toLowerCase(), weight };
00232| }
00233| 
00234| /** 必須搭配「待執行動詞」才有效 */
00235| const CHOICE_ACTION_VERBS: readonly string[] = [
00236|   '執行', '建立', '修改', '重構', '部署', '建置',
00237|   'run', 'build', 'create', 'modify', 'refactor', 'deploy',
00238|   '開始', '動手', 'proceed', 'start', 'begin',
00239| ];
00240| 
00241| // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
00242| // Scoring thresholds
00243| // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
00244| 
00245| const REFUSAL_THRESHOLD = 8;   // ≥ 8 判定為拒絕
00246| const CHOICE_THRESHOLD = 6;    // ≥ 6 判定為等確認
00247| 
00248| // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
00249| // Public API
00250| // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
00251| 
00252| /**
00253|  * 完整偵測：回傳分數、類別、命中清單。
00254|  */
00255| export function detectRefusal(text: string): RefusalVerdict {
00256|   const lower = text.toLowerCase();
00257| 
00258|   // Whitelist check
00259|   const whitelistHits = WHITELIST_PATTERNS.filter(w => lower.includes(w));
00260|   if (whitelistHits.length > 0) {
00261|     // 命中 whitelist → 強制非拒絕
00262|     return {
00263|       isRefusal: false,
00264|       score: 0,
00265|       category: null,
00266|       matched: [],
00267|       whitelistHits,
00268|     };
00269|   }
00270| 
00271|   let totalScore = 0;
00272|   const matched: string[] = [];
00273|   const categoryScores = new Map<RefusalCategory, number>();
00274| 
00275|   for (const pat of REFUSAL_PATTERNS) {
00276|     let hit = false;
00277|     if (pat.re) {
00278|       hit = pat.re.test(text);
00279|     } else if (pat.str) {
00280|       hit = lower.includes(pat.str);
00281|     }
00282|     if (hit) {
00283|       totalScore += pat.weight;
00284|       matched.push(pat.str ?? pat.re!.source);
00285|       const prev = categoryScores.get(pat.category) ?? 0;
00286|       categoryScores.set(pat.category, prev + pat.weight);
00287|     }
00288|   }
00289| 
00290|   const isRefusal = totalScore >= REFUSAL_THRESHOLD;
00291|   const topCategory = ((): RefusalCategory | null => {
00292|     let best: RefusalCategory | null = null;
00293|     let bestScore = 0;
00294|     for (const [cat, sc] of categoryScores) {
00295|       if (sc > bestScore) { best = cat; bestScore = sc; }
00296|     }
00297|     return best;
00298|   })();
00299| 
00300|   return { isRefusal, score: totalScore, category: topCategory, matched, whitelistHits: [] };
00301| }
00302| 
00303| /**
00304|  * 收緊版 choice 偵測：選擇指示詞 + 動作動詞同時出現才計分。
00305|  */
00306| export function detectChoice(text: string): ChoiceVerdict {
00307|   const lower = text.toLowerCase();
00308| 
00309|   // 先確認有動作動詞
00310|   const hasActionVerb = CHOICE_ACTION_VERBS.some(v => lower.includes(v));
00311|   if (!hasActionVerb) {
00312|     return { isChoice: false, score: 0, matched: [] };
00313|   }
00314| 
00315|   let score = 0;
00316|   const matched: string[] = [];
00317| 
00318|   for (const pat of CHOICE_INDICATORS) {
00319|     let hit = false;
00320|     if (pat.re) {
00321|       hit = pat.re.test(text);
00322|     } else if (pat.str) {
00323|       hit = lower.includes(pat.str);
00324|     }
00325|     if (hit) {
00326|       score += pat.weight;
00327|       matched.push(pat.str ?? pat.re!.source);
00328|     }
00329|   }
00330| 
00331|   // 有動作動詞加 2 分 bonus
00332|   if (score > 0) score += 2;
00333| 
00334|   return { isChoice: score >= CHOICE_THRESHOLD, score, matched };
00335| }
00336| 
00337| // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
00338| // Backward-compatible shims（舊呼叫端可直接切換）
00339| // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
00340| 
00341| export function isRefusalResponse(text: string): boolean {
00342|   return detectRefusal(text).isRefusal;
00343| }
00344| 
00345| export function isChoiceConfirmation(text: string): boolean {
00346|   return detectChoice(text).isChoice;
00347| }

00004| export interface QueuedTask {

00011| export class TaskQueue {

00014| 
00015|   enqueue(prompt: string, modelOverride?: string): QueuedTask {
00016|     const task: QueuedTask = {
00017|       id: `q-${++this._seq}`,
00018|       prompt: prompt.trim(),
00019|       modelOverride: modelOverride?.trim() || undefined,
00020|       addedAt: Date.now(),
00021|     };
00022|     this._items.push(task);

00024|   }
00025| 
00026|   dequeue(): QueuedTask | undefined {
00027|     return this._items.shift();
00028|   }
00029| 
00030|   peek(): QueuedTask | undefined {
00031|     return this._items[0];
00032|   }
00033| 
00034|   get length(): number {
00035|     return this._items.length;
00036|   }
00037| 
00038|   getAll(): readonly QueuedTask[] {
00039|     return [...this._items];
00040|   }
00041| 
00042|   remove(id: string): boolean {
00043|     const idx = this._items.findIndex(t => t.id === id);
00044|     if (idx < 0) return false;
00045|     this._items.splice(idx, 1);
00046|     return true;
00047|   }
00048| 
00049|   clear(): number {
00050|     const count = this._items.length;
00051|     this._items = [];
00052|     return count;
00053|   }
00054| 
00055|   format(): string {
00056|     if (!this._items.length) return '（任務佇列為空）';
00057|     return this._items.map((t, i) => {
00058|       const prompt = t.prompt.length > 80 ? t.prompt.slice(0, 80) + '…' : t.prompt;
00059|       const model = t.modelOverride ? ` [${t.modelOverride}]` : '';
00060|       return `${i + 1}. [${t.id}]${model} ${prompt}`;
00061|     }).join('\n');
00062|   }

00001| // Copyright (c) 2026 YCHsu. All rights reserved.

00004| export type TaskStatus = 'created' | 'claimed' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'blocked';
00005| 
00006| export interface Task {
00007|   id: string;
00008|   description: string;
00009|   status: TaskStatus;
00010|   context?: string;
00011|   result?: string;       // Worker's report_result summary
00012|   errorDetails?: string;
00013|   workerIdx?: number;
00014|   createdAt: number;
00015|   claimedAt?: number;
00016|   resolvedAt?: number;
00017| }
00018| 
00019| const STATUS_ICON: Record<TaskStatus, string> = {
00020|   created: '⬜', claimed: '🔄', completed: '✅', failed: '❌', blocked: '⚠️',
00021| };
00022| 
00023| export class TaskStore {
00024|   private readonly _tasks = new Map<string, Task>();
00025|   private _seq = 0;
00026| 
00027|   create(description: string, context?: string, id?: string): Task {
00028|     const taskId = id?.trim() || `task-${++this._seq}`;
00029|     const task: Task = { id: taskId, description, status: 'created', context, createdAt: Date.now() };
00030|     this._tasks.set(taskId, task);
00031|     return task;
00032|   }
00033| 
00034|   /** Transitions created → claimed; no-op if task doesn't exist or is in wrong state. */
00035|   claim(taskId: string, workerIdx: number): Task | undefined {
00036|     const task = this._tasks.get(taskId);
00037|     if (!task || task.status !== 'created') return undefined;
00038|     task.status = 'claimed';
00039|     task.workerIdx = workerIdx;
00040|     task.claimedAt = Date.now();
00041|     return task;
00042|   }
00043| 
00044|   /** Transitions claimed → completed | failed | blocked. */
00045|   resolve(taskId: string, status: 'completed' | 'failed' | 'blocked', result?: string, errorDetails?: string): void {
00046|     const task = this._tasks.get(taskId);
00047|     if (!task) return;
00048|     task.status = status;
00049|     task.result = result;
00050|     task.errorDetails = errorDetails;
00051|     task.resolvedAt = Date.now();
00052|   }
00053| 
00054|   get(taskId: string): Task | undefined {
00055|     return this._tasks.get(taskId);
00056|   }
00057| 
00058|   getAll(): readonly Task[] {
00059|     return Array.from(this._tasks.values());
00060|   }
00061| 
00062|   /** Formatted task board for LLM / webview display. */
00063|   format(): string {
00064|     const tasks = this.getAll();
00065|     if (!tasks.length) return '（無任務）';
00066|     return tasks.map(t => {
00067|       const lines = [`${STATUS_ICON[t.status]} [${t.id}] ${t.description}`];
00068|       if (t.status === 'claimed' && t.workerIdx !== undefined)
00069|         lines.push(`  → Worker #${t.workerIdx} 處理中`);
00070|       if (t.result)
00071|         lines.push(`  結果：${t.result.slice(0, 150)}`);
00072|       if (t.errorDetails)
00073|         lines.push(`  錯誤：${t.errorDetails.slice(0, 80)}`);
00074|       return lines.join('\n');
00075|     }).join('\n');
00076|   }
00077| }

00001| /**
00002|  * HistoryCompactor
00003|  *
00004|  * 移植自 claude-code `services/compact/compact.ts` 與 `prompt.ts` 的整段對話 summarize 機制。
00005|  *

00120| export function createCompactBoundaryMessage(summary: string): CompactableMessage {
00121|   return {
00122|     role: 'system',
00123|     content: `[Previous conversation compacted — context summary below]\n\n${summary}`,
00124|     __compactBoundary: true,
00125|   };
00126| }
00127| 
00128| export function isCompactBoundaryMessage(msg: CompactableMessage): boolean {
00129|   return msg.__compactBoundary === true;
00130| }
00131| 
00132| export function getMessagesAfterCompactBoundary<T extends CompactableMessage>(messages: T[]): T[] {
00133|   for (let i = messages.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
00134|     if (isCompactBoundaryMessage(messages[i])) {
00135|       return messages.slice(i + 1);
00136|     }
00137|   }
00138|   return messages;
00139| }
00140| 
00141| /**
00142|  * 從 LLM 回傳的 <analysis>...<summary>...</summary> 文字中抽出 summary 部分。
00143|  * 同時相容繁體中文版 <分析>...<摘要>...</摘要>（AmiClaw 既有 prompt 採用此格式）。
00144|  * Analysis 是 scratchpad，不送回主對話。
00145|  */
00146| export function formatCompactSummary(rawText: string): string {
00147|   const enMatch = rawText.match(/<summary>([\s\S]*?)<\/summary>/);
00148|   if (enMatch) return enMatch[1].trim();
00149|   const zhMatch = rawText.match(/<摘要>([\s\S]*?)<\/摘要>/);
00150|   if (zhMatch) return zhMatch[1].trim();
00151| 
00152|   // Fallback：若模型未產出標籤，整段保留（去掉 analysis 段）
00153|   const stripped = rawText
00154|     .replace(/<analysis>[\s\S]*?<\/analysis>/g, '')
00155|     .replace(/<分析>[\s\S]*?<\/分析>/g, '')
00156|     .trim();
00157|   return stripped || rawText.trim();
00158| }
00159| 
00160| // ============================================================================
00161| // 主流程
00162| // ============================================================================
00163| 
00164| /**
00165|  * 執行 history compaction：
00166|  *   1. 取 boundary 之後的所有訊息
00167|  *   2. 呼叫 LLM summarize
00168|  *   3. 回傳新訊息陣列（含 boundary + 摘要 + 保留的最近 N 輪）
00169|  */
00170| export async function compactHistory<T extends CompactableMessage>(
00171|   messages: T[],
00172|   caller: CompactCaller,
00173|   options: HistoryCompactOptions = {}
00174| ): Promise<CompactionResult<T>> {
00175|   const keepRecent = options.keepRecentRounds ?? 4;
00176|   const dropPre = options.dropPreBoundary ?? false;
00177|   const minMsgs = options.minMessages ?? 10;
00178| 
00179|   const activeMessages = getMessagesAfterCompactBoundary(messages);
00180| 
00181|   // Guard: skip compaction when there are too few messages to summarize
00182|   // (avoids wasting a full LLM call on short sessions).
00183|   if (activeMessages.length < minMsgs) {
00184|     const tokens = activeMessages.reduce((s, m) => s + estimateTokensRough(m.content ?? ''), 0);
00185|     return {
00186|       messages,
00187|       summary: '',
00188|       tokensBefore: tokens,
00189|       tokensAfter: tokens,
00190|       boundaryIndex: -1,
00191|     };
00192|   }
00193| 
00194|   const tokensBefore = activeMessages.reduce((s, m) => s + estimateTokensRough(m.content ?? ''), 0);
00195| 
00196|   // 呼叫 LLM 產生 summary
00197|   const rawSummary = await caller.summarize(activeMessages as CompactableMessage[], COMPACT_SUMMARY_PROMPT);
00198|   const summary = formatCompactSummary(rawSummary);
00199| 
00200|   // 保留最近 N 輪原文（user/assistant pair）
00201|   const recentTail: T[] = [];
00202|   let rounds = 0;
00203|   for (let i = activeMessages.length - 1; i >= 0 && rounds < keepRecent; i--) {
00204|     const m = activeMessages[i];
00205|     recentTail.unshift(m);
00206|     if (m.role === 'user') rounds++;
00207|   }
00208| 
00209|   const boundary = createCompactBoundaryMessage(summary) as T;
00210| 
00211|   const pre = dropPre
00212|     ? messages.filter(isCompactBoundaryMessage)
00213|     : messages.slice(0, messages.length - activeMessages.length);
00214| 
00215|   const newMessages: T[] = [...pre, boundary, ...recentTail];
00216|   const tokensAfter = newMessages.reduce((s, m) => s + estimateTokensRough(m.content ?? ''), 0);
00217| 
00218|   return {
00219|     messages: newMessages,
00220|     summary,
00221|     tokensBefore,
00222|     tokensAfter,
00223|     boundaryIndex: pre.length,
00224|   };
00225| }

00001| /**
00002|  * MicroCompactor
00003|  *
00004|  * 移植自 claude-code `services/compact/microCompact.ts`。
00005|  * 在每輪 agent loop 結束後，針對個別工具呼叫結果做剪裁，回收 token 但保留訊息結構。
00006|  *
00007|  * 策略：
00008|  *   - 只壓縮屬於 COMPACTABLE_TOOLS 的工具結果（檔案/Bash/Grep/Web 等大型輸出）
00009|  *   - 圖片結果若超過 2,000 token 直接清除
00010|  *   - 舊工具結果（time-based）清為 `[Old tool result content cleared]`
00011|  *   - 不動 user / assistant 一般訊息
00012|  */
00013| 
00014| import { estimateTokensRough } from './TokenBudgetManager';
00015| 
00016| /** 預設可壓縮工具名單（與 AmiClaw 內建工具對齊；若名稱不同會無害略過） */
00017| export const DEFAULT_COMPACTABLE_TOOLS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([
00018|   'read_file',
00019|   'file_read',
00020|   'write_file',
00021|   'file_write',
00022|   'edit_file',
00023|   'file_edit',
00024|   'run_terminal',
00025|   'bash',
00026|   'grep',
00027|   'glob',
00028|   'list_dir',
00029|   'web_search',
00030|   'web_fetch',
00031|   'fetch_webpage',
00032| ]);
00033| 
00034| export const IMAGE_MAX_TOKEN_SIZE = 2_000;
00035| export const TIME_BASED_MC_CLEARED_MESSAGE = '[Old tool result content cleared]';
00036| export const PER_RESULT_MAX_TOKENS = 4_000;
00037| export const PER_RESULT_PREVIEW_TAIL_TOKENS = 200;
00038| 
00039| export interface CompactableToolMessage {
00040|   role: 'tool' | 'assistant' | 'user' | 'system';
00041|   content: string | null;
00042|   tool_call_id?: string;
00043|   /** 對應的工具名稱（若 role 是 'tool'） */
00044|   toolName?: string;
00045|   images?: string[];
00046| }
00047| 
00048| export interface MicroCompactOptions {
00049|   /** 可壓縮工具白名單 */
00050|   compactableTools?: ReadonlySet<string>;
00051|   /** 單一工具結果保留上限 (token) */
00052|   perResultMaxTokens?: number;
00053|   /** 舊結果視為「過時」的閾值（毫秒），預設 10 分鐘 */
00054|   staleThresholdMs?: number;
00055|   /** 訊息時間戳查詢（若無，所有訊息視為新鮮） */
00056|   getMessageTimestamp?: (msg: CompactableToolMessage, index: number) => number | undefined;
00057| }
00058| 
00059| export interface MicroCompactResult<T> {
00060|   messages: T[];
00061|   trimmedCount: number;
00062|   tokensFreed: number;
00063| }
00064| 
00065| /**
00066|  * 對工具結果做剪裁：
00067|  *  - 過大的結果保留前後 1,000 token + 中間以摘要替代
00068|  *  - 過時的結果整段替換為 cleared message
00069|  *  - 圖片過大則清除
00070|  */
00071| export function microCompact<T extends CompactableToolMessage>(
00072|   messages: T[],
00073|   options: MicroCompactOptions = {}
00074| ): MicroCompactResult<T> {
00075|   const compactable = options.compactableTools ?? DEFAULT_COMPACTABLE_TOOLS;
00076|   const perResultMax = options.perResultMaxTokens ?? PER_RESULT_MAX_TOKENS;
00077|   const staleMs = options.staleThresholdMs ?? 10 * 60 * 1000;
00078|   const now = Date.now();
00079| 
00080|   let trimmed = 0;
00081|   let freed = 0;
00082| 
00083|   const out = messages.map((msg, idx) => {
00084|     if (msg.role !== 'tool') return msg;
00085|     if (!msg.toolName || !compactable.has(msg.toolName)) return msg;
00086| 
00087|     const ts = options.getMessageTimestamp?.(msg, idx);
00088|     const isStale = ts !== undefined && now - ts > staleMs;
00089| 
00090|     // 過時：整段清除
00091|     if (isStale && msg.content) {
00092|       freed += estimateTokensRough(msg.content);
00093|       trimmed++;
00094|       return { ...msg, content: TIME_BASED_MC_CLEARED_MESSAGE };
00095|     }
00096| 
00097|     // 圖片過大：清除
00098|     let images = msg.images;
00099|     if (images && images.length > 0) {
00100|       const totalImgTokens = images.reduce((s, i) => s + estimateTokensRough(i), 0);
00101|       if (totalImgTokens > IMAGE_MAX_TOKEN_SIZE) {
00102|         freed += totalImgTokens;
00103|         images = undefined;
00104|         trimmed++;
00105|       }
00106|     }
00107| 
00108|     // 內容過大：保留頭尾 + 中間替換摘要
00109|     if (msg.content) {
00110|       const tokens = estimateTokensRough(msg.content);
00111|       if (tokens > perResultMax) {
00112|         const headChars = Math.floor((perResultMax - PER_RESULT_PREVIEW_TAIL_TOKENS) * 3);
00113|         const tailChars = Math.floor(PER_RESULT_PREVIEW_TAIL_TOKENS * 3);
00114|         const head = msg.content.slice(0, headChars);
00115|         const tail = msg.content.slice(-tailChars);
00116|         const collapsed = `${head}\n\n...[truncated ${tokens - perResultMax} tokens]...\n\n${tail}`;
00117|         freed += tokens - estimateTokensRough(collapsed);
00118|         trimmed++;
00119|         return { ...msg, content: collapsed, images };
00120|       }
00121|     }
00122| 
00123|     if (images !== msg.images) return { ...msg, images };
00124|     return msg;
00125|   });
00126| 
00127|   return { messages: out, trimmedCount: trimmed, tokensFreed: freed };
00128| }
===== END: src\context\MicroCompactor.ts =====

00001| /**
00002|  * SystemPromptBuilder
00003|  *
00004|  * 移植自 claude-code `context.ts` 的 system prompt 組裝管線。
00005|  * 把分散的 system 內容（persona / memory / workspace / tool rules）統一為固定管線。
00006|  *
00007|  * 設計原則：
00008|  *   - 每個 section 都是純函式 → 易測試、易選擇性啟用
00009|  *   - 區塊間用清楚的分隔線，方便 model 解析
00010|  *   - 順序固定：persona → policy → memory index → workspace → active file → custom rules
00011|  */
00012| 
00013| export interface SystemPromptSection {
00014|   /** Section 標題（會用 `## {title}` 包起來） */
00015|   title: string;
00016|   /** Section 內文；空字串會被略過 */
00017|   content: string;
00018| }
00019| 
00020| export interface BuildSystemPromptInput {
00021|   /** Persona / role definition（最先） */
00022|   persona?: string;
00023|   /** Hard policy rules（如 Atlassian / 不要修改某些檔案） */
00024|   policy?: string;
00025|   /** 專案規則層（RULES.md）——必常注入，優先級高於記憶索引 */
00026|   rules?: string;
00027|   /** MEMORY.md index 內容（短期 + 長期記憶索引） */
00028|   memoryIndex?: string;
00029|   /** Workspace 概況（git status, project root, open files 計數等） */
00030|   workspaceSummary?: string;
00031|   /** 當前 active file 摘要 */
00032|   activeFileSummary?: string;
00033|   /** 啟用中的工具規則摘要 */
00034|   toolRules?: string;
00035|   /** 額外自訂 sections（會接在最後） */
00036|   extraSections?: SystemPromptSection[];
00037| }
00038| 
00039| const SEP = '\n\n---\n\n';
00040| 
00041| /**
00042|  * 組裝 system prompt：依固定順序拼接，空 section 略過。
00043|  */
00044| export function buildSystemPrompt(input: BuildSystemPromptInput): string {
00045|   const parts: string[] = [];
00046| 
00047|   if (input.persona?.trim()) {
00048|     parts.push(input.persona.trim());
00049|   }
00050| 
00051|   if (input.policy?.trim()) {
00052|     parts.push(`## Policy\n\n${input.policy.trim()}`);
00053|   }
00054| 
00055|   if (input.rules?.trim()) {
00056|     parts.push(`## Project Rules\n\n${input.rules.trim()}`);
00057|   }
00058| 
00059|   if (input.memoryIndex?.trim()) {
00060|     parts.push(`## Long-term memory index\n\n${input.memoryIndex.trim()}`);
00061|   }
00062| 
00063|   if (input.workspaceSummary?.trim()) {
00064|     parts.push(`## Workspace\n\n${input.workspaceSummary.trim()}`);
00065|   }
00066| 
00067|   if (input.activeFileSummary?.trim()) {
00068|     parts.push(`## Active file\n\n${input.activeFileSummary.trim()}`);
00069|   }
00070| 
00071|   if (input.toolRules?.trim()) {
00072|     parts.push(`## Tool rules\n\n${input.toolRules.trim()}`);
00073|   }
00074| 
00075|   for (const sec of input.extraSections ?? []) {
00076|     if (sec.content?.trim()) {
00077|       parts.push(`## ${sec.title}\n\n${sec.content.trim()}`);
00078|     }
00079|   }
00080| 
00081|   return parts.join(SEP);
00082| }
00083| 
00084| /**
00085|  * 依 token 預算裁切 memoryIndex（避免吃光 system prompt）。
00086|  * 對應 claude-code 的「MEMORY.md 超過 200 行截斷」策略。
00087|  */
00088| export function truncateMemoryIndex(text: string, maxLines = 200): string {
00089|   if (!text) return text;
00090|   const lines = text.split('\n');
00091|   if (lines.length <= maxLines) return text;
00092|   return [
00093|     ...lines.slice(0, maxLines),
00094|     `\n... [memory index truncated, ${lines.length - maxLines} more lines]`,
00095|   ].join('\n');
00096| }

===== FILE: src\context\TokenBudgetManager.ts  (118 lines) =====
00001| /**
00002|  * TokenBudgetManager
00003|  *
00004|  * 移植自 claude-code `services/compact/autoCompact.ts` 的 token 預算機制。
00005|  * 用於決定何時觸發 micro / auto compaction、何時警告使用者。
00006|  *
00007|  * 移植來源關鍵常數：
00008|  *   AUTOCOMPACT_BUFFER_TOKENS         = 13_000  ← 距離 context window 還剩這麼多就壓縮
00009|  *   WARNING_THRESHOLD_BUFFER_TOKENS   = 20_000
00010|  *   MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS_FOR_SUMMARY     = 20_000  ← 預留給 summarize 輸出
00011|  *   MAX_CONSECUTIVE_AUTOCOMPACT_FAILS = 3
00012|  */
00013| 
00014| export const AUTOCOMPACT_BUFFER_TOKENS = 13_000;
00015| export const WARNING_THRESHOLD_BUFFER_TOKENS = 20_000;
00016| export const ERROR_THRESHOLD_BUFFER_TOKENS = 20_000;
00017| export const MANUAL_COMPACT_BUFFER_TOKENS = 3_000;
00018| export const MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS_FOR_SUMMARY = 20_000;
00019| export const MAX_CONSECUTIVE_AUTOCOMPACT_FAILURES = 3;
00020| 
00021| export interface TokenBudget {
00022|   /** Provider 回報的 context window 上限（token 數） */
00023|   contextWindow: number;
00024|   /** 保留給輸出的 token 數 */
00025|   maxOutputTokens: number;
00026| }
00027| 
00028| export interface TokenWarningState {
00029|   /** 剩餘 token 百分比 (0~100) */
00030|   percentLeft: number;
00031|   /** 已使用 token */
00032|   used: number;
00033|   /** 有效 context window（扣除輸出保留） */
00034|   effectiveWindow: number;
00035|   isAboveWarningThreshold: boolean;
00036|   isAboveErrorThreshold: boolean;
00037|   isAboveAutoCompactThreshold: boolean;
00038| }
00039| 
00040| /**
00041|  * 計算扣除輸出保留後的有效 context window。
00042|  */
00043| export function getEffectiveContextWindowSize(budget: TokenBudget): number {
00044|   const reservedForOutput = Math.min(budget.maxOutputTokens, MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS_FOR_SUMMARY);
00045|   return Math.max(0, budget.contextWindow - reservedForOutput);
00046| }
00047| 
00048| /**
00049|  * 自動壓縮觸發點：有效視窗 − 13K buffer。
00050|  */
00051| export function getAutoCompactThreshold(budget: TokenBudget): number {
00052|   return Math.max(0, getEffectiveContextWindowSize(budget) - AUTOCOMPACT_BUFFER_TOKENS);
00053| }
00054| 
00055| /**
00056|  * 警告閾值：有效視窗 − 20K buffer。
00057|  */
00058| export function getWarningThreshold(budget: TokenBudget): number {
00059|   return Math.max(0, getEffectiveContextWindowSize(budget) - WARNING_THRESHOLD_BUFFER_TOKENS);
00060| }
00061| 
00062| /**
00063|  * 依目前 token 使用量計算警告狀態。
00064|  */
00065| export function calculateTokenWarningState(
00066|   tokenUsage: number,
00067|   budget: TokenBudget
00068| ): TokenWarningState {
00069|   const effectiveWindow = getEffectiveContextWindowSize(budget);
00070|   const autoCompactThreshold = getAutoCompactThreshold(budget);
00071|   const warningThreshold = getWarningThreshold(budget);
00072| 
00073|   const percentLeft = effectiveWindow > 0
00074|     ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, ((effectiveWindow - tokenUsage) / effectiveWindow) * 100))
00075|     : 0;
00076| 
00077|   return {
00078|     percentLeft,
00079|     used: tokenUsage,
00080|     effectiveWindow,
00081|     isAboveWarningThreshold: tokenUsage >= warningThreshold,
00082|     isAboveErrorThreshold: tokenUsage >= effectiveWindow - ERROR_THRESHOLD_BUFFER_TOKENS,
00083|     isAboveAutoCompactThreshold: tokenUsage >= autoCompactThreshold,
00084|   };
00085| }
00086| 
00087| /**
00088|  * Circuit breaker：連續失敗超過 3 次即停止自動壓縮。
00089|  */
00090| export function shouldStopAutoCompact(consecutiveFailures: number): boolean {
00091|   return consecutiveFailures >= MAX_CONSECUTIVE_AUTOCOMPACT_FAILURES;
00092| }
00093| 
00094| /**
00095|  * 預估字串 token 數。粗略估算：英文約 4 char / token，中文約 1.5 char / token。
00096|  * 若上層已有更精準的 estimator（如 tiktoken），可從外部注入並覆蓋。
00097|  */
00098| export function estimateTokensRough(text: string): number {
00099|   if (!text) return 0;
00100|   // 中文字元算 1 token，其他每 4 char 算 1 token
00101|   let cjk = 0;
00102|   let other = 0;
00103|   for (const ch of text) {
00104|     if (/[\u4e00-\u9fff\u3000-\u303f\uff00-\uffef]/.test(ch)) cjk++;
00105|     else other++;
00106|   }
00107|   return Math.ceil(cjk + other / 4);
00108| }
00109| 
00110| /**
00111|  * 強制截斷字串以符合 Token 限制。
00112|  * 為確保絕對安全，我們採取「最保守估算」：將字串截斷至 maxTokens 個字元。
00113|  * 因為即使全為中文字，token 數也只會等於字元數，絕不會超過 maxTokens。
00114|  */
00115| export function truncateToTokenLimit(text: string, maxTokens: number): string {
00116|   if (estimateTokensRough(text) <= maxTokens) return text;
00117|   return text.substring(0, maxTokens);
00118| }

00131|   const exclude = opts.exclude ?? DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_GLOB;
00132|   const uris = await vscode.workspace.findFiles(include, exclude, 4000);
00133|   const candidates = uris.filter((u) => !BINARY_EXTS.has(path.extname(u.fsPath).toLowerCase()));

00135| 
00136|   const result = opts.depth === 'full'
00137|     ? buildFullInstruction(candidates)   // 同步：不讀檔，只回傳指令
00138|     : await buildOutline(candidates, opts);
00139| 
00140|   result.durationMs = Date.now() - started;
00141|   _cache = { key: cacheKey, result, ts: Date.now() };
00142|   return result;

00145| /**
00146|  * 全讀模式：不再把代碼倒進 system prompt（會溢出 context window）。
00147|  * 改為回傳一段強制指令，讓 Agent 在第一輪就呼叫 read_workspace 工具。
00148|  * 這是在 Ollama 有限 context window 下真正能完整讀取整個 workspace 的唯一可靠方式。
00149|  */
00150| function buildFullInstruction(candidates: vscode.Uri[]): WorkspaceDigestResult {

00154|   const preview = candidates.slice(0, 100)
00155|     .map((u) => `- ${vscode.workspace.asRelativePath(u)}`).join('\n');
00156|   const more = candidates.length > 100 ? `\n  …共 ${candidates.length} 個檔案` : '';

00159|     `## 【全讀模式 (Full Analysis) 已啟用】`,
00160|     `工作區路徑：${roots}`,
00161|     `原始碼檔案共 **${candidates.length}** 個（符合副檔名篩選）。`,
00162|     ``,
00163|     `**【強制規則】** 你必須在第一輪立即呼叫 \`read_workspace\` 工具讀取整個工作區所有原始碼，`,
00164|     `再進行任何分析、總結或回答。呼叫時可傳入 max_total_kb 與 include 參數控制範圍。`,
00165|     `讀取完成後，根據完整內容回答使用者的問題。`,
00166|     ``,
00167|     `### 工作區檔案預覽（前 ${Math.min(candidates.length, 100)} 個）`,
00168|     preview + more,
00169|   ].join('\n');
00170| 
00171|   return { text, fileCount: candidates.length, bytes: Buffer.byteLength(text, 'utf8'), truncated: false, durationMs: 0 };
00172| }
00173| 
00174| async function buildOutline(candidates: vscode.Uri[], opts: BuildOpts): Promise<WorkspaceDigestResult> {
00175|   // 如果傳入 modelContextLength，自動將 outline 大小限制在 context 25% 以內
00176|   // 估算：1 token ≈ 3~4 bytes。取保守值 3 bytes/token
00177|   const ctxKb = (opts.modelContextLength ?? 0) > 0
00178|     ? Math.floor((opts.modelContextLength! * 0.25 * 3) / 1024)
00179|     : 0;
00180|   const maxTotal = Math.max(2, opts.maxTotalKb ?? (ctxKb > 0 ? Math.min(ctxKb, 64) : 24)) * 1024;
00181|   const topN = Math.max(1, opts.topN ?? 40);
00182|   const linesPerFile = Math.max(5, opts.linesPerFile ?? 40);
00183| 
00184|   opts.onProgress?.(`🗂️ Outline 剖析（context=${opts.modelContextLength ? `${(opts.modelContextLength / 1024).toFixed(0)}K tokens` : '未知'}，上限 ${fmtSize(maxTotal)}）…`);
00185| 
00186|   // 計算副檔名分佈
00187|   const extCount = new Map<string, number>();
00188|   const rels: string[] = [];
00189|   for (const u of candidates) {
00190|     const rel = vscode.workspace.asRelativePath(u);
00191|     rels.push(rel);
00192|     const ext = path.extname(rel).toLowerCase() || '(無)';
00193|     extCount.set(ext, (extCount.get(ext) ?? 0) + 1);
00194|   }
00195|   const langTable = Array.from(extCount.entries())
00196|     .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
00197|     .slice(0, 20)
00198|     .map(([ext, n]) => `\`${ext}\`: ${n}`)
00199|     .join(', ');
00200| 
00201|   // 平行取得 stat（抓大小用於排序）
00202|   const statRaw = await Promise.all(
00203|     candidates.map((u) =>
00204|       asPromise(vscode.workspace.fs.stat(u))
00205|         .then((s) => ({ uri: u, size: s.size }))
00206|         .catch((): { uri: vscode.Uri; size: number } | null => null)
00207|     )
00208|   );
00209|   const withSizes = statRaw.filter((x): x is { uri: vscode.Uri; size: number } => x !== null);
00210|   withSizes.sort((a, b) => b.size - a.size);
00211|   const top = withSizes.slice(0, topN);
00212| 
00213|   // 平行讀取 top-N 檔案的 outline
00214|   const maxOutlineBytes = 4 * 1024;   // 單檔 outline 最多 4 KB（前 N 行）
00215|   const readRaw = await Promise.all(top.map((item) => safeRead(item.uri, maxOutlineBytes)));
00216| 
00217|   const outlines: string[] = [];
00218|   let outlineBytes = 0;
00219|   for (let i = 0; i < readRaw.length; i++) {
00220|     const r = readRaw[i];
00221|     if (!r) { continue; }
00222|     const { rel, buf } = r;
00223|     const lines = buf.toString('utf8').split(/\r?\n/).slice(0, linesPerFile);
00224|     const size = top[i].size;
00225|     const lang = path.extname(rel).slice(1).toLowerCase();
00226|     const entry = `### ${rel} (${fmtSize(size)}, 前 ${lines.length} 行)\n\`\`\`${lang}\n${lines.join('\n')}\n\`\`\``;
00227|     const eb = Buffer.byteLength(entry, 'utf8');
00228|     if (outlineBytes + eb > maxTotal) { break; }
00229|     outlineBytes += eb;
00230|     outlines.push(entry);
00231|   }
00232| 
00233|   // 檔案樹（最多 250 筆，避免太長）
00234|   const treeLimit = 250;
00235|   const tree = rels.slice(0, treeLimit).map((r) => `- ${r}`).join('\n');
00236|   const treeMore = rels.length > treeLimit ? `\n  …（共 ${rels.length} 個檔案，僅列出前 ${treeLimit}）` : '';
00237| 
00238|   const digest = [
00239|     `## 工作區結構摘要 (Outline Deep Analysis)`,
00240|     `共 ${rels.length} 個原始碼檔案。副檔名分佈：${langTable}`,
00241|     '',
00242|     `### 檔案清單`,
00243|     tree + treeMore,
00244|     '',
00245|     `### 重要檔案 outline（依大小排序，前 ${outlines.length} 個，每檔前 ${linesPerFile} 行）`,
00246|     outlines.join('\n\n'),
00247|     '',
00248|     `💡 如需完整內容請呼叫 read_file / read_files / read_workspace 工具。`,
00249|   ].join('\n');
00250| 
00251|   return {
00252|     text: digest,
00253|     fileCount: rels.length,
00254|     bytes: Buffer.byteLength(digest, 'utf8'),
00255|     truncated: false,
00256|     durationMs: 0,
00257|   };
00258| }

00263|   return v === 'outline' || v === 'full' ? v : 'file';

00553|         if (process.platform === 'win32') {
00554|           // Use PowerShell for reliable recursive file count

00559|         }
00560| 
00561|         const oc = vscode.window.createOutputChannel('AmiClaw');
00562|         oc.appendLine(`Running: ${cmd}`);
00563|         oc.show(true);
00564|         try {
00565|           const { stdout, stderr } = await exec(cmd, { windowsHide: true, maxBuffer: 50 * 1024 * 1024 });
00566|           if (stderr && String(stderr).trim()) oc.appendLine(String(stderr));
00567|           const n = parseInt(String(stdout).trim().split(/\r?\n/).pop() || '', 10);
00568|           if (!Number.isNaN(n)) {
00569|             const msg = `Shell file count: ${n.toLocaleString()} (path: ${root})`;
00570|             oc.appendLine(msg);
00571|             vscode.window.showInformationMessage(msg);
00572|             return;
00573|           }
00574|         } catch (e) {
00575|           oc.appendLine('Shell command failed: ' + (e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)));
00576|         }
00577| 
00578|         // Fallback to JS counting via workspace.findFiles
00579|         oc.appendLine('Falling back to workspace.findFiles count...');
00580|         const exclude = '{**/node_modules/**,**/.git/**,**/dist/**,**/out/**}';
00581|         const uris = await vscode.workspace.findFiles('**/*', exclude);
00582|         const count = uris.length;
00583|         const msg = `Fallback file count: ${count.toLocaleString()} (excludes node_modules, .git, dist, out)`;
00584|         oc.appendLine(msg);
00585|         vscode.window.showInformationMessage(msg);
00586|       } catch (e) {

00088|   /**

00090|    * 適用於 extension 重新啟動後自動恢復連線。
00091|    * 若憑證已失效（QR 需重新掃描），會靜默放棄，等使用者手動呼叫 whatsapp_connect。
00092|    */

00094|     const waAuthDir = path.join(this._context.globalStorageUri.fsPath, 'wa-auth');
00095|     const credsFile = path.join(waAuthDir, 'creds.json');
00096|     if (!fs.existsSync(credsFile)) { this._cb.log('WA auto-reconnect: no saved creds, skipping'); return; }

00271|   /**

00274|    */
00275|   async handleIncoming(msg: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void> {

00283|     if (fromMe) {
00284|       let myPhone = this._context.globalState.get<string>('amiAiClaw.waPhone', '');
00285|       // remoteJid 可能含設備號 :N（如 886919327569:5@s.whatsapp.net），需一併去除
00286|       const remotePhone = remoteJid.replace(/@.+/, '').replace(/:.*/, '');
00287|       // 若 waPhone 尚未儲存（auto-reconnect 在 debug log 開啟前完成），嘗試從 socket 讀取
00288|       if (!myPhone && this._waSock) {
00289|         try {
00290|           const creds = (this._waSock as Record<string, unknown>)['authState'] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
00291|           const meObj = ((creds?.['creds'] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.['me']) as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
00292|           const meId = String(meObj?.['id'] ?? '');
00293|           myPhone = meId.replace(/:.*/, '').replace(/@.*/, '');

00295|             void this._context.globalState.update('amiAiClaw.waPhone', myPhone);

00300|       this._cb.log(`WA _handleWaIncoming: myPhone=${myPhone} remotePhone=${remotePhone}`);

00302|       const isLid = remoteJid.endsWith('@lid');

00310|     }

00312|     if (msgContent['deviceSentMessage']) {

00314|       const inner = dsm?.['message'] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
00315|       if (inner) {
00316|         this._cb.log('WA _handleWaIncoming: unwrapping deviceSentMessage');
00317|         msgContent = inner;
00318|       }
00319|     }

00321|     const text: string =
00322|       String(msgContent['conversation'] ?? '') ||

00325|       String((msgContent['videoMessage'] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.['caption'] ?? '') ||

00334|       return;

00425|   /**
00426|    * 處理 WhatsApp /module 內建指令（不走 Agent，直接同步回覆）。
00427|    * 支援：
00428|    *   /module list              → 列出所有可用 Ollama + Copilot 模型（帶編號）
00429|    *   /module <N>               → 切換 waAgentModel 為第 N 個模型
00430|    *   /module <name>            → 切換 waAgentModel 為名稱模糊相符的模型
00431|    */
00432|   async handleModuleCommand(text: string, msg: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void> {
00433|     this._cb.log(`WA /module command: "${text}"`);
00434| 
00435|     // 取得回覆 JID（原訊息的 remoteJid）
00436|     // @lid JID 是 WhatsApp 隱私混淆 ID，sendMessage 到 @lid 靜默失敗；
00437|     // 改用自己的 @s.whatsapp.net JID（Note-to-self 模式）
00438|     const msgKey = msg['key'] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
00439|     let replyJid = String(msgKey?.['remoteJid'] ?? '');
00440|     if (replyJid.endsWith('@lid')) {
00441|       const ownPhone = this._context.globalState.get<string>('amiAiClaw.waPhone', '');
00442|       if (ownPhone) replyJid = `${ownPhone}@s.whatsapp.net`;
00443|     }
00444|     this._cb.log(`WA /module replyJid: ${replyJid}`);
00445|     const send = async (body: string) => {
00446|       const prefixed = body.startsWith('[AmiClaw]') ? body : `[AmiClaw] ${body}`;
00447|       try {
00448|         if (this._waSock && replyJid) {
00449|           this._waSentTexts.add(prefixed);
00450|           setTimeout(() => { this._waSentTexts.delete(prefixed); }, 30_000);
00451|           await (this._waSock as Record<string, (j: string, m: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<void>>)
00452|             .sendMessage(replyJid, { text: prefixed });
00453|           this._cb.log(`WA /module sent OK (${prefixed.length} chars) -> ${replyJid}`);
00454|         }
00455|       } catch (e) { this._cb.log(`WA /module reply error: ${String(e)}`); }
00456|     };

01010|   private _listChats(): string {
01011|     if (!this._waConnected) {
01012|       return '⚠️ WhatsApp Web 未連線。請先呼叫 whatsapp_connect。';

01018|       .sort((a, b) => b.lastTs - a.lastTs);
01019|     const now = Date.now();
01020|     const rows = sorted.map((c, i) => {
01021|       const elapsed = Math.round((now - c.lastTs) / 60000);
01022|       const age = elapsed < 60 ? `${elapsed}m ago` : elapsed < 1440 ? `${Math.round(elapsed / 60)}h ago` : `${Math.round(elapsed / 1440)}d ago`;
01023|       const name = c.name ? `${c.name} (+${c.phone})` : `+${c.phone}`;
01024|       return `${i + 1}. ${name}\n   JID: ${c.jid}\n   最後: ${c.lastMsg} (${age}, ${c.msgCount} 則)`;
01025|     });
01026|     return `已知職天 ${sorted.length} 個（依最新活動排序）：\n\n${rows.join('\n\n')}`;
01027|   }

01055|   /** GET /api/tags → 傳回模型名稱清單。 */
01056|   private static _ollamaListModels(baseUrl: string): Promise<string[]> {
01057|     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
01058|       try {
01059|         const url = new URL('/api/tags', baseUrl);
01060|         const protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
01061|         const options: http.RequestOptions = {
01062|           hostname: url.hostname,
01063|           port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434),
01064|           path: url.pathname,
01065|           method: 'GET',
01066|         };
01067|         const req = protocol.request(options, (res) => {
01068|           let data = '';
01069|           res.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => { data += chunk; });
01070|           res.on('end', () => {
01071|             if (res.statusCode !== 200) { reject(new Error('HTTP ' + res.statusCode)); return; }
01072|             try {
01073|               const json = JSON.parse(data);
01074|               const names: string[] = (json.models ?? []).map((m: { name: string }) => m.name).sort();
01075|               resolve(names);
01076|             } catch { reject(new Error('Invalid JSON from /api/tags')); }
01077|           });
01078|         });
01079|         req.on('error', (e: NodeJS.ErrnoException) => reject(WhatsAppManager._ollamaConnectError(url.hostname, e)));
01080|         req.setTimeout(8000, () => { req.destroy(new Error('ETIMEDOUT')); });
01081|         req.end();
01082|       } catch (e) { reject(e); }
01083|     });
01084|   }
01085| 
01086|   private static _ollamaConnectError(hostname: string, e: NodeJS.ErrnoException): Error {
01087|     if (e.code === 'ENOTFOUND') {
01088|       return new Error('主機名稱 \'' + hostname + '\' 無法解析（DNS），請確認 /etc/hosts 或 DNS 設定');
01089|     }
01090|     if (e.code === 'ECONNREFUSED') {
01091|       return new Error('連線被拒絕（port 未開放），請確認 Ollama 伺服器已啟動：' + hostname + ':11434');
01092|     }
01093|     if (e.code === 'ETIMEDOUT' || e.message === 'ETIMEDOUT') {
01094|       return new Error('連線逾時，請確認防火牆設定或主機 \'' + hostname + '\' 可達');
01095|     }
01096|     if (e.code === 'EHOSTUNREACH') {
01097|       return new Error('無法到達主機 \'' + hostname + '\'，請確認網路路由設定');
01098|     }
01099|     return new Error((e.code ? e.code + ': ' : '') + e.message);
01100|   }

===== FILE: src\memdir\findRelevantMemories.ts  (40 lines) =====
00001| import { scanMemoryFiles } from './memoryScan';
00002| import * as fs from 'fs/promises';
00003| 
00004| export interface SelectedMemory { path: string; excerpt: string; mtimeMs: number }
00005| 
00006| /**
00007|  * Very small relevance selector: choose up to `max` most recently modified files
00008|  * that contain any keyword from queryTokens. Returns excerpt (first 1000 chars).
00009|  */
00010| export async function findRelevantMemories(query: string, max = 5): Promise<SelectedMemory[]> {
00011|   const headers = await scanMemoryFiles(200);
00012|   if (!query || headers.length === 0) return [];
00013|   const tokens = query.toLowerCase().split(/\W+/).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 10);
00014|   const scored: Array<{ h: typeof headers[0]; score: number }> = [];
00015|   for (const h of headers) {
00016|     try {
00017|       const raw = await fs.readFile(h.path, 'utf8');
00018|       const text = raw.toLowerCase();
00019|       let score = 0;
00020|       for (const t of tokens) { if (text.includes(t)) score += 1; }
00021|       // recency bonus: +3 today → +0 after 3+ days (newer files preferred)
00022|       const daysSince = (Date.now() - h.mtimeMs) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
00023|       if (daysSince < 3) score += Math.round(3 - daysSince);
00024|       if (score > 0) scored.push({ h, score });
00025|     } catch { /* ignore */ }
00026|   }
00027|   // return empty rather than injecting files with no content match
00028|   if (scored.length === 0) return [];
00029|   scored.sort((a,b)=>b.score - a.score || b.h.mtimeMs - a.h.mtimeMs);
00030|   const out: SelectedMemory[] = [];
00031|   for (const s of scored.slice(0, max)) {
00032|     try {
00033|       const raw = await fs.readFile(s.h.path, 'utf8');
00034|       out.push({ path: s.h.path, excerpt: raw.slice(0, 1000), mtimeMs: s.h.mtimeMs });
00035|     } catch { }
00036|   }
00037|   return out;
00038| }
00039| 
00040| export default { findRelevantMemories };

00018| export async function readMemoryIndex(): Promise<string> {
00019|   // Prefer workspace-scoped memory index when available.
00020|   const wsDir = paths.getWorkspaceMemoryDir();
00021|   if (wsDir) {
00022|     const wp = path.join(wsDir, INDEX_NAME);
00023|     try {
00024|       const b = await fs.readFile(wp, 'utf8');
00025|       return b;
00026|     } catch (e) {
00027|       // if workspace dir missing index, fallthrough to check global/base dir
00028|     }
00029|   }
00030| 
00031|   // fallback to base/global memory dir
00032|   const dir = paths.getDefaultMemoryDir();
00033|   const p = path.join(dir, INDEX_NAME);
00034|   try {
00035|     const b = await fs.readFile(p, 'utf8');
00036|     // if we have a workspace dir available, migrate the index there for future reads
00037|     if (wsDir) {
00038|       try {
00039|         await fs.mkdir(wsDir, { recursive: true });
00040|         await fs.writeFile(path.join(wsDir, INDEX_NAME), b, 'utf8');
00041|       } catch {
00042|         // ignore migration errors
00043|       }

00077| export async function migrateGlobalIndexToWorkspace(): Promise<{ migrated: boolean; details?: string }> {
00078|   const wsDir = paths.getWorkspaceMemoryDir();
00079|   if (!wsDir) return { migrated: false, details: 'no-workspace' };
00080| 
00081|   // legacy location under memory base: /projects/{projectId}/memory
00082|   const wsRoot = vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders && vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders[0]?.uri.fsPath;
00083|   if (!wsRoot) return { migrated: false, details: 'no-workspace-root' };
00084|   const projectId = wsRoot ? wsRoot.split(/[\\/]/).pop()?.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, '_') : 'unknown';

00086| 
00087|   try {
00088|     const existing = await fs.readdir(legacyDir, { withFileTypes: true }).catch(() => []);
00089|     if (!existing || existing.length === 0) return { migrated: false, details: 'no-legacy-files' };
00090|     await fs.mkdir(wsDir, { recursive: true }).catch(() => null);
00091|     let copied = 0;
00092|     for (const e of existing) {
00093|       if (!e.isFile() || !e.name.endsWith('.md')) continue;
00094|       const src = path.join(legacyDir, e.name);
00095|       const dest = path.join(wsDir, e.name);
00096|       try {
00097|         const b = await fs.readFile(src, 'utf8');
00098|         await fs.writeFile(dest, b, 'utf8');
00099|         copied++;
00100|       } catch {
00101|         // ignore individual failures
00102|       }
00103|     }
00104|     return { migrated: copied > 0, details: `copied:${copied}` };
00105|   } catch (e) {
00106|     return { migrated: false, details: String(e) };
00107|   }
00108| }

00001| import * as fs from 'fs/promises';

00004| 
00005| export interface MemoryHeader { path: string; mtimeMs: number; summary?: string }
00006| 
00007| export async function scanMemoryFiles(limit = 200): Promise<MemoryHeader[]> {
00008|   const files = await memdir.listMemoryFiles();
00009|   const results: MemoryHeader[] = [];
00010|   for (const f of files) {
00011|     try {
00012|       const stat = await fs.stat(f);
00013|       results.push({ path: f, mtimeMs: stat.mtimeMs });
00014|     } catch {}
00015|   }
00016|   results.sort((a,b)=>b.mtimeMs - a.mtimeMs);
00017|   return results.slice(0, limit);
00018| }

00001| /**
00002|  * Memory types & frontmatter
00003|  *
00004|  * 移植自 claude-code `memdir/memoryTypes.ts`。
00005|  * 定義四種記憶分類與 frontmatter 範例，供 extractMemories 與 MEMORY.md 索引使用。

00007| 
00008| export type MemoryType = 'fact' | 'preference' | 'pattern' | 'context';
00009| 
00010| export const MEMORY_TYPE_VALUES: readonly MemoryType[] = ['fact', 'preference', 'pattern', 'context'];
00011| 
00012| export interface MemoryFrontmatter {

00014|   title: string;
00015|   tags?: string[];

00017|   created?: string;
00018|   /** ISO date */

00023|   fact: '技術事實 / 規則 / constraint（例：「此專案 ESLint 用 X 規則」）',
00024|   preference: '使用者偏好 / 格式要求（例：「回覆用繁體中文」「不要產 emoji」）',
00025|   pattern: '常見解法 / 工作流（例：「build 失敗先看 Build.log 最後 50 行」）',

00032|   'title: One short descriptive title',
00033|   'tags: [tag1, tag2]',
00034|   'created: 2026-01-01',
00035|   'updated: 2026-01-15',
00036|   '---',
00037|   '',

00043| export const WHAT_NOT_TO_SAVE = [
00044|   '不要儲存：',

00051| /**
00052|  * 從 markdown 檔內容解析 frontmatter（簡化版，不引入 yaml lib）。
00053|  */
00054| export function parseMemoryFrontmatter(content: string): { meta: Partial<MemoryFrontmatter>; body: string } {
00055|   const m = content.match(/^---\n([\s\S]*?)\n---\n?([\s\S]*)$/);
00056|   if (!m) return { meta: {}, body: content };
00057| 
00058|   const meta: Partial<MemoryFrontmatter> = {};
00059|   for (const line of m[1].split('\n')) {
00060|     const kv = line.match(/^(\w+):\s*(.+)$/);
00061|     if (!kv) continue;
00062|     const key = kv[1];
00063|     const val = kv[2].trim();
00064|     if (key === 'type' && MEMORY_TYPE_VALUES.includes(val as MemoryType)) {
00065|       meta.type = val as MemoryType;
00066|     } else if (key === 'title') {
00067|       meta.title = val.replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
00068|     } else if (key === 'tags') {
00069|       meta.tags = val.replace(/[[\]]/g, '').split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
00070|     } else if (key === 'created' || key === 'updated') {
00071|       meta[key] = val;
00072|     }
00073|   }
00074|   return { meta, body: m[2] };
00075| }
00076| 
00077| /**
00078|  * 序列化 frontmatter 為 markdown 字串。
00079|  */
00080| export function stringifyMemoryFrontmatter(meta: MemoryFrontmatter, body: string): string {
00081|   const lines = ['---', `type: ${meta.type}`, `title: ${meta.title}`];
00082|   if (meta.tags && meta.tags.length > 0) lines.push(`tags: [${meta.tags.join(', ')}]`);
00083|   if (meta.created) lines.push(`created: ${meta.created}`);
00084|   if (meta.updated) lines.push(`updated: ${meta.updated}`);
00085|   lines.push('---', '', body.trim(), '');
00086|   return lines.join('\n');
00087| }

00018| export function getWorkspaceMemoryDir(): string | null {
00019|   const folders = vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders ?? [];
00020|   if (folders.length === 0) return null;
00021| 
00022|   // Prefer workspace folder that corresponds to active editor (multi-root friendly)
00023|   const active = vscode.window.activeTextEditor?.document.uri;
00024|   let chosenRoot: string | undefined;
00025|   if (active) {
00026|     const wf = vscode.workspace.getWorkspaceFolder(active);
00027|     if (wf) chosenRoot = wf.uri.fsPath;
00028|   }
00029|   // fallback to workspaceFolders[0]
00030|   if (!chosenRoot) chosenRoot = folders[0].uri.fsPath;
00031|   if (!chosenRoot) return null;
00032| 
00033|   // prefer a workspace-local memory directory under the chosen workspace root
00034|   return path.join(chosenRoot, '.amiclaw', 'memory');
00035| }
00036|

00038|   // prefer workspace-scoped memory dir when possible
00039|   const w = getWorkspaceMemoryDir();
00040|   if (w) return w;
00041|   return path.join(getMemoryBaseDir(), 'global', 'memory');
00042| }
00043| 
00044| export function validateMemoryPath(p: string): boolean {
00045|   if (!p) return false;
00046|   // reject root-like paths
00047|   const normalized = path.resolve(p);
00048|   if (normalized === path.parse(normalized).root) return false;
00049|   if (normalized.includes('\0')) return false;
00050|   return true;
00051| }

00130|   // 建立一個 Proxy 用以攔截陣列變更並標記為需要儲存
00131|   private createHistoryProxy(arr: ChatMessage[], sessionId: string): ChatMessage[] {
00132|     const that = this;
00133|     const target = Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : [];
00134|     const handler: ProxyHandler<ChatMessage[]> = {
00135|       set(t, prop, value) {
00136|         const res = Reflect.set(t, prop, value);
00137|         // 設定長度或數字索引時視為修改
00138|         if (typeof prop === 'string' && (prop === 'length' || /^\d+$/.test(prop))) {
00139|           that._chatDirty = true;
00140|           that.schedulePersistChatHistories();
00141|         }
00142|         return res;
00143|       },
00144|       get(t, prop, receiver) {
00145|         const v = Reflect.get(t, prop, receiver);
00146|         if (typeof v === 'function') {
00147|           const name = String(prop);
00148|           if (['push', 'pop', 'shift', 'unshift', 'splice', 'sort', 'reverse', 'fill', 'copyWithin'].includes(name)) {
00149|             return function (...args: any[]) {
00150|               const r = (Array.prototype as any)[name].apply(t, args);
00151|               that._chatDirty = true;
00152|               that.schedulePersistChatHistories();
00153|               return r;
00154|             };
00155|           }
00156|         }
00157|         return v;
00158|       }
00159|     };
00160|     const proxy = new Proxy(target, handler) as ChatMessage[];
00161|     (proxy as any).__isProxy = true;
00162|     return proxy;
00163|   }

00230|   /** 記錄一次 API 呼叫的 token 使用量，並推送更新到前端。 */
00231|   private trackUsage(model: string, tokens: number, multiplier = '', toolCall = false): void {
00232|     if (!toolCall && (!tokens || tokens <= 0)) { return; }
00233|     const isCopilot = model.startsWith('copilot::') || model.startsWith('copilot/');
00234|     const key = model.replace(/^copilot[::\/]+/, '');
00235|     const existing = this._usageStats[key];
00236|     if (existing) {
00237|       existing.tokens += tokens;
00238|       if (tokens > 0) existing.calls = (existing.calls || 0) + 1;
00239|       if (toolCall) existing.toolCalls = (existing.toolCalls || 0) + 1;
00240|     } else {
00241|       this._usageStats[key] = { tokens, isCopilot, multiplier, calls: tokens > 0 ? 1 : 0, toolCalls: toolCall ? 1 : 0 };
00242|     }
00243|     // 持久化累計值
00244|     const saved = this._context.globalState.get<Record<string, { tokens: number; isCopilot: boolean; multiplier: string; calls: number; toolCalls: number }>>('amiAiClaw.usageStats') ?? {};
00245|     const sk = saved[key];
00246|     if (sk) { sk.tokens += tokens; if (tokens > 0) sk.calls = (sk.calls || 0) + 1; if (toolCall) sk.toolCalls = (sk.toolCalls || 0) + 1; }
00247|     else { saved[key] = { tokens, isCopilot, multiplier, calls: tokens > 0 ? 1 : 0, toolCalls: toolCall ? 1 : 0 }; }
00248|     this._context.globalState.update('amiAiClaw.usageStats', saved);
00249|     this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'usageUpdate', stats: this._usageStats });
00250|   }
00251| 
00252|   /** 記錄一次請求的延遲，並推送到前端。 */
00253|   private trackLatency(model: string, ms: number): void {
00254|     const key = model.replace(/^copilot[::\/]+/, '');
00255|     this._latencyLog.push({ model: key, ms, ts: Date.now() });
00256|     if (this._latencyLog.length > 200) { this._latencyLog.shift(); }
00257|     this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'latencyUpdate', log: this._latencyLog });
00258|   }

00260|   private normalizeConfiguredModelId(modelId: string): string {
00261|     return modelId.startsWith('copilot/') ? `copilot::${modelId.slice('copilot/'.length)}` : modelId;
00262|   }
00263| 
00264|   private getProviderId(modelId: string): string {
00265|     if (modelId.startsWith('copilot::') || modelId.startsWith('copilot/')) {
00266|       return 'copilot';
00267|     }
00268|     if (modelId.startsWith('openai::')) {
00269|       return 'openai';
00270|     }
00271|     return 'ollama';
00272|   }

00274|   private getProviderLabel(providerId: string): string {
00275|     switch (providerId) {
00276|       case 'copilot':
00277|         return 'Copilot';
00278|       case 'openai':
00279|         return 'OpenAI Compatible';
00280|       default:
00281|         return 'Ollama';
00282|     }
00283|   }

00285|   private normalizeModelOptions(
00286|     ollamaModels: { id: string; label: string }[],
00287|     copilotModels: { id: string; name: string; multiplier: string }[]
00288|   ): WebviewModelOption[] {
00289|     return [

00293|           id: model.id,
00294|           label: model.label,
00295|           provider: isOai ? 'openai' : 'ollama',
00296|           providerLabel: isOai ? 'OpenAI Compatible' : 'Ollama',
00297|         };
00298|       }),
00299|       ...copilotModels.map((model) => ({
00300|         id: `copilot::${model.id}`,
00301|         label: model.name,
00302|         provider: 'copilot',
00303|         providerLabel: 'Copilot',
00304|         multiplier: model.multiplier,
00305|       })),
00306|     ];
00307|   }

00309|   private buildProviderInfo(modelId?: string, models?: WebviewModelOption[]): ProviderInfo {

00311|     const normalizedModelId = this.normalizeConfiguredModelId(modelId ?? cfg.get<string>('model') ?? '');

00315|

00317|       id: providerId,
00318|       label: this.getProviderLabel(providerId),
00319|       modelId: normalizedModelId,

00321|     };

01070|               this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'ollamaModelDeleteError', model: delModel, error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
01071|             }
01072|             break;
01073|           }
01074|           case 'pullOllamaModel': {
01075|             const pullUrl = message.url as string;
01076|             const pullModel = (message.model as string).trim();
01077|             if (!pullModel) { break; }
01078|             try {
01079|               await ollamaPullModel(pullUrl, pullModel, (status, pct) => {
01080|                 this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'ollamaModelPullProgress', model: pullModel, status, pct });
01081|               });
01082|               this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'ollamaModelPulled', model: pullModel, url: pullUrl });
01083|               await this._queryEngine.fetchModelsFromServer();
01084|             } catch (e) {
01085|               this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'ollamaModelPullError', model: pullModel, error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
01086|             }
01087|             break;
01088|           }
01089|           default:
01090|             OllamaChatPanel.log('Unknown message type: ' + message.type);
01091|             break;
01092|         }
01093|       } catch (e) {
01094|         const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
01095|         OllamaChatPanel.log('Message handler error: ' + msg);
01096|         OllamaChatPanel.reportDiagnostic('message handler error', e);
01097|         this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'error', text: msg });
01098|       }
01099|     }, null, this._disposables);

01101|     OllamaChatPanel.log('Setting webview HTML');

01104|     } catch (e) {
01105|       OllamaChatPanel.reportDiagnostic('constructor: setting webview HTML failed', e);
01106|       throw e;
01107|     }

01110|     const _self = this;

01210|   public static async createOrShow(context: vscode.ExtensionContext) {
01211|     // 優先：focus 側邊欄 view —— activity bar 內的 view 不會被使用者意外關掉，可常駐
01212|     try {
01213|       await vscode.commands.executeCommand('amiAiClaw.chatView.focus');
01214|       // resolveWebviewView 會在 view 首次顯示時被 VS Code 呼叫，由 createFromView 建立實例
01215|       if (OllamaChatPanel.currentPanel) { return; }
01216|     } catch (e) {
01217|       OllamaChatPanel.reportDiagnostic('createOrShow: chatView.focus failed, falling back to editor panel', e);
01218|     }
01219| 
01220|     // 已存在的實例（不論是 WebviewView 或 editor panel）：直接 reveal
01221|     if (OllamaChatPanel.currentPanel) {
01222|       OllamaChatPanel.currentPanel._panel.reveal?.(vscode.ViewColumn.One, true);
01223|       return;
01224|     }
01225| 
01226|     // 最後備援：傳統 editor-column panel（注意：使用者關閉此 tab 後實例會 dispose）
01227|     const panel = vscode.window.createWebviewPanel(
01228|       OllamaChatPanel.viewType,
01229|       'AmiClaw',
01230|       { viewColumn: vscode.ViewColumn.Beside, preserveFocus: false },
01231|       { enableScripts: true, retainContextWhenHidden: true }
01232|     );
01233| 
01234|     try {
01235|       OllamaChatPanel.currentPanel = new OllamaChatPanel(panel, context);
01236|       OllamaChatPanel.reportDiagnostic('createOrShow: fallback editor panel created');
01237|     } catch (e) {
01238|       OllamaChatPanel.reportDiagnostic('createOrShow: fallback editor panel init failed', e);
01239|       try { panel.dispose(); } catch { /* ignore */ }
01240|       OllamaChatPanel.revealDiagnostics();
01241|       void vscode.window.showErrorMessage('AmiClaw 啟動失敗，請查看輸出視窗「AmiClaw Diagnostics」。');
01242|       throw e;
01243|     }
01244|   }

01283|   /**

01285|    * 直到 agentStatus.running===false 後觸發 onTodoComplete 回呼。
01286|    * 注意：streamDone 只代表單次串流結束，Agent 可能還有多輪工具呼叫，不作為觸發條件。
01287|    * 由 extension.ts 的 processTodoFile 呼叫。

01294|   /** 統一的 postToWebview 入口，在 todo 模式下攔截訊息以累積回應文字。 */
01295|   private _postToWebview(msg: Record<string, unknown>): void {
01296|     // 累積 agent / ask 的回應文字
01297|     if (this._todoModePrompt !== undefined) {
01298|       if (msg.type === 'agentChunk' && typeof msg.text === 'string') {
01299|         this._todoAccumulator += msg.text;
01300|       } else if (msg.type === 'assistant' && typeof msg.text === 'string') {
01301|         this._todoAccumulator += msg.text;
01302|       } else if (msg.type === 'agentStatus' && msg.running === false) {
01303|         // Agent 全部輪次結束 → 觸發回呼（agentStatus.running===false 才是最終完成信號）
01304|         const prompt = this._todoModePrompt;
01305|         const response = this._todoAccumulator.trim();
01306|         this._todoModePrompt = undefined;
01307|         this._todoAccumulator = '';
01308|         if (response && OllamaChatPanel.onTodoComplete) {
01309|           OllamaChatPanel.onTodoComplete(prompt, response);
01310|         }
01311|       }
01312|     }
01313|     this._panel.webview.postMessage(msg);
01314|   }

01325|   private switchChatSession(sessionId?: string): void {
01326|     const id = this.resolveSessionId(sessionId);
01327|     if (!this._chatHistories[id]) {
01328|       this._chatHistories[id] = this.createHistoryProxy([], id);
01329|     }
01330|     this._activeSessionId = id;
01331|     // 若尚未為該 session 建立 proxy，包裝一次
01332|     if (!(this._chatHistories[id] as any).__isProxy) {
01333|       this._chatHistories[id] = this.createHistoryProxy(this._chatHistories[id] || [], id);
01334|     }
01335|     this._chatHistory = this._chatHistories[id];
01336|     this._agentExecutor.switchSession(id);
01337|   }

01339|   /**
01340|    * Send one or more URIs (files or folders) to the open chat panel as context.
01341|    * Call AFTER createOrShow so currentPanel is guaranteed to exist.
01342|    */
01343|   public static async sendUrisToChat(uris: vscode.Uri[]): Promise<void> {
01344|     const panel = OllamaChatPanel.currentPanel;
01345|     if (!panel) { return; }
01346| 
01347|     await panel.waitForWebviewReady();
01348| 
01349|     for (const uri of uris) {
01350|       let stat: vscode.FileStat;
01351|       try { stat = await vscode.workspace.fs.stat(uri); } catch { continue; }
01352| 
01353|       if (stat.type & vscode.FileType.Directory) {
01354|         // Send directory listing
01355|         const entries = await vscode.workspace.fs.readDirectory(uri);
01356|         const listing = entries.map(([name, type]) =>
01357|           (type & vscode.FileType.Directory) ? name + '/' : name
01358|         ).join('\n');
01359|         panel._panel.webview.postMessage({
01360|           type: 'fileAttached',
01361|           name: uri.fsPath,
01362|           content: `[目錄列表]\n${listing}`
01363|         });
01364|       } else {
01365|         // Send file content (limit to 500 KB)
01366|         const MAX = 500 * 1024;
01367|         const raw = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(uri);
01368|         const content = raw.byteLength > MAX
01369|           ? Buffer.from(raw).toString('utf8', 0, MAX) + '\n...(截斷)'
01370|           : Buffer.from(raw).toString('utf8');
01371|         panel._panel.webview.postMessage({
01372|           type: 'fileAttached',
01373|           name: uri.fsPath,
01374|           content
01375|         });
01376|       }
01377|     }
01378|   }

01452|   private async handleMemoryConsolidate(sessionId?: string): Promise<void> {
01453|     this.switchChatSession(sessionId);
01454|     if (this._chatHistory.length < 2) {
01455|       this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'consolidateDone', ltm: this.getLongTermMemory(), skipped: true });
01456|       return;
01457|     }
01458|     const cfg = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw');
01459|     const urls = getOllamaUrls(cfg);
01460|     const rawModel = cfg.get<string>('model') ?? '';
01461|     const { url: baseUrl, model } = rawModel.startsWith('copilot') ? { url: urls[0], model: rawModel } : decodeOllamaModel(rawModel, urls);
01462|     const currentLtm = this.getLongTermMemory();
01463|     const historyText = this._chatHistory.map(m => {
01464|       const role = m.role === 'user' ? '使用者' : 'AI';
01465|       return `[${role}]: ${(m.content ?? '').slice(0, 500)}`;
01466|     }).join('\n\n');
01467|     const consolidatePrompt = `你是記憶整理助手。請從以下【短期對話記錄】中，提取值得長期保存的重要資訊（使用者習慣、偏好、結論、技術事實、環境設定等），與【現有長期記憶】合併，去掉重複或過時的內容，以簡潔的條列格式（每行一個重點，用 - 開頭）輸出整合後的長期記憶。不要加任何前言或說明，直接輸出條列內容。
01468| 
01469| 【現有長期記憶】
01470| ${currentLtm.trim() || '（空）'}
01471| 
01472| 【短期對話記錄】
01473| ${historyText}
01474| 
01475| 整合後的長期記憶：`;
01476|     this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'consolidateStart' });
01477|     try {
01478|       let newLtm = '';
01479|       if (model.startsWith('copilot::')) {
01480|         const cts = new vscode.CancellationTokenSource();
01481|         try {
01482|           newLtm = await copilotStreamText(model.slice('copilot::'.length), [vscode.LanguageModelChatMessage.User(consolidatePrompt)], (chunk) => { this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'consolidateChunk', chunk }); }, cts.token);
01483|         } finally { cts.dispose(); }
01484|       } else if (model.startsWith('openai::')) {
01485|         const res = await openaiCompatChatCallStream(baseUrl, model.slice('openai::'.length), [{ role: 'user', content: consolidatePrompt }], [], (chunk) => { this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'consolidateChunk', chunk }); });
01486|         newLtm = res.content ?? '';
01487|       } else {
01488|         newLtm = await ollamaGenerateStream(baseUrl, model, consolidatePrompt, (chunk) => { this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'consolidateChunk', chunk }); });
01489|       }

01518|             }

01636|   private async handleApplyToFile(code: string): Promise<void> {
01637|     const editor = vscode.window.activeTextEditor;

01640|     const fullRange = new vscode.Range(doc.positionAt(0), doc.positionAt(doc.getText().length));
01641|     const lines = doc.getText().split('\n').length;
01642|     if (lines > 50) {
01643|       const ans = await vscode.window.showWarningMessage(
01644|         `將替換 ${doc.fileName.split(/[\\/]/).pop()} (${lines} 行) 的全部內容，確定?`,
01645|         '確定替換', '取消'
01646|       );
01647|       if (ans !== '確定替換') { return; }
01648|     }

01681| /** Docker 模式瀏覽器工具執行助手：透過 stdin 將 Python 程式碼傳送至容器，回傳 stdout。
01682|  *  使用 `docker run --rm -i <image> python -` ，不需要挂載影約或在害端安裝 playwright。
01683|  */
01684| /** 過濾輸出文字中的敏感資訊（API key、token、密碼等），避免模型學習或外洩憑證。 */
01685| export function filterSensitiveInfo(text: string): string {
01686|   return text
01687|     // JWT tokens (Header.Payload.Signature)
01688|     .replace(/eyJ[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{10,}\.[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{5,}\.[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{5,}/g, '[JWT_REDACTED]')
01689|     // AWS access key IDs
01690|     .replace(/\bAKIA[A-Z0-9]{16}\b/g, '[AWS_KEY_REDACTED]')
01691|     // PEM private key blocks
01692|     .replace(/-----BEGIN (?:[A-Z ]+ )?PRIVATE KEY-----[\s\S]*?-----END (?:[A-Z ]+ )?PRIVATE KEY-----/g, '[PRIVATE_KEY_REDACTED]')
01693|     // Authorization Bearer headers
01694|     .replace(/(Authorization:\s*Bearer\s+)[A-Za-z0-9_\-.+/]{20,}/gi, '$1[REDACTED]')
01695|     // GitHub personal access tokens
01696|     .replace(/\bgh[pousr]_[a-zA-Z0-9]{36,}\b/g, '[GH_TOKEN_REDACTED]')
01697|     // OpenAI / Anthropic / generic sk- API keys
01698|     .replace(/\bsk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}\b/g, '[API_KEY_REDACTED]')
01699|     // Generic credential key=value or "key": "value" patterns
01700|     .replace(/(["\'']?(?:api_?key|secret|password|passwd|token|access_?key|auth_?key|private_?key)["\'']?\s*[:=]\s*["\'']?)[A-Za-z0-9_\-.+/]{16,}(["\'']?)/gi, '$1[REDACTED]$2');
01701| }

01703| /** 估算文字的約略 token 數（CJK 字元每個約 1 token，ASCII 每 4 字元約 1 token）。 */
01704| export function estimateTokens(text: string): number {
01705|   let count = 0;
01706|   for (const ch of text) {
01707|     const code = ch.codePointAt(0) ?? 0;
01708|     count += code > 0x2E7F ? 1 : 0.25;  // CJK/special ≈ 1 token; ASCII ≈ 1/4 token
01709|   }
01710|   return Math.ceil(count);
01711| }
