01713| /** 快取：model context length（key = `${baseUrl}||${model}`）。TTL 5 分鐘。 */
01714| const _modelCtxCache = new Map<string, { len: number; ts: number }>();
01715| const MODEL_CTX_TTL = 5 * 60 * 1000;
01716| 
01717| /** 清除 context length 快取，讓下次查詢重新向伺服器取值。重整模型時呼叫。 */
01718| export function clearModelCtxCache(): void { _modelCtxCache.clear(); }
01719| 
01720| /** 向 Ollama `/api/show` 或 vLLM/OpenAI-compat `/v1/models/{id}` 查詢模型實際 context window 大小（tokens）。
01721|  *  - Ollama：解析 `model_info.*.context_length`（0.3+）或 `parameters` 段落的 `num_ctx`
01722|  *  - vLLM / OpenAI-compat：解析 `GET /v1/models/{model_id}` 回應中的 `max_model_len`
01723|  *  成功時回傳正整數；失敗時回傳 0。結果快取 5 分鐘。
01724|  *  `model` 可帶 `openai::` 前綴，函式會自動去除後查詢。 */
01725| function ollamaGetContextLength(baseUrl: string, model: string): Promise<number> {
01726|   const cacheKey = `${baseUrl}||${model}`;
01727|   const cached = _modelCtxCache.get(cacheKey);
01728|   if (cached && Date.now() - cached.ts < MODEL_CTX_TTL) { return Promise.resolve(cached.len); }
01729| 
01730|   const isOpenAiCompat = model.startsWith('openai::');
01731|   const rawModel = isOpenAiCompat ? model.slice('openai::'.length) : model;
01732| 
01733|   // ── vLLM / OpenAI-compat：GET /v1/models/{model_id} ──────────────────────
01734|   if (isOpenAiCompat) {
01735|     return new Promise<number>((resolve) => {
01736|       try {
01737|         // LM Studio 內部 API：/api/v0/models 回傳 max_context_length
01738|         const lmsUrl = new URL('/api/v0/models', baseUrl);
01739|         const protocol = lmsUrl.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
01740|         const _oaiKey = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw').get<string>('openaiCompatApiKey', '');
01741|         const lmsReq = protocol.request({
01742|           hostname: lmsUrl.hostname,
01743|           port: lmsUrl.port ? parseInt(lmsUrl.port, 10) : (lmsUrl.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 80),
01744|           path: lmsUrl.pathname,
01745|           method: 'GET',
01746|           headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json', ...(_oaiKey ? { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + _oaiKey } : {}) },
01747|         }, (res) => {
01748|           let data = '';
01749|           res.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => { data += chunk; });
01750|           res.on('end', () => {
01751|             if (res.statusCode === 200) {
01752|               try {
01753|                 const json = JSON.parse(data);
01754|                 const models: Array<{ id?: string; max_context_length?: number }> = json.data ?? json;
01755|                 const entry = Array.isArray(models) ? models.find(m => m.id === rawModel) : null;
01756|                 const len = Number(entry?.max_context_length ?? 0);
01757|                 if (len > 0) { _modelCtxCache.set(cacheKey, { len, ts: Date.now() }); resolve(len); return; }
01758|               } catch { /* fall through to vLLM path */ }
01759|             }
01760|             // vLLM fallback：GET /v1/models/{model_id}
01761|             const encodedId = encodeURIComponent(rawModel);
01762|             const url = new URL(`/v1/models/${encodedId}`, baseUrl);
01763|             const req2 = protocol.request({
01764|               hostname: url.hostname,
01765|               port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 80),
01766|               path: url.pathname,
01767|               method: 'GET',
01768|               headers: { ...(_oaiKey ? { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + _oaiKey } : {}) },
01769|             }, (res2) => {
01770|               let d2 = '';
01771|               res2.on('data', (c: Buffer) => { d2 += c; });
01772|               res2.on('end', () => {
01773|                 try {
01774|                   const j2 = JSON.parse(d2);
01775|                   const len2 = Number(j2.max_model_len ?? 0);
01776|                   if (len2 > 0) { _modelCtxCache.set(cacheKey, { len: len2, ts: Date.now() }); }
01777|                   resolve(len2 > 0 ? len2 : 0);
01778|                 } catch { resolve(0); }
01779|               });
01780|             });
01781|             req2.on('error', () => resolve(0));
01782|             req2.setTimeout(3000, () => { req2.destroy(); resolve(0); });
01783|             req2.end();
01784|           });
01785|         });
01786|         lmsReq.on('error', () => resolve(0));
01787|         lmsReq.setTimeout(5000, () => { lmsReq.destroy(); resolve(0); });
01788|         lmsReq.end();
01789|       } catch { resolve(0); }
01790|     });
01791|   }
01792| 
01793|   // ── Ollama：POST /api/show ────────────────────────────────────────────────
01794|   return new Promise<number>((resolve) => {
01795|     try {
01796|       const url = new URL('/api/show', baseUrl);
01797|       const body = JSON.stringify({ name: rawModel });
01798|       const protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
01799|       const req = protocol.request({
01800|         hostname: url.hostname,
01801|         port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434),
01802|         path: url.pathname,
01803|         method: 'POST',
01804|         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(body) },
01805|       }, (res) => {
01806|         let data = '';
01807|         res.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => { data += chunk; });
01808|         res.on('end', () => {
01809|           try {
01810|             const json = JSON.parse(data);
01811|             // Priority 1: parameters.num_ctx = actual loaded window (Modelfile/user config)
01812|             let len = 0;
01813|             if (json.parameters) {
01814|               const m = String(json.parameters).match(/num_ctx\s+(\d+)/);
01815|               if (m) { len = Number(m[1]); }
01816|             }
01817|             // Priority 2: model_info.*.context_length = architecture capacity (may far exceed loaded window)
01818|             if (!len) {
01819|               const modelInfo: Record<string, unknown> = json.model_info ?? {};
01820|               for (const k of Object.keys(modelInfo)) {
01821|                 if (k.endsWith('.context_length')) { len = Number(modelInfo[k]); break; }
01822|               }
01823|             }
01824|             if (len > 0) { _modelCtxCache.set(cacheKey, { len, ts: Date.now() }); }
01825|             resolve(len > 0 ? len : 0);
01826|           } catch { resolve(0); }
01827|         });
01828|       });
01829|       req.on('error', () => resolve(0));
01830|       req.setTimeout(5000, () => { req.destroy(); resolve(0); });
01831|       req.write(body);
01832|       req.end();
01833|     } catch { resolve(0); }
01834|   });
01835| }

01837| /** 傳送 keep_alive=600 給 Ollama 以預熱（fire-and-forget），讓模型提前載入以減少首次請求延遲。 */
01838| function ollamaWarmupModel(baseUrl: string, model: string): void {
01839|   try {
01840|     const url = new URL('/api/generate', baseUrl);
01841|     const body = JSON.stringify({ model, prompt: '', keep_alive: 600 });
01842|     const protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
01843|     const req = protocol.request({
01844|       hostname: url.hostname,
01845|       port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434),
01846|       path: url.pathname, method: 'POST',
01847|       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(body) },
01848|     }, res => { res.resume(); });
01849|     req.on('error', () => {});
01850|     req.setTimeout(30000, () => { req.destroy(); });
01851|     req.write(body); req.end();
01852|   } catch { /* ignore */ }
01853| }

01855| /** 傳送 keep_alive=0 給 Ollama 要求立即卸載模型（釋放 VRAM）。等待 Ollama 回應後 resolve。*/
01856| function ollamaUnloadModel(baseUrl: string, model: string): Promise<void> {
01857|   return new Promise(resolve => {
01858|     try {
01859|       const url = new URL('/api/generate', baseUrl);
01860|       // prompt:'' must be present; keep_alive:0 tells Ollama to unload immediately
01861|       const body = JSON.stringify({ model, prompt: '', keep_alive: 0 });
01862|       const protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
01863|       const req = protocol.request({
01864|         hostname: url.hostname,
01865|         port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434),
01866|         path: url.pathname, method: 'POST',
01867|         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(body) },
01868|       }, res => { res.resume(); res.on('end', () => resolve()); res.on('error', () => resolve()); });
01869|       req.on('error', () => resolve());
01870|       req.setTimeout(30000, () => { req.destroy(); resolve(); });
01871|       req.write(body); req.end();
01872|     } catch { resolve(); }
01873|   });
01874| }

01876| /** GET /api/ps → 傳回目前 Ollama 正在執行的模型及其 VRAM 用量（bytes）。*/
01877| function ollamaGetRunningModels(baseUrl: string): Promise<{ name: string; size_vram: number }[]> {
01878|   return new Promise(resolve => {
01879|     try {
01880|       const url = new URL('/api/ps', baseUrl);
01881|       const protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
01882|       const req = protocol.request({
01883|         hostname: url.hostname,
01884|         port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434),
01885|         path: url.pathname, method: 'GET',
01886|       }, res => {
01887|         let data = '';
01888|         res.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => { data += chunk; });
01889|         res.on('end', () => {
01890|           try {

01935| function ollamaChatCall(baseUrl: string, model: string, messages: ChatMessage[], tools: unknown[]): Promise<ChatMessage> {
01936|   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
01937|     try {
01938|       const url = new URL('/api/chat', baseUrl);
01939|       const body = JSON.stringify({ model, messages, tools, stream: false, ...getOllamaThinkParam(model) });
01940|       const protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
01941|       const options: http.RequestOptions = {
01942|         hostname: url.hostname,
01943|         port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434),
01944|         path: url.pathname,
01945|         method: 'POST',
01946|         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(body) }
01947|       };
01948|       const req = protocol.request(options, (res) => {
01949|         let data = '';
01950|         res.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => { data += chunk; });
01951|         res.on('end', () => {
01952|           if (res.statusCode !== 200) {
01953|             reject(new Error(`Ollama /api/chat 回傳 HTTP ${res.statusCode}: ${data.substring(0, 200)}`));
01954|             return;
01955|           }
01956|           try {
01957|             const json = JSON.parse(data);
01958|             const msg = json.message as ChatMessage & { thinking?: string };
01959|             // Also extract <think>...</think> from content if no dedicated thinking field
01960|             if (!msg.thinking && msg.content) {
01961|               const m = (msg.content as string).match(/^<think>([\s\S]*?)<\/think>\s*/);
01962|               if (m) { msg.thinking = m[1].trim(); msg.content = (msg.content as string).slice(m[0].length); }
01963|             }
01964|             resolve(msg);
01965|           } catch { reject(new Error('無法解析 /api/chat 回應')); }
01966|         });
01967|       });
01968|       req.on('error', (e: NodeJS.ErrnoException) => reject(ollamaConnectError(new URL(baseUrl).hostname, e)));
01969|       req.setTimeout(600000, () => { req.destroy(new Error('Agent \u547c\u53eb\u903e\u6642 (600s)')); });
01970|       req.write(body);
01971|       req.end();
01972|     } catch (e) { reject(e); }
01973|   });
01974| }

01976| export function ollamaChatCallStream(
01977|   baseUrl: string, model: string, messages: ChatMessage[], tools: unknown[],
01978|   onThinkChunk?: (chunk: string) => void,
01979|   onTextChunk?: (chunk: string) => void,
01980|   onStats?: (tokens: number, tps: number) => void
01981| ): Promise<ChatMessage> {
01982|   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
01983|     try {
01984|       const url = new URL('/api/chat', baseUrl);
01985|       const bodyObj: Record<string, unknown> = {
01986|         model, messages, stream: true,
01987|         ...(tools.length > 0 ? { tools } : {}),
01988|         ...getOllamaThinkParam(model)
01989|       };
01990|       const body = JSON.stringify(bodyObj);
01991|       const protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
01992|       const options: http.RequestOptions = {
01993|         hostname: url.hostname,
01994|         port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434),
01995|         path: url.pathname, method: 'POST',
01996|         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(body) }
01997|       };
01998|       let lineBuffer = '';
01999|       let accContent = '';
02000|       let accThinking = '';
02001|       let finalToolCalls: unknown[] | undefined;
02002|       let wasTruncated = false;
02003|       const req = protocol.request(options, (res) => {
02004|         if (res.statusCode && (res.statusCode < 200 || res.statusCode >= 300)) {
02005|           let errBody = '';
02006|           res.setEncoding('utf8');
02007|           res.on('data', (d: string) => { errBody += d; });
02008|           res.on('end', () => {
02009|             try { const j = JSON.parse(errBody); reject(new Error('Ollama 錯誤：' + (j.error ?? 'HTTP ' + res.statusCode))); }
02010|             catch { reject(new Error('Ollama HTTP ' + res.statusCode)); }
02011|           });
02012|           return;
02013|         }
02014|         res.setEncoding('utf8');
02015|         let streamError: string | null = null;
02016|         res.on('data', (data: string) => {
02017|           lineBuffer += data;
02018|           const lines = lineBuffer.split('\n');
02019|           lineBuffer = lines.pop() ?? '';
02020|           for (const line of lines) {
02021|             const t = line.trim(); if (!t) continue;
02022|             try {
02023|               const json = JSON.parse(t) as Record<string, unknown>;
02024|               if (json.error) { const e = json.error; streamError = typeof e === 'string' ? e : ((e as Record<string, unknown>).message as string | undefined) ?? JSON.stringify(e); return; }
02025|               const msgFrag = json.message as (ChatMessage & { thinking?: string }) | undefined;
02026|               if (msgFrag) {
02027|                 if (msgFrag.thinking) { accThinking += msgFrag.thinking; if (onThinkChunk) onThinkChunk(msgFrag.thinking); }
02028|                 if (msgFrag.content) { accContent += msgFrag.content; if (onTextChunk) onTextChunk(msgFrag.content); }
02029|                 if (msgFrag.tool_calls && Array.isArray(msgFrag.tool_calls) && msgFrag.tool_calls.length > 0) {
02030|                   finalToolCalls = msgFrag.tool_calls;
02031|                 }
02032|               }
02033|               if (json.done) {
02034|                 if ((json.done_reason as string | undefined) === 'length') wasTruncated = true;
02035|                 const ec = json.eval_count as number | undefined;
02036|                 const ed = json.eval_duration as number | undefined;
02037|                 if (onStats && ec && ed && ed > 0) onStats(ec, ec / (ed / 1e9));
02038|               }
02039|             } catch { /* partial */ }
02040|           }
02041|         });
02042|         res.on('end', () => {
02043|           if (streamError) { reject(new Error('Ollama 錯誤：' + streamError)); return; }
02044|           if (finalToolCalls && finalToolCalls.length > 0) {
02045|             resolve({ role: 'assistant', content: accContent || null, tool_calls: finalToolCalls as ChatMessage['tool_calls'] });
02046|           } else {
02047|             let content = accContent;
02048|             if (!accThinking && content) {
02049|               const m = content.match(/^<think>([\s\S]*?)<\/think>\s*/);
02050|               if (m) { if (onThinkChunk) onThinkChunk(m[1].trim()); content = content.slice(m[0].length); }
02051|             }
02052|             resolve({ role: 'assistant', content: content || null, thinking: accThinking || undefined, truncated: wasTruncated || undefined });
02053|           }
02054|         });
02055|       });
02056|       req.on('error', (e: NodeJS.ErrnoException) => reject(ollamaConnectError(new URL(baseUrl).hostname, e)));
02057|       req.setTimeout(600000, () => { req.destroy(new Error('Agent 呼叫逾時 (600s)')); });
02058|       req.write(body); req.end();
02059|     } catch (e) { reject(e); }
02060|   });
02061| }

02063| /**
02064|  * OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions 串流呼叫（支援 tool_calls）。
02065|  * 模型 ID 格式：openai::http://host:port||model-name 或 openai::model-name（使用預設 baseUrl）
02066|  */
02067| function openaiCompatChatCallStream(
02068|   baseUrl: string, model: string, messages: ChatMessage[], tools: unknown[],
02069|   onTextChunk?: (chunk: string) => void,
02070|   onStats?: (tokens: number, tps: number) => void,
02071|   onThinkChunk?: (chunk: string) => void
02072| ): Promise<ChatMessage> {
02073|   OllamaChatPanel.log(`[openaiCompat] call url=${baseUrl} model=${model} msgs=${messages.length} tools=${tools.length}`);
02074|   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
02075|     try {
02076|       const url = new URL('/v1/chat/completions', baseUrl);
02077|       // 轉換 ChatMessage 格式為 OpenAI 格式
02078|       const oaiMessages = messages.map(m => {
02079|         if (m.role === 'tool') {
02080|           return { role: 'tool' as const, content: m.content ?? '', tool_call_id: m.tool_call_id ?? '' };
02081|         }

02085|             content: m.content ?? null,
02086|             tool_calls: m.tool_calls.map(tc => ({
02087|               id: tc.id ?? tc.function.name,
02088|               type: 'function' as const,

02090|                 name: tc.function.name,
02091|                 arguments: typeof tc.function.arguments === 'string'
02092|                   ? tc.function.arguments
02093|                   : JSON.stringify(tc.function.arguments),
02094|               },
02095|             })),
02096|           };
02097|         }
02098|         return { role: m.role as 'system' | 'user' | 'assistant', content: m.content ?? '' };
02099|       });
02100|       const protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
02101|       let triedWithoutTools = false;
02102| 
02103|       const sendRequest = (includeTools: boolean) => {
02104|         const oaiTools = includeTools && tools.length > 0 ? tools : undefined;
02105|         const bodyObj: Record<string, unknown> = { model, messages: oaiMessages, stream: true };
02106|         if (oaiTools) { bodyObj.tools = oaiTools; }
02107|         const body = JSON.stringify(bodyObj);
02108| 
02109|         const options: http.RequestOptions = {
02110|           hostname: url.hostname,
02111|           port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 80),
02112|           path: url.pathname, method: 'POST',
02113|           headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(body), 'Accept': 'text/event-stream' },
02114|         };
02115|         const _oaiKey = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw').get<string>('openaiCompatApiKey', '');
02116|         if (_oaiKey) { (options.headers as Record<string, string>)['Authorization'] = 'Bearer ' + _oaiKey; }
02117| 
02118|         let lineBuffer = '';
02119|         let accContent = '';
02120|         let wasTruncated = false;
02121|         // tool_calls 是增量合併結構（index-based）
02122|         const toolCallBuilders: Map<number, { id: string; name: string; args: string }> = new Map();
02123|         let promptTokens = 0; let completionTokens = 0; const startMs = Date.now();
02124|         // <think> 串流路由狀態機（0=before, 1=in_think, 2=after）
02125|         let _thinkState: 0 | 1 | 2 = 0;
02126|         let _tagBuf = '';
02127|         const _dispatch = (raw: string) => {
02128|           let s = _tagBuf + raw; _tagBuf = '';
02129|           while (s.length > 0) {
02130|             if (_thinkState === 0) {
02131|               const openIdx = s.indexOf('<think>');
02132|               if (openIdx === -1) {
02133|                 let cut = s.length;
02134|                 for (let p = Math.min(s.length, 6); p >= 1; p--) { if ('<think>'.startsWith(s.slice(s.length - p))) { cut = s.length - p; _tagBuf = s.slice(cut); break; } }
02135|                 if (cut > 0 && onTextChunk) onTextChunk(s.slice(0, cut));
02136|                 s = '';
02137|               } else {
02138|                 if (openIdx > 0 && onTextChunk) onTextChunk(s.slice(0, openIdx));
02139|                 s = s.slice(openIdx + 7); _thinkState = 1;
02140|               }
02141|             } else if (_thinkState === 1) {
02142|               const closeIdx = s.indexOf('</think>');
02143|               if (closeIdx === -1) {
02144|                 let cut = s.length;
02145|                 for (let p = Math.min(s.length, 7); p >= 1; p--) { if ('</think>'.startsWith(s.slice(s.length - p))) { cut = s.length - p; _tagBuf = s.slice(cut); break; } }
02146|                 if (cut > 0 && onThinkChunk) onThinkChunk(s.slice(0, cut));
02147|                 s = '';
02148|               } else {
02149|                 if (closeIdx > 0 && onThinkChunk) onThinkChunk(s.slice(0, closeIdx));
02150|                 s = s.slice(closeIdx + 8); _thinkState = 2;
02151|               }
02152|             } else {
02153|               if (onTextChunk) onTextChunk(s); s = '';
02154|             }
02155|           }
02156|         };
02157| 
02158|         const req = protocol.request(options, (res)=> {
02159|           if (res.statusCode && (res.statusCode < 200 || res.statusCode >= 300)) {
02160|             let errBody = '';
02161|             res.setEncoding('utf8');
02162|             res.on('data', (d: string) => { errBody += d; });
02163|             res.on('end', () => {
02164|               let apiMessage = 'HTTP ' + res.statusCode;
02165|               try {
02166|                 const j = JSON.parse(errBody);
02167|                 apiMessage = j.error?.message ?? apiMessage;
02168|               } catch { /* ignore parse error */ }
02169| 
02170|               const isAutoToolChoiceError = apiMessage.includes('"auto" tool choice requires')
02171|                 || apiMessage.includes('--enable-auto-tool-choice');
02172| 
02173|               // vLLM 在未啟用 auto tool choice 時會拒絕 tools；自動降級為無工具重試一次。
02174|               if (includeTools && !triedWithoutTools && isAutoToolChoiceError) {
02175|                 triedWithoutTools = true;
02176|                 sendRequest(false);
02177|                 return;
02178|               }
02179| 
02180|               if (apiMessage.startsWith('HTTP ')) {
02181|                 reject(new Error('OpenAI API HTTP ' + res.statusCode + ': ' + errBody.slice(0, 200)));
02182|                 return;
02183|               }
02184|               reject(new Error('OpenAI API 錯誤：' + apiMessage));
02185|             });
02186|             return;
02187|           }
02188|           res.setEncoding('utf8');
02189|           OllamaChatPanel.log(`[openaiCompat] HTTP ${res.statusCode} headers=${JSON.stringify(res.headers).slice(0,200)}`);
02190|           let _firstChunk = true;
02191|           let _sseEvent = '';       // track current SSE event type
02192|           let _sseError = '';       // accumulate SSE error message
02193|           res.on('data', (data: string) => {
02194|             lineBuffer += data;
02195|             const lines = lineBuffer.split('\n');
02196|             lineBuffer = lines.pop() ?? '';
02197|             for (const line of lines) {
02198|               const t = line.trim();
02199|               if (!t) { _sseEvent = ''; continue; }           // blank line resets event type
02200|               if (t.startsWith('event:')) { _sseEvent = t.slice(6).trim(); continue; }
02201|               if (!t.startsWith('data:')) continue;
02202|               const payload = t.slice(5).trim();
02203|               if (payload === '[DONE]') continue;
02204|               // SSE error event: reject with the error message
02205|               if (_sseEvent === 'error') {
02206|                 try {
02207|                   const errObj = JSON.parse(payload);
02208|                   const msg = errObj?.error?.message ?? payload.slice(0, 300);
02209|                   _sseError = msg;
02210|                 } catch { _sseError = payload.slice(0, 300); }
02211|                 continue;
02212|               }
02213|               try {
02214|                 const chunk = JSON.parse(payload) as {
02215|                   choices?: Array<{
02216|                     delta?: {
02217|                       content?: string | null;
02218|                       reasoning_content?: string | null;   // LM Studio / OpenRouter 思考欄位
02219|                       tool_calls?: Array<{ index: number; id?: string; function?: { name?: string; arguments?: string } }>;
02220|                     };
02221|                     finish_reason?: string;
02222|                   }>;
02223|                   usage?: { prompt_tokens?: number; completion_tokens?: number };
02224|                 };
02225|                 if (chunk.choices?.[0]?.finish_reason === 'length') wasTruncated = true;
02226|                 const delta = chunk.choices?.[0]?.delta;
02227|                 // reasoning_content → 思考框（Gemma 4 / OpenRouter thinking 格式）
02228|                 if (delta?.reasoning_content) {
02229|                   if (_firstChunk) { OllamaChatPanel.log(`[openaiCompat] first reasoning_content chunk: ${JSON.stringify(delta.reasoning_content.slice(0,40))}`); _firstChunk = false; }
02230|                   if (onThinkChunk) onThinkChunk(delta.reasoning_content);
02231|                 }
02232|                 if (delta?.content) {
02233|                   if (_firstChunk) { OllamaChatPanel.log(`[openaiCompat] first content chunk: ${JSON.stringify(delta.content.slice(0,40))}`); _firstChunk = false; }
02234|                   accContent += delta.content; _dispatch(delta.content);
02235|                 }
02236|                 if (delta?.tool_calls) {
02237|                   for (const tc of delta.tool_calls) {
02238|                     if (!toolCallBuilders.has(tc.index)) { toolCallBuilders.set(tc.index, { id: tc.id ?? '', name: '', args: '' }); }
02239|                     const b = toolCallBuilders.get(tc.index)!;
02240|                     if (tc.id) b.id = tc.id;
02241|                     if (tc.function?.name) b.name += tc.function.name;
02242|                     if (tc.function?.arguments) b.args += tc.function.arguments;
02243|                   }
02244|                 }
02245|                 if (chunk.usage) {
02246|                   promptTokens = chunk.usage.prompt_tokens ?? 0;
02247|                   completionTokens = chunk.usage.completion_tokens ?? 0;
02248|                 }
02249|               } catch { /* partial */ }
02250|             }
02251|           });
02252|           res.on('end', () => {
02253|             OllamaChatPanel.log(`[openaiCompat] end: accContent.length=${accContent.length} toolCalls=${toolCallBuilders.size} sseError=${!!_sseError}`);
02254|             // SSE error event → check if context overflow + tools → retry without tools
02255|             if (_sseError) {
02256|               const isCtxOverflow = /exceeds.*context|context.*size|context.*length/i.test(_sseError);
02257|               if (includeTools && !triedWithoutTools && isCtxOverflow) {
02258|                 OllamaChatPanel.log(`[openaiCompat] context overflow with tools, retrying without tools`);
02259|                 triedWithoutTools = true;
02260|                 sendRequest(false);
02261|                 return;
02262|               }
02263|               reject(new Error('OpenAI API 錯誤：' + _sseError));
02264|               return;
02265|             }
02266|             if (onStats && completionTokens > 0) {
02267|               const elapsed = (Date.now() - startMs) / 1000;
02268|               onStats(promptTokens + completionTokens, elapsed > 0 ? completionTokens / elapsed : 0);
02269|             }
02270|             if (toolCallBuilders.size > 0) {
02271|               const tool_calls = Array.from(toolCallBuilders.entries())
02272|                 .sort(([a], [b]) => a - b)
02273|                 .map(([, b]) => ({
02274|                   id: b.id || b.name,
02275|                   function: {
02276|                     name: b.name,
02277|                     arguments: (() => { try { return JSON.parse(b.args) as Record<string, unknown>; } catch { return {}; } })(),
02278|                   },
02279|                 }));
02280|               resolve({ role: 'assistant', content: accContent || null, tool_calls });
02281|             } else {
02282|               resolve({ role: 'assistant', content: accContent || null, truncated: wasTruncated || undefined });
02283|             }
02284|           });
02285|           res.on('error', (e: Error) => reject(e));
02286|         });
02287| 
02288|         req.on('error', (e: Error) => reject(new Error(`無法連線到 OpenAI-compatible server (${baseUrl})：${e.message}`)));
02289|         req.setTimeout(1200000, () => { req.destroy(new Error('OpenAI-compatible 呼叫逾時 (1200s)')); });
02290|         req.write(body); req.end();
02291|       };
02292| 
02293|       sendRequest(true);
02294|     } catch (e) { reject(e); }
02295|   });
02296| }

02298| export function getCopilotMultiplier(m: vscode.LanguageModelChat): string {
02299|   const id = m.id.toLowerCase();
02300|   const fam = (m.family || '').toLowerCase();
02301|   if (id === 'auto' || fam === 'auto') return '10% off';
02302|   if (id.includes('opus') || fam.includes('opus')) return '3x';
02303|   if (id.includes('mini') || fam.includes('mini')) return '0x';
02304|   if ((id.startsWith('gpt-4o') && !id.includes('mini')) || fam === 'gpt-4o' || id === 'gpt-4o') return '0x';
02305|   return '1x';
02306| }

02310|   if (i === 'auto') { return '10% off'; }
02311|   if (i.includes('opus')) { return '3x'; }
02312|   if (i.includes('mini')) { return '0x'; }
02313|   if (i.startsWith('gpt-4o') && !i.includes('mini')) { return '0x'; }
02314|   return '1x';

02332| async function copilotChatCallWithCts(
02333|   modelId: string,
02334|   messages: ChatMessage[],
02335|   tools: unknown[]
02336| ): Promise<ChatMessage> {
02337|   const lms = await vscode.lm.selectChatModels({ id: modelId });
02338|   const lm = lms[0];
02339|   if (!lm) { throw new Error(`Copilot 找不到模型: ${modelId}`); }

02341|   // 防禦性過濾：移除孤立的 tool_result（找不到對應 tool_use 的 tool 訊息），避免 Bedrock/Anthropic 400 錯誤
02342|   const sanitized = messages.filter((m, i) => {
02343|     if (m.role !== 'tool') { return true; }
02344|     // 往前找最近的 assistant 訊息，確認其 tool_calls 包含此 tool_call_id
02345|     let ai = i - 1;
02346|     while (ai >= 0 && messages[ai].role === 'tool') { ai--; }
02347|     return ai >= 0 && messages[ai].role === 'assistant' &&
02348|       (messages[ai].tool_calls ?? []).some(tc => (tc.id ?? tc.function.name) === m.tool_call_id);
02349|   });
02350| 
02351|   // 正確轉換每種 role 為 VS Code LM API 對應的 Part 型別
02352|   const vmMsgs: vscode.LanguageModelChatMessage[] = [];
02353|   for (const m of sanitized) {
02354|     if (m.role === 'system' || m.role === 'user') {
02355|       // system 沒有對應 role，以 User 訊息注入
02356|       vmMsgs.push(vscode.LanguageModelChatMessage.User(m.content ?? ''));
02357|     } else if (m.role === 'assistant') {
02358|       // 助手訊息可能同時含文字與工具呼叫（Claude Sonnet tool-use 格式）
02359|       const parts: (vscode.LanguageModelTextPart | vscode.LanguageModelToolCallPart)[] = [];
02360|       if (m.content) { parts.push(new vscode.LanguageModelTextPart(m.content)); }
02361|       for (const tc of m.tool_calls ?? []) {
02362|         const args = (typeof tc.function.arguments === 'string'
02363|           ? JSON.parse(tc.function.arguments)
02364|           : tc.function.arguments) as Record<string, unknown>;
02365|         parts.push(new vscode.LanguageModelToolCallPart(tc.id ?? tc.function.name, tc.function.name, args));
02366|       }
02367|       if (parts.length === 0) { parts.push(new vscode.LanguageModelTextPart('')); }
02368|       // 純文字時直接傳 string，避免不必要的 Part 包裝
02369|       vmMsgs.push(parts.length === 1 && parts[0] instanceof vscode.LanguageModelTextPart
02370|         ? vscode.LanguageModelChatMessage.Assistant(parts[0].value)
02371|         : vscode.LanguageModelChatMessage.Assistant(parts));
02372|     } else if (m.role === 'tool') {
02373|       // 工具執行結果：用 LanguageModelToolResultPart，讓 Claude Sonnet 正確對應 tool_call_id
02374|       vmMsgs.push(vscode.LanguageModelChatMessage.User([
02375|         new vscode.LanguageModelToolResultPart(
02376|           m.tool_call_id ?? '',
02377|           [new vscode.LanguageModelTextPart(m.content ?? '')]
02378|         )
02379|       ]));
02380|     }
02381|   }
02382| 
02383|   type OllamaTool = { function: { name: string; description: string; parameters: object } };
02384|   const vmTools = (tools as OllamaTool[]).map(t => ({
02385|     name: t.function.name,
02386|     description: t.function.description,
02387|     inputSchema: t.function.parameters,
02388|   }));
02389|   const cts = new vscode.CancellationTokenSource();
02390|   try {
02391|     const response = await lm.sendRequest(vmMsgs, { tools: vmTools }, cts.token);
02392|     let text = '';
02393|     const toolCalls: NonNullable<ChatMessage['tool_calls']> = [];
02394|     for await (const part of response.stream) {
02395|       if (part instanceof vscode.LanguageModelTextPart) {
02396|         text += part.value;
02397|       } else if (part instanceof vscode.LanguageModelToolCallPart) {
02398|         toolCalls.push({
02399|           id: part.callId,
02400|           function: {
02401|             name: part.name,
02402|             arguments: (typeof part.input === 'object' ? part.input : JSON.parse(String(part.input))) as Record<string, unknown>,
02403|           },
02404|         });
02405|       }
02406|     }
02407|     return { role: 'assistant', content: text || null, ...(toolCalls.length > 0 ? { tool_calls: toolCalls } : {}) };
02408|   } finally {
02409|     cts.dispose();
02410|   }
02411| }

02413| function supportsThinking(model: string): boolean {
02414|   // strip registry prefix (hf.co/user/) 後取純模型名稱
02415|   const m = model.toLowerCase().replace(/^hf\.co\/[^/]+\//i, '').replace(/^.*\//, '');
02416|   // 明確不支援 thinking 的關鍵字（coder / instruct 變體）
02417|   if (m.includes('coder') || m.includes('-instruct') || m.includes(':instruct')) { return false; }
02418|   // 明確支援 thinking 的模型
02419|   return m.startsWith('deepseek-r1') || m.startsWith('deepseek-r2') ||
02420|     m.startsWith('qwq') ||
02421|     // qwen3 只有 thinking 系列才支援，判斷方式：名稱不含 coder/instruct 且根模型就叫 qwen3
02422|     (m.startsWith('qwen3') && !m.includes('coder')) ||
02423|     m.includes(':thinking') || m.includes('-thinking') ||
02424|     m.includes('think') || m.includes('-r1') || m.includes(':r1') ||
02425|     m.includes('r1-') || /^r1[:.-]/.test(m);
02426| }

02428| export type ThinkingLevel = 'off' | 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'max';
02429| 
02430| export function getCurrentThinkingLevel(): ThinkingLevel {
02431|   const v = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw').get<string>('thinkingLevel', 'medium');
02432|   return (v === 'off' || v === 'low' || v === 'medium' || v === 'high' || v === 'max') ? v : 'medium';
02433| }
02434| 
02435| /**
02436|  * 依使用者「思考等級」設定 + 模型能力，回傳要塞進 Ollama request body 的 think 參數。
02437|  * - off: 強制 think:false（即使模型支援，也跳過思考，省 token & 加速）
02438|  * - low/medium: 傳對應字串（各模型 Jinja 模板通用）
02439|  * - high/max: 傳 true（布林），讓 Ollama 套用模型預設最大思考力，避免模板等級字串不相容
02440|  * - 模型不支援思考時，不加 think key（讓 Ollama 用模型預設）
02441|  */
02442| function getOllamaThinkParam(model: string): { think?: boolean | string } {
02443|   const level = getCurrentThinkingLevel();
02444|   if (level === 'off') { return { think: false }; }
02445|   if (!supportsThinking(model)) { return {}; }
02446|   // 'low'/'medium' are universally supported strings; 'high'/'max' fall back to boolean true
02447|   if (level === 'low' || level === 'medium') { return { think: level }; }
02448|   return { think: true };
02449| }
02450| 
02451| function ollamaGenerate(baseUrl: string, model: string, prompt: string): Promise<{ response: string; thinking?: string }> {
02452|   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
02453|     try {
02454|       const url = new URL('/api/generate', baseUrl);
02455|       const params: Record<string, unknown> = { model, prompt, stream: false };
02456|       Object.assign(params, getOllamaThinkParam(model));
02457|       const body = JSON.stringify(params);
02458|       const protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
02459| 
02460|       const options: http.RequestOptions = {
02461|         hostname: url.hostname,
02462|         port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434),
02463|         path: url.pathname,
02464|         method: 'POST',
02465|         headers: {
02466|           'Content-Type': 'application/json',
02467|           'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(body)
02468|         }
02469|       };
02470| 
02471|       const req = protocol.request(options, (res) => {
02472|         let data = '';
02473|         res.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => { data += chunk; });
02474|         res.on('end', () => {
02475|           if (res.statusCode !== 200) {
02476|             reject(new Error(`Ollama returned HTTP ${res.statusCode}: ${data.substring(0, 200)}`));
02477|             return;
02478|           }
02479|           try {
02480|             const json = JSON.parse(data);
02481|             let response: string = (json.response as string) ?? data;
02482|             let thinking: string | undefined = json.thinking as string | undefined;
02483|             // fallback: extract <think>...</think> if model embeds it in response
02484|             if (!thinking) {
02485|               const m = /^<think>([\s\S]*?)<\/think>\s*/i.exec(response);
02486|               if (m) { thinking = m[1]; response = response.slice(m[0].length); }
02487|             }
02488|             resolve({ response, thinking });
02489|           } catch {
02490|             resolve({ response: data });
02491|           }
02492|         });
02493|       });
02494|       req.on('error', (e) => reject(new Error(`無法連線到 Ollama (${baseUrl})：${e.message}`)));
02495|       req.write(body);
02496|       req.end();
02497|     } catch (e) { reject(e); }
02498|   });
02499| }
02500| 
02501| const OLLAMA_RETRY_ERRORS = ['ECONNRESET', 'ETIMEDOUT', 'ECONNREFUSED', 'socket hang up', '超時', 'timeout'];
02502| function isRetryableOllamaError(e: unknown): boolean {
02503|   const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
02504|   return OLLAMA_RETRY_ERRORS.some(s => msg.toLowerCase().includes(s.toLowerCase()));
02505| }
02506| 
02507| /**
02508|  * 從 LLM 回傳文字中抽出 extractMemories 的 JSON array。
02509|  * 容忍 ```json``` fence、前後解說文字、單一物件包裝等常見格式偏差。
02510|  */
02511| function parseExtractMemoriesJson(raw: string): import('./services/extractMemories/extractMemories').ExtractedMemoryItem[] {
02512|   if (!raw) return [];
02513|   const fence = raw.match(/```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)```/i);
02514|   let candidate = fence ? fence[1] : raw;
02515|   const arrayStart = candidate.indexOf('[');
02516|   const arrayEnd = candidate.lastIndexOf(']');
02517|   if (arrayStart >= 0 && arrayEnd > arrayStart) {
02518|     candidate = candidate.slice(arrayStart, arrayEnd + 1);
02519|   }
02520|   try {
02521|     const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(candidate);
02522|     if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return [];
02523|     const valid: import('./services/extractMemories/extractMemories').ExtractedMemoryItem[] = [];
02524|     for (const item of parsed) {
02525|       if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') continue;
02526|       const o = item as Record<string, unknown>;
02527|       const type = String(o.type ?? '');
02528|       if (type !== 'fact' && type !== 'preference' && type !== 'pattern' && type !== 'context') continue;
02529|       const title = String(o.title ?? '').trim();
02530|       const body = String(o.body ?? '').trim();
02531|       const slug = String(o.slug ?? '').trim();
02532|       const oneLineHook = String(o.oneLineHook ?? title).trim();
02533|       if (!title || !body) continue;
02534|       const tags = Array.isArray(o.tags) ? o.tags.map(t => String(t)).slice(0, 10) : undefined;
02535|       valid.push({ type, title, slug, body, oneLineHook, tags });
02536|     }
02537|     return valid;
02538|   } catch {
02539|     return [];
02540|   }
02541| }

02543| export async function ollamaGenerateStreamWithRetry(
02544|   baseUrl: string, model: string, prompt: string,
02545|   onResponseChunk: (chunk: string) => void,
02546|   onThinkChunk?: (chunk: string) => void,
02547|   onRetry?: (attempt: number, waitSec: number, err: string) => void,
02548|   maxRetries = 10,
02549|   retrySec = 60,
02550|   onStats?: (tokens: number, tps: number) => void
02551| ): Promise<string> {
02552|   for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
02553|     try {
02554|       return await ollamaGenerateStream(baseUrl, model, prompt, onResponseChunk, onThinkChunk, onStats);
02555|     } catch (e) {
02556|       if (attempt >= maxRetries || !isRetryableOllamaError(e)) throw e;
02557|       const errMsg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
02558|       if (onRetry) onRetry(attempt + 1, retrySec, errMsg);
02559|       await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, retrySec * 1000));
02560|     }
02561|   }
02562|   throw new Error('retry exhausted');
02563| }

02565| export function ollamaGenerateStream(
02566|   baseUrl: string, model: string, prompt: string,
02567|   onResponseChunk: (chunk: string) => void,
02568|   onThinkChunk?: (chunk: string) => void,
02569|   onStats?: (tokens: number, tps: number) => void,
02570|   images?: string[]
02571| ): Promise<string> {
02572|   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
02573|     try {
02574|       const url = new URL('/api/generate', baseUrl);
02575|       const params: Record<string, unknown> = { model, prompt, stream: true };
02576|       Object.assign(params, getOllamaThinkParam(model));
02577|       if (images && images.length > 0) { params.images = images; }
02578|       const body = JSON.stringify(params);
02579|       const protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
02580| 
02581|       const options: http.RequestOptions = {
02582|         hostname: url.hostname,
02583|         port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434),
02584|         path: url.pathname,
02585|         method: 'POST',
02586|         headers: {
02587|           'Content-Type': 'application/json',
02588|           'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(body)
02589|         }
02590|       };
02591| 
02592|       let lineBuffer = '';
02593|       let fullResponse = '';
02594|       let inThink = false;
02595| 
02596|       // Process a single response token, routing to think or response callbacks
02597|       const processToken = (token: string) => {
02598|         let rem = token;
02599|         while (rem.length > 0) {
02600|           if (!inThink) {
02601|             const ts = rem.indexOf('<think>');
02602|             if (ts === -1) { fullResponse += rem; onResponseChunk(rem); break; }
02603|             if (ts > 0) { const b = rem.slice(0, ts); fullResponse += b; onResponseChunk(b); }
02604|             inThink = true;
02605|             rem = rem.slice(ts + 7);
02606|           } else {
02607|             const te = rem.indexOf('</think>');
02608|             if (te === -1) { if (onThinkChunk) onThinkChunk(rem); break; }
02609|             const tc = rem.slice(0, te);
02610|             if (onThinkChunk && tc) onThinkChunk(tc);
02611|             inThink = false;
02612|             rem = rem.slice(te + 8);
02613|           }
02614|         }
02615|       };
02616| 
02617|       const req = protocol.request(options, (res) => {
02618|         if (res.statusCode && (res.statusCode < 200 || res.statusCode >= 300)) {
02619|           let errBody = '';
02620|           res.setEncoding('utf8');
02621|           res.on('data', (d: string) => { errBody += d; });
02622|           res.on('end', () => {
02623|             try { const j = JSON.parse(errBody); reject(new Error('Ollama 錯誤：' + (j.error ?? 'HTTP ' + res.statusCode))); }
02624|             catch { reject(new Error('Ollama HTTP ' + res.statusCode)); }
02625|           });
02626|           return;
02627|         }
02628|         res.setEncoding('utf8');
02629|         let streamError: string | null = null;
02630|         res.on('data', (data: string) => {
02631|           lineBuffer += data;
02632|           const lines = lineBuffer.split('\n');
02633|           lineBuffer = lines.pop() ?? '';
02634|           for (const line of lines) {
02635|             const t = line.trim();
02636|             if (!t) continue;
02637|             try {
02638|               const json = JSON.parse(t);
02639|               if (json.error) { const e = json.error; streamError = typeof e === 'string' ? e : ((e as Record<string, unknown>).message as string | undefined) ?? JSON.stringify(e); return; }
02640|               // dedicated thinking field (Ollama >= 0.9 with think models)
02641|               if (json.thinking && onThinkChunk) onThinkChunk(json.thinking as string);
02642|               if (json.response) processToken(json.response as string);
02643|               if (json.done && onStats && typeof json.eval_count === 'number' && typeof json.eval_duration === 'number' && json.eval_duration > 0) {
02644|                 onStats(json.eval_count as number, (json.eval_count as number) / ((json.eval_duration as number) / 1e9));
02645|               }
02646|             } catch { /* partial or non-JSON line */ }
02647|           }
02648|         });
02649|         res.on('end', () => {
02650|           if (streamError) { reject(new Error('Ollama 錯誤：' + streamError)); return; }
02651|           resolve(fullResponse);
02652|         });
02653|       });
02654|       req.on('error', (e) => reject(new Error(`無法連線到 Ollama (${baseUrl})：${e.message}`)));
02655|       req.write(body);
02656|       req.end();
02657|     } catch (e) { reject(e); }
02658|   });
02659| }

02661| export function ollamaChatStream(
02662|   baseUrl: string, model: string, messages: ChatMessage[],
02663|   onResponseChunk: (chunk: string) => void,

02691|             if (ts > 0) { const b = rem.slice(0, ts); fullResponse += b; onResponseChunk(b); }

02697|             if (onThinkChunk && tc) onThinkChunk(tc);

02700|         }

02702|

02704|         if (res.statusCode && (res.statusCode < 200 || res.statusCode >= 300)) {
02705|           let errBody = '';
02706|           res.setEncoding('utf8');
02707|           res.on('data', (d: string) => { errBody += d; });
02708|           res.on('end', () => {
02709|             try { const j = JSON.parse(errBody); reject(new Error('Ollama 錯誤：' + (j.error ?? 'HTTP ' + res.statusCode))); }
02710|             catch { reject(new Error('Ollama HTTP ' + res.statusCode)); }
02711|           });
02712|           return;
02713|         }
02714|         res.setEncoding('utf8');
02715|         let streamError: string | null = null;
02716|         res.on('data', (data: string) => {
02717|           lineBuffer += data;
02718|           const lines = lineBuffer.split('\n');
02719|           lineBuffer = lines.pop() ?? '';
02720|           for (const line of lines) {
02721|             const t = line.trim(); if (!t) continue;
02722|             try {

02724|               if (json.error) { const e = json.error; streamError = typeof e === 'string' ? e : ((e as Record<string, unknown>).message as string | undefined) ?? JSON.stringify(e); return; }
02725|               // /api/chat stream format: json.message.thinking + json.message.content
02726|               if (json.message?.thinking && onThinkChunk) onThinkChunk(json.message.thinking as string);
02727|               if (json.message?.content) processToken(json.message.content as string);
02728|               if (json.done && onStats && typeof json.eval_count === 'number' && typeof json.eval_duration === 'number' && json.eval_duration > 0) {
02729|                 onStats(json.eval_count as number, (json.eval_count as number) / ((json.eval_duration as number) / 1e9));
02730|               }
02731|             } catch { /* partial */ }
02732|           }
02733|         });
02734|         res.on('end', () => {
02735|           if (streamError) { reject(new Error('Ollama 錯誤：' + streamError)); return; }
02736|           resolve(fullResponse);
02737|         });
02738|       });
02739|       req.on('error', (e) => reject(new Error(`無法連線到 Ollama (${baseUrl})：${e.message}`)));
02740|       req.write(body); req.end();
02741|     } catch (e) { reject(e); }

02745| /** 讀取所有設定的 Ollama 伺服器 URL（amiAiClaw.urls）。 */
02746| export function getOllamaUrls(cfg: vscode.WorkspaceConfiguration): string[] {
02747|   const arr = (cfg.get<string[]>('urls') ?? []).filter((u: string) => u.trim());
02748|   if (arr.length > 0) {
02749|     // 重複出現的 URL 視為停用：只保留恰好出現一次的 URL
02750|     const count = new Map<string, number>();
02751|     for (const u of arr) count.set(u, (count.get(u) ?? 0) + 1);
02752|     const enabled = arr.filter(u => count.get(u) === 1);
02753|     return enabled.length > 0 ? enabled : [];
02754|   }
02755|   return [cfg.get<string>('url') ?? 'http://localhost:11434'];
02756| }
02757| 
02758| /** 解碼 Ollama model ID：多伺服器格式為 "http://host:port||modelname"，單伺服器為 "modelname"。
02759|  *  OpenAI-compatible 格式："openai::http://host:port||modelname" 或 "openai::modelname"（使用 fallbackUrls[0]）。
02760|  *  解碼後 model 保留 openai:: 前綴供後續路由判斷。
02761|  */
02762| export function decodeOllamaModel(modelId: string, fallbackUrls: string[]): { url: string; model: string } {
02763|   // OpenAI-compatible 格式：openai::http://host:port||modelname 或 openai::modelname
02764|   if (modelId.startsWith('openai::')) {
02765|     const inner = modelId.slice('openai::'.length);
02766|     const sep = inner.indexOf('||');
02767|     if (sep !== -1) return { url: inner.slice(0, sep), model: 'openai::' + inner.slice(sep + 2) };
02768|     return { url: fallbackUrls[0] ?? 'http://localhost:11434', model: 'openai::' + inner };
02769|   }
02770|   const sep = modelId.indexOf('||');
02771|   if (sep !== -1) return { url: modelId.slice(0, sep), model: modelId.slice(sep + 2) };
02772|   return { url: fallbackUrls[0] ?? 'http://localhost:11434', model: modelId };
02773| }
02774| 
02775| /** 編碼 Ollama model ID：多伺服器時加 URL 前綴，單伺服器時返回原始 model 名稱（向後相容）。 */

02781| /** 顯示標籤：多伺服器時加上 [hostname:port] 前綴。 */
02782| export function ollamaDisplayLabel(url: string, model: string, allUrls: string[]): string {
02783|   if (model.startsWith('openai::')) {
02784|     const inner = model.slice('openai::'.length);
02785|     const sep = inner.indexOf('||');
02786|     const sourceUrl = sep !== -1 ? inner.slice(0, sep) : url;
02787|     const modelName = sep !== -1 ? inner.slice(sep + 2) : inner;
02788|     if (allUrls.length <= 1 && sep === -1) { return modelName; }
02789|     try {
02790|       const u = new URL(sourceUrl);
02791|       return `[${u.hostname}:${u.port || (u.protocol === 'https:' ? '443' : '80')}] ${modelName}`;
02792|     } catch {
02793|       return modelName;
02794|     }
02795|   }
02796|   if (allUrls.length <= 1) return model;
02797|   try { const u = new URL(url); return `[${u.hostname}:${u.port || '11434'}] ${model}`; } catch { return model; }
02798| }

02833| function ollamaListModels(baseUrl: string): Promise<string[]> {
02834|   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {

02869|         openAiReq.end();

02873|       const req = protocol.request({
02874|         hostname: ollamaUrl.hostname,
02875|         port: ollamaUrl.port ? parseInt(ollamaUrl.port, 10) : (ollamaUrl.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434),
02876|         path: ollamaUrl.pathname,
02877|         method: 'GET',
02878|       }, (res) => {

02881|         res.on('end', () => {

02886|               resolve(names);
02887|             } catch {

02889|             }
02890|             return;
02891|           }

02893|         });
02894|       });

02896|         loadOpenAiModels();
02897|       });
02898|       req.setTimeout(8000, () => { req.destroy(new Error('ETIMEDOUT')); });

02904| function ollamaCheckConnection(baseUrl: string): Promise<{ ok: boolean; message: string }> {
02905|   return new Promise((resolve) => {
02906|     try {
02907|       const url = new URL('/api/tags', baseUrl);
02908|       const openAiUrl = new URL('/v1/models', baseUrl);
02909|       const protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
02910|       const options: http.RequestOptions = {
02911|         hostname: url.hostname,
02912|         port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434),
02913|         path: url.pathname,
02914|         method: 'GET',
02915|       };
02916|       let settled = false;
02917| 
02918|       const probeOpenAi = () => {
02919|         if (settled) { return; }
02920|         const p = openAiUrl.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
02921|         const req2 = p.request({
02922|           hostname: openAiUrl.hostname,
02923|           port: openAiUrl.port ? parseInt(openAiUrl.port, 10) : (openAiUrl.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 80),
02924|           path: openAiUrl.pathname,
02925|           method: 'GET',
02926|         }, (res2) => {
02927|           res2.resume();
02928|           if (!settled) {
02929|             settled = true;
02930|             resolve({ ok: res2.statusCode === 200, message: res2.statusCode === 200 ? 'OpenAI-compatible OK' : 'HTTP ' + res2.statusCode });
02931|           }
02932|         });
02933|         req2.on('error', (e: NodeJS.ErrnoException) => {
02934|           if (!settled) { settled = true; resolve({ ok: false, message: ollamaConnectError(openAiUrl.hostname, e).message }); }
02935|         });
02936|         req2.setTimeout(8000, () => {
02937|           if (!settled) { settled = true; req2.destroy(); resolve({ ok: false, message: '連線逾時 (8s)，請確認主機 ' + openAiUrl.hostname + ' 可達' }); }
02938|         });
02939|         req2.end();
02940|       };
02941| 
02942|       const req = protocol.request(options, (res) => {
02943|         res.resume();
02944|         if (!settled) {
02945|           if (res.statusCode === 200) {
02946|             settled = true;
02947|             resolve({ ok: true, message: 'OK' });
02948|           } else {
02949|             probeOpenAi();
02950|           }
02951|         }
02952|       });
02953|       req.on('error', (e: NodeJS.ErrnoException) => {
02954|         if (!settled) { probeOpenAi(); }
02955|       });
02956|       req.setTimeout(8000, () => {
02957|         if (!settled) { req.destroy(); probeOpenAi(); }
02958|       });
02959|       req.end();
02960|     } catch (e) { resolve({ ok: false, message: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) }); }
02961|   });
02962| }

02991| /** 拉取 Ollama 模型，透過 onProgress 回報進度字串。返回 Promise，完成或失敗時 resolve/reject。 */
02992| function ollamaPullModel(
02993|   baseUrl: string,
02994|   modelName: string,
02995|   onProgress: (status: string, percent: number | null) => void
02996| ): Promise<void> {
02997|   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
02998|     try {
02999|       const url = new URL('/api/pull', baseUrl);
03000|       const protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
03001|       const body = JSON.stringify({ model: modelName, stream: true });
03002|       const options: http.RequestOptions = {
03003|         hostname: url.hostname,
03004|         port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434),
03005|         path: url.pathname,
03006|         method: 'POST',
03007|         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(body) },
03008|       };
03009|       const req = protocol.request(options, (res) => {
03010|         if (res.statusCode !== 200) { res.resume(); reject(new Error('HTTP ' + res.statusCode)); return; }
03011|         let buf = '';
03012|         res.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => {
03013|           buf += chunk.toString();
03014|           const lines = buf.split('\n');
03015|           buf = lines.pop() ?? '';
03016|           for (const line of lines) {
03017|             if (!line.trim()) { continue; }
03018|             try {
03019|               const obj = JSON.parse(line) as { status?: string; completed?: number; total?: number; error?: string };
03020|               if (obj.error) { reject(new Error(obj.error)); return; }
03021|               const pct = (obj.total && obj.total > 0) ? Math.round((obj.completed ?? 0) / obj.total * 100) : null;
03022|               onProgress(obj.status ?? '', pct);
03023|             } catch { /* skip malformed JSON lines */ }
03024|           }
03025|         });
03026|         res.on('end', () => resolve());
03027|         res.on('error', (e: Error) => reject(e));
03028|       });
03029|       req.on('error', (e: NodeJS.ErrnoException) => reject(ollamaConnectError(url.hostname, e)));
03030|       req.write(body);
03031|       req.end();
03032|     } catch (e) { reject(e); }
03033|   });
03034| }
03035| 
03036| function ollamaConnectError(hostname: string, e: NodeJS.ErrnoException): Error {
03037|   if (e.code === 'ENOTFOUND') {
03038|     return new Error('主機名稱 \'' + hostname + '\' 無法解析（DNS），請確認 /etc/hosts 或 DNS 設定');
03039|   }
03040|   if (e.code === 'ECONNREFUSED') {
03041|     return new Error('連線被拒絕（port 未開放），請確認 Ollama 伺服器已啟動：' + hostname + ':11434');
03042|   }
03043|   if (e.code === 'ETIMEDOUT' || e.message === 'ETIMEDOUT') {
03044|     return new Error('連線逾時，請確認防火牆設定或主機 \'' + hostname + '\' 可達');
03045|   }
03046|   if (e.code === 'EHOSTUNREACH') {
03047|     return new Error('無法到達主機 \'' + hostname + '\'，請確認網路路由設定');
03048|   }
03049|   return new Error((e.code ? e.code + ': ' : '') + e.message);
03050| }

00004| /**
00005|  * 集中管理模型 ID 字首與 provider 對應。讓 QueryEngine / AgentExecutor 不再
00006|  * 散落 `modelId.startsWith('copilot::')` 之類的判斷。
00007|  *
00008|  * Provider ID 字首：
00009|  *   - `copilot::<copilotModelId>` — VS Code GitHub Copilot Language Model
00010|  *   - `copilot/<copilotModelId>`  — 舊版字首（從 setting 載入時自動正規化為 copilot::）
00011|  *   - `openai::<openaiModelName>` — OpenAI 相容端點（base url + key 由 setting 提供）
00012|  *   - 其他不帶字首                  — Ollama（base url 由 url setting 提供）
00013|  */
00014|

00016|

00018|   id: ProviderKind;
00019|   label: string;
00020| }
00021| 
00022| const COPILOT_PREFIX = 'copilot::';
00023| const COPILOT_LEGACY_PREFIX = 'copilot/';
00024| const OPENAI_PREFIX = 'openai::';
00025| 
00026| const KIND_LABEL: Record<ProviderKind, string> = {
00027|   copilot: 'Copilot',
00028|   openai: 'OpenAI Compatible',
00029|   ollama: 'Ollama',
00030| };
00031|

00033| export function normalizeProviderModelId(modelId: string): string {
00034|   return modelId.startsWith(COPILOT_LEGACY_PREFIX)
00035|     ? COPILOT_PREFIX + modelId.slice(COPILOT_LEGACY_PREFIX.length)
00036|     : modelId;
00037| }

00040|   if (modelId.startsWith(COPILOT_PREFIX) || modelId.startsWith(COPILOT_LEGACY_PREFIX)) { return 'copilot'; }
00041|   if (modelId.startsWith(OPENAI_PREFIX)) { return 'openai'; }
00042|   return 'ollama';
00043| }

00047| }

00051|   return { id: kind, label: getProviderLabel(kind) };
00052| }

00055| export function addProviderPrefix(kind: ProviderKind, modelName: string): string {
00056|   if (kind === 'copilot') { return COPILOT_PREFIX + modelName; }
00057|   if (kind === 'openai') { return OPENAI_PREFIX + modelName; }
00058|   return modelName;

00062| export function stripProviderPrefix(modelId: string): string {
00063|   if (modelId.startsWith(COPILOT_PREFIX)) { return modelId.slice(COPILOT_PREFIX.length); }
00064|   if (modelId.startsWith(COPILOT_LEGACY_PREFIX)) { return modelId.slice(COPILOT_LEGACY_PREFIX.length); }
00065|   if (modelId.startsWith(OPENAI_PREFIX)) { return modelId.slice(OPENAI_PREFIX.length); }
00066|   return modelId;
00067| }
00068|

00075| }
00076|

00026| /**
00027|  * HeartbeatService: A singleton service that provides a periodic pulse (5s).
00028|  * It allows modules to subscribe to tick events and broadcasts the heartbeat to the Webview UI.

00030| export class HeartbeatService implements vscode.Disposable {
00031|   private static _instance: HeartbeatService | undefined;

00063|         try {
00064|           callback();

00067|         }

00085|   public onTick(callback: () => void): vscode.Disposable {
00086|     this._subscribers.add(callback);
00087|     const disposable = { dispose: () => { this._subscribers.delete(callback); } };
00088|     this._disposables.push(disposable);
00089|     return disposable;
00090|   }
00091| 
00092|   /** Broadcasts a heartbeat signal (including agent status) to the provided Webview panel. */
00093|   public broadcastToWebview(panel: IWebviewPanel): void {
00094|     const info = this._agentInfo;
00095|     panel.webview.postMessage({
00096|       type: 'heartbeat-tick',
00097|       agentRunning: info.running,
00098|       agentStep: info.step,
00099|       agentModel: info.model,
00100|       shadowRunning: info.shadowRunning,
00101|       shadowCount: info.shadowCount,
00102|       lastActivity: info.lastActivity,
00103|       elapsedMs: info.running && info.startedAt ? Date.now() - info.startedAt : 0,
00104|     });
00105|   }
00106| 
00107|   /** Cleans up subscriptions but keeps the interval running (singleton, never truly stopped). */
00108|   public dispose(): void {
00109|     this._agentInfo = { ...DEFAULT_AGENT_INFO };
00110|     this._disposables.forEach((d) => d.dispose());
00111|     this._subscribers.clear();
00112|     this._disposables = [];
00113|   }
00114| }

00001| /**
00002|  * extractMemories
00003|  *
00004|  * 移植自 claude-code `services/extractMemories/extractMemories.ts` 的長期記憶抽取機制。
00005|  *
00006|  * 觸發時機：每次完整 query loop 結束（model 輸出無 tool call）後在背景執行。
00007|  * 行為：
00008|  *   1. 取得最近 N 則訊息作為來源
00009|  *   2. 讀 MEMORY.md 索引避免重複

00058| export function buildExtractPrompt(existingIndex: string): string {
00059|   const typeBlock = MEMORY_TYPE_VALUES
00060|     .map(t => `- **${t}** — ${MEMORY_TYPE_DESCRIPTIONS[t]}`)
00061|     .join('\n');
00062| 
00063|   const indexBlock = existingIndex.trim().length > 0
00064|     ? `\n\n## Existing memory index\n\n${existingIndex.trim()}\n\nCheck this list before creating new memories — prefer updating an existing entry over duplicating.`
00065|     : '';
00066| 
00067|   return `You are the memory extraction subagent for AmiClaw.
00068| 
00069| Analyze the conversation snippet provided and extract any durable, reusable knowledge worth remembering across future sessions.
00070| 
00071| ## Four memory types
00072| 
00073| ${typeBlock}
00074| 
00075| ## What to extract
00076| 
00077| - User preferences (language, format, tooling choices)
00078| - Project facts that won't change quickly (architecture, key files, conventions)
00079| - Workflow patterns that worked (commands, procedures, debugging steps)
00080| - Constraints / rules the user mentioned
00081| 
00082| ## What NOT to extract
00083| 
00084| - One-off task details (those belong in transcript)
00085| - Trivial facts the model can re-derive from code
00086| - Temporary error messages or single build logs
00087| - Anything containing secrets, tokens, passwords${indexBlock}
00088| 
00089| ## Output format
00090| 
00091| Reply with a single JSON array. Each element is one memory:
00092| 
00093| \`\`\`json

00097|     "title": "Short distinctive title (5-10 words)",
00098|     "slug": "kebab-case-filename-no-ext",
00099|     "tags": ["tag1", "tag2"],
00100|     "oneLineHook": "One-line hook < 150 chars for MEMORY.md index",
00101|     "body": "The actual memory body. Markdown. Bullet points preferred. Info-dense."
00102|   }
00103| ]
00104| \`\`\`
00105| 
00106| If nothing worth saving, reply with: \`[]\`
00107| Do not wrap in any other text — just the JSON array.`;
00108| }

00110| // ============================================================================
00111| // 主流程
00112| // ============================================================================
00113| 
00114| export interface ExtractMemoriesOptions {
00115|   caller?: MemoryExtractCaller;
00116|   ignoreInterval?: boolean;

00125| export async function executeExtractMemories(
00126|   shortTermText: string,
00127|   options: ExtractMemoriesOptions = {}
00128| ): Promise<ExtractMemoriesResult | null> {
00129|   if (!shortTermText || shortTermText.trim().length === 0) return null;
00130| 
00131|   const now = Date.now();
00132|   if (extractionInProgress) return null;
00133|   if (!options.ignoreInterval && now - lastExtractionTs < MIN_INTERVAL_MS) return null;
00134| 
00135|   extractionInProgress = true;
00136|   try {
00137|     const dir = await memdir.ensureMemoryDirExists();
00138|     const source = shortTermText.slice(0, MAX_SOURCE_CHARS);
00139| 
00140|     if (!options.caller) {
00141|       // Fallback：無 LLM 時直接寫快照（向後相容舊行為）
00142|       const name = `auto-${Date.now()}.md`;
00143|       const p = path.join(dir, name);
00144|       const body = `Source snapshot: ${new Date().toISOString()}\n\n${source}`;
00145|       const meta = {
00146|         type: 'context' as MemoryType,
00147|         title: 'Auto-extracted snapshot',
00148|         created: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
00149|       };
00150|       await fs.writeFile(p, stringifyMemoryFrontmatter(meta, body), 'utf8');
00151|       lastExtractionTs = Date.now();
00152|       return { written: [p], updatedIndex: false, fallback: true };
00153|     }
00154| 
00155|     const existingIndex = await memdir.readMemoryIndex();
00156|     const prompt = buildExtractPrompt(existingIndex);
00157| 
00158|     let items: ExtractedMemoryItem[] = [];
00159|     try {
00160|       items = await options.caller.extract({
00161|         sourceText: source,
00162|         existingIndex,
00163|         extractPrompt: prompt,
00164|       });
00165|     } catch {
00166|       lastExtractionTs = Date.now();
00167|       return { written: [], updatedIndex: false, fallback: true };
00168|     }
00169| 
00170|     if (items.length === 0) {
00171|       lastExtractionTs = Date.now();
00172|       return { written: [], updatedIndex: false, fallback: false };
00173|     }
00174| 
00175|     const written: string[] = [];
00176|     const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
00177|     for (const item of items) {
00178|       if (!MEMORY_TYPE_VALUES.includes(item.type)) continue;
00179|       const safeSlug = sanitizeSlug(item.slug || item.title);
00180|       if (!safeSlug) continue;
00181|       const filename = `${safeSlug}.md`;
00182|       const filepath = path.join(dir, filename);
00183| 
00184|       const existed = await fileExists(filepath);
00185|       const meta: {
00186|         type: MemoryType;
00187|         title: string;
00188|         tags?: string[];
00189|         created?: string;
00190|         updated: string;
00191|       } = {
00192|         type: item.type,
00193|         title: item.title.slice(0, 200),
00194|         tags: item.tags?.slice(0, 10),
00195|         created: existed ? undefined : today,
00196|         updated: today,
00197|       };
00198|       if (existed) {
00199|         try {
00200|           const old = await fs.readFile(filepath, 'utf8');
00201|           const created = old.match(/^created:\s*(.+)$/m)?.[1]?.trim();
00202|           if (created) meta.created = created;
00203|         } catch { /* ignore */ }
00204|       }
00205|       await fs.writeFile(
00206|         filepath,
00207|         stringifyMemoryFrontmatter(meta as Required<Pick<typeof meta, 'type' | 'title' | 'updated'>> & typeof meta, item.body.trim()),
00208|         'utf8'
00209|       );
00210|       written.push(filepath);
00211|     }
00212| 
00213|     const updatedIndex = await updateMemoryIndex(items, existingIndex);
00214|     lastExtractionTs = Date.now();
00215|     return { written, updatedIndex, fallback: false };
00216|   } catch {
00217|     return null;
00218|   } finally {
00219|     extractionInProgress = false;
00220|   }
00221| }

00227| function sanitizeSlug(s: string): string {
00228|   return s
00229|     .toLowerCase()
00230|     .replace(/[^\w\- ]+/g, '')
00231|     .trim()
00232|     .replace(/\s+/g, '-')
00233|     .replace(/-+/g, '-')
00234|     .slice(0, 80);
00235| }

00237| async function fileExists(p: string): Promise<boolean> {
00238|   try { await fs.stat(p); return true; } catch { return false; }
00239| }
00240| 
00241| async function updateMemoryIndex(
00242|   newItems: ExtractedMemoryItem[],
00243|   existingIndex: string
00244| ): Promise<boolean> {
00245|   try {
00246|     const existingLines = existingIndex.split('\n');
00247|     const seen = new Set<string>();
00248|     for (const line of existingLines) {
00249|       const m = line.match(/\[.*?\]\(([\w\-.]+)\)/);
00250|       if (m) seen.add(m[1]);
00251|     }
00252| 
00253|     const newLines: string[] = [];
00254|     for (const it of newItems) {
00255|       const slug = sanitizeSlug(it.slug || it.title);
00256|       if (!slug) continue;
00257|       const filename = `${slug}.md`;
00258|       if (seen.has(filename)) continue;
00259|       const hook = it.oneLineHook.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, MAX_INDEX_LINE_LENGTH);
00260|       newLines.push(`- [${it.title}](${filename}) — ${hook}`);
00261|     }
00262| 
00263|     if (newLines.length === 0) return false;
00264| 
00265|     const header = existingLines.length > 0 && existingIndex.trim().length > 0
00266|       ? existingIndex.trimEnd() + '\n'
00267|       : '# Memory Index\n\n';
00268|     let combined = header + newLines.join('\n') + '\n';
00269| 
00270|     const lines = combined.split('\n');
00271|     if (lines.length > MAX_INDEX_LINES) {
00272|       combined = lines.slice(0, MAX_INDEX_LINES).join('\n') + '\n';
00273|     }
00274|     await memdir.saveMemoryIndex(combined);
00275|     return true;
00276|   } catch {
00277|     return false;
00278|   }

00001| /**
00002|  * TeamCallModel — Team 主管模式的 provider-agnostic 模型呼叫。
00003|  *
00004|  * 抽出動機（見 ClaudeToDo.md §19.5 異味 7）：
00005|  *   _handleTeamManager 內有一個 ~90 行的 callModel local closure，內嵌
00006|  *   copilot / ollama(無工具) / ollama(有工具) 三條呼叫路徑，是 provider 抽象的內聯版本。
00007|  *
00008|  * 本模組以依賴注入（TeamCallModelDeps）解除對 this / _services / _callbacks / _teamCancel 的耦合，
00009|  * 行為與原 closure **完全一致**（含 200ms cancel 計時器、80ms think buffer、12 輪 tool loop）。
00010|  *
00011|  * 註：偵測仍用 `model.startsWith('copilot::')`（與原行為相同），未改用 ProviderRegistry，

00045| /**
00046|  * 呼叫單一模型並串流回覆，回傳完整文字。
00047|  *   - `copilot::family` → vscode.lm（含 cancel 計時器）
00048|  *   - ollama 無工具 → ollamaChatStream（think buffer 80ms flush）
00049|  *   - ollama 有工具 → ollamaChatCallStream 最多 12 輪 tool loop（executeTool）
00050|  */
00051| export async function teamCallModel(
00052|   deps: TeamCallModelDeps,
00053|   model: string,
00054|   persona: string,
00055|   hist: TeamHistoryEntry[],
00056|   userMsg: string,
00057|   onChunk: (c: string) => void,
00058|   onThink?: (c: string) => void,
00059|   tools: unknown[] = []
00060| ): Promise<string> {
00061|   if (model.startsWith('copilot::')) {
00062|     const family = model.slice('copilot::'.length);
00063|     const messages: vscode.LanguageModelChatMessage[] = [
00064|       vscode.LanguageModelChatMessage.User(persona),
00065|       ...hist.map(h => h.role === 'user'
00066|         ? vscode.LanguageModelChatMessage.User(h.content)
00067|         : vscode.LanguageModelChatMessage.Assistant(h.content)),
00068|       vscode.LanguageModelChatMessage.User(userMsg)
00069|     ];
00070|     const cts = new vscode.CancellationTokenSource();
00071|     const cancelTimer = setInterval(() => { if (deps.isCancelled()) { cts.cancel(); } }, 200);
00072|     try {
00073|       const [lm] = await vscode.lm.selectChatModels({ vendor: 'copilot', family });
00074|       if (!lm) { throw new Error(`Copilot 模型 "${family}" 不可用`); }
00075|       const resp = await lm.sendRequest(messages, {}, cts.token);
00076|       let full = '';
00077|       for await (const part of resp.stream) {
00078|         if (deps.isCancelled()) { break; }
00079|         if (part instanceof vscode.LanguageModelTextPart) { full += part.value; onChunk(part.value); }
00080|       }
00081|       return full;
00082|     } finally { clearInterval(cancelTimer); cts.dispose(); }
00083|   } else {
00084|     const { url, model: mName } = deps.decodeOllamaModel(model, deps.urls);
00085|     if (tools.length === 0) {
00086|       let thinkBuf = '';
00087|       let thinkTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
00088|       const flushThink = () => { if (thinkBuf && onThink) { onThink(thinkBuf); thinkBuf = ''; } thinkTimer = null; };
00089|       const messages: TeamManagerChatMessage[] = [
00090|         { role: 'system', content: persona },
00091|         ...hist.map(h => ({ role: h.role as 'user' | 'assistant', content: h.content })),
00092|         { role: 'user', content: userMsg }
00093|       ];
00094|       const text = await deps.ollamaChatStream(url, mName, messages, onChunk,
00095|         (tc) => { thinkBuf += tc; if (!thinkTimer) { thinkTimer = setTimeout(flushThink, 80); } },
00096|         (tokens) => { deps.trackUsage(mName, tokens); });
00097|       if (thinkTimer) { clearTimeout(thinkTimer); } flushThink();
00098|       return text;
00099|     } else {
00100|       const messages: TeamManagerChatMessage[] = [
00101|         { role: 'system', content: persona },
00102|         ...hist.map(h => ({ role: h.role as 'user' | 'assistant', content: h.content })),
00103|         { role: 'user', content: userMsg }
00104|       ];
00105|       let finalText = '';
00106|       for (let _tLoop = 0; _tLoop < 12 && !deps.isCancelled(); _tLoop++) {
00107|         const assistantMsg = await deps.ollamaChatCallStream(url, mName, messages, tools,
00108|           (tc) => { if (onThink && !deps.isCancelled()) onThink(tc); },
00109|           (tc) => { if (!deps.isCancelled()) { onChunk(tc); finalText += tc; } },
00110|           (tokens) => { deps.trackUsage(mName, tokens); });
00111|         messages.push(assistantMsg as TeamManagerChatMessage);
00112|         if (!assistantMsg.tool_calls || assistantMsg.tool_calls.length === 0) { break; }
00113|         for (const tc of assistantMsg.tool_calls) {
00114|           const fn = tc.function;
00115|           const args = typeof fn.arguments === 'string' ? (() => { try { return JSON.parse(fn.arguments as string); } catch { return {}; } })() : fn.arguments as Record<string, unknown>;
00116|           onChunk(`\n🔧 ${fn.name}(${JSON.stringify(args).slice(0, 80)})\n`);
00117|           let toolResult: string;
00118|           try { toolResult = await deps.executeTool(fn.name, args); }
00119|           catch (e) { toolResult = `工具錯誤: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`; }
00120|           onChunk(`→ ${toolResult.slice(0, 200)}${toolResult.length > 200 ? '…' : ''}\n`);
00121|           messages.push({ role: 'tool', content: toolResult, tool_call_id: tc.id ?? fn.name });
00122|         }
00123|       }
00124|       return finalText;
00125|     }
00126|   }
00127| }

00001| /**

00005|  *   discussion / agent / manager 三個 mode 各有一份「讀既有 → 加分隔線 → 寫」的持久化邏輯。
00006|  *   三者 entry 格式與 UI 訊息不同（留各 mode），唯一可安全共用的是時間戳記 + 附加寫入。
00007|  *
00008|  * ⚠️ 既有行為差異已忠實保留：
00009|  *   - discussion / manager 使用 **掃描時的記憶體快取**（傳入 existingContent，空字串=新檔不加分隔線）。
00010|  *   - agent 於寫入當下 **重新讀檔**（省略 existingContent）：讀到就加分隔線（即使內容為空），讀不到則為空。
00011|  */
00012| import * as vscode from 'vscode';
00013| 
00014| /** teamscontext.md 紀錄時間戳記（`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`）。 */
00015| export function teamContextTimestamp(): string {
00016|   return new Date().toISOString().replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 19);
00017| }
00018| 
00019| /**
00020|  * 把一筆 entry 附加到 teamscontext.md（既有內容 + 分隔線 + 新 entry）。
00021|  *
00022|  * @param ctxPath teamscontext.md 的絕對路徑
00023|  * @param entryMarkdown 已組裝好的 entry（含標題與內文，格式由呼叫端負責）
00024|  * @param existingContent 既有內容快取；傳入時：非空才加分隔線（discussion / manager）。
00025|  *   省略（undefined）時改從磁碟重新讀取（agent）：讀到就加分隔線，讀不到（新檔）則為空。
00026|  */
00027| export async function appendTeamContext(
00028|   ctxPath: string,
00029|   entryMarkdown: string,
00030|   existingContent?: string
00031| ): Promise<void> {
00032|   let prefix: string;
00033|   if (existingContent !== undefined) {
00034|     prefix = existingContent ? `${existingContent}\n\n---\n\n` : '';
00035|   } else {
00036|     try {
00037|       prefix = Buffer.from(await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(ctxPath))).toString('utf-8').trim() + '\n\n---\n\n';
00038|     } catch {
00039|       prefix = '';
00040|     }
00041|   }
00042|   await vscode.workspace.fs.writeFile(vscode.Uri.file(ctxPath), Buffer.from(prefix + entryMarkdown, 'utf-8'));
00043| }

00482|   public static pickThinkingModel(models: string[]): string {
00483|     if (models.length === 0) { return ''; }
00484|     const RANK = [/deepseek-r1/i, /qwq/i, /r1/i, /thinking/i, /reasoner/i, /reflect/i];
00485|     let best = models[0]; let bestScore = -1;
00486|     for (const m of models) {
00487|       const score = RANK.findIndex(r => r.test(m));
00488|       const s = score === -1 ? RANK.length : score;
00489|       if (bestScore === -1 || s < bestScore) { bestScore = s; best = m; }
00490|     }
00491|     return best;
00492|   }

00494|   public static buildRoleSystemNote(role: string): string {
00495|     const configured = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw').get<Array<{key:string;systemPrompt:string}>>('teamRoles', []);
00496|     const found = configured.find(r => r.key === role);
00497|     if (found?.systemPrompt) return found.systemPrompt;
00498|     switch (role) {
00499|       case 'planner':   return '你的職責是【規劃者】：分析需求、制定解題架構、將任務拆分為有序步驟、確保整體方向正確。';
00500|       case 'developer': return '你的職責是【開發者】：撰寫程式碼、實作功能、提供具體技術解決方案、確保程式邏輯正確。';
00501|       case 'reviewer':  return '你的職責是【評審員】：審查方案與程式碼品質、找出潛在問題與改進空間、以批判視角提高整體品質。';
00502|       case 'tester':    return '你的職責是【測試員】：思考邊界情況、撰寫測試案例、找出可能的錯誤與漏洞、確保功能穩定性。';
00503|       case 'writer':    return '你的職責是【撰寫者】：清晰解釋技術概念、撰寫說明文件、確保溝通明確易懂。';
