00508|   private async _handleTeamDiscussion(prompt: string, allModels: string[], maxRounds: number, roles?: string[]): Promise<void> {
00509|     const cfg = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw');
00510|     const urls = this._services.getOllamaUrls(cfg);
00511|     const COLORS = TEAM_COLORS;
00512|     const getDisplay = (m: string) => getWorkerDisplay(m, urls, (id, u) => this._services.decodeOllamaModel(id, u));
00513|     const _rolesCfg = cfg.get<Array<{key:string;label:string;emoji:string}>>('teamRoles', []);
00514|     const _rolePrefix = (idx: number) => { const k = roles?.[idx]; const r = k ? _rolesCfg.find(c => c.key === k) : undefined; return r ? `${r.emoji} ${r.label} ` : ''; };
00515| 
00516|     // 決定主管：優先 'manager' 角色 → Copilot 模型 → index 0
00517|     const managerIdx = (() => {
00518|       const mgrRoleIdx = roles ? roles.findIndex(r => r === 'manager') : -1;
00519|       if (mgrRoleIdx >= 0 && mgrRoleIdx < allModels.length) return mgrRoleIdx;
00520|       const cpIdx = allModels.findIndex(m => m.startsWith('copilot::'));
00521|       if (cpIdx >= 0) return cpIdx;
00522|       return 0;
00523|     })();
00524|     const managerModel = allModels[managerIdx];
00525|     const workerModels = allModels.filter((_, i) => i !== managerIdx);
00526|     // 若只有一個模型，它同時擔任主管與唯一 worker
00527|     const effectiveWorkers = workerModels.length > 0 ? workerModels : allModels;
00528|     const managerDisplay = _rolePrefix(managerIdx) + getDisplay(managerModel);
00529| 
00530|     this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'debateStart',
00531|       labelA: getDisplay(allModels[0]), labelB: getDisplay(allModels[1] ?? allModels[0]),
00532|       labelJ: allModels[2] ? getDisplay(allModels[2]) : null,
00533|       colorA: COLORS[0], colorB: COLORS[1], colorJ: COLORS[2],
00534|       gameType: 'team-discussion',
00535|       speakerLabels: Object.fromEntries(allModels.map((m,i) => [String(i), getDisplay(m)])),
00536|       speakerColors: Object.fromEntries(allModels.map((m,i) => [String(i), COLORS[i % COLORS.length]])) });
00537|     this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'teamSynthChunk', chunk: '🔍 正在掃描工作區原始碼與 teamscontext.md…\n' });

00944|   private async _handleTeamCompare(prompt: string, allModels: string[]): Promise<void> {
00945|     if (allModels.length === 0) {

01590|   private async copilotStream(
01591|     modelFamily: string,
01592|     prompt: string,
01593|     onChunk: (chunk: string) => void
01594|   ): Promise<string> {
01595|     const [model] = await vscode.lm.selectChatModels({ vendor: 'copilot', family: modelFamily });

01599|     try {
01600|       const response = await model.sendRequest(
01601|         [vscode.LanguageModelChatMessage.User(prompt)],
01602|         {},
01603|         cts.token
01604|       );
01605|       let fullText = '';
01606|       for await (const part of response.stream) {
01607|         if (this._teamCancel) { break; }
01608|         if (part instanceof vscode.LanguageModelTextPart) {
01609|           fullText += part.value;
01610|           onChunk(part.value);
01611|         }
01612|       }
01613|       return fullText;
01614|     } finally {
01615|       clearInterval(cancelInterval);
01616|       cts.dispose();
01617|     }
01618|   }

00001| /**
00002|  * TeamWorkspaceScanner — Team 模式的工作區掃描 + 批次化 + 對話歷史建構。
00003|  *
00004|  * 抽出動機（見 ClaudeToDo.md §19.5 異味 3）：
00005|  *   `_handleTeamDiscussion` 與 `_handleTeamManager` 各有一份 **逐字重複 ~60 行** 的
00006|  *   「掃描工作區 → 讀 teamscontext.md → 過濾 → 80KB 批次 → 組裝多輪 init history」邏輯，
00007|  *   僅變數前綴（_disc / _mgr）與結尾用語（請提出問題／任務）不同。
00008|  *
00009|  * 為何不復用 context/WorkspaceDigest.ts：
00010|  *   WorkspaceDigest 產出的是「單一 markdown digest」供 system prompt 注入，
00011|  *   且其 full 模式只回傳「請呼叫 read_workspace」指令、不真的倒程式碼；
00012|  *   本掃描器則需要把 **整個 codebase 分批塞進多輪對話歷史**（TeamHistoryEntry[]），
00013|  *   兩者輸出形狀與 glob/skip 集合都不同，強行共用會改變既有行為。
00014|  *
00015|  * 本模組為純函式（僅依賴 vscode / path），不持有任何 panel/this 狀態；
00016|  * UI 進度訊息（teamSynthChunk vs teamOrchestrator*）刻意留在各 mode 由呼叫端發送。
00017|  */
00018| import * as path from 'path';
00019| import * as vscode from 'vscode';
00020| import { TeamHistoryEntry } from './TeamShared';
00021| 
00022| /** 即使路徑匹配也跳過的二進位 / 非原始碼副檔名。 */
00023| const SKIP_EXT = new Set([
00024|   '.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.gif', '.ico', '.svg', '.woff', '.woff2', '.ttf', '.eot',
00025|   '.vsix', '.zip', '.tar', '.gz', '.exe', '.dll', '.pdf', '.db', '.sqlite', '.lock',
00026| ]);
00027| 
00028| /** findFiles 排除的目錄 glob。 */
00029| const SKIP_DIRS = '{**/node_modules/**,**/.git/**,**/out/**,**/dist/**,**/build/**,**/.vscode-test/**,**/coverage/**}';
00030| 
00031| /** findFiles 上限。 */
00032| const FIND_LIMIT = 2000;
00033| 
00034| /** 單一批次的 byte 上限（超過則切下一批）。 */
00035| const BATCH_SIZE = 80000;
00036| 
00037| /** 單一檔案納入的字元上限（超過則截斷）。 */
00038| const MAX_FILE = 15000;
00039| 
00040| /** 工作區掃描結果。 */
00041| export interface TeamWorkspaceScan {
00042|   /** 工作區根目錄（第一個 folder，或 process.cwd()）。 */
00043|   wsRoot: string;
00044|   /** teamscontext.md 的絕對路徑。 */
00045|   teamsCtxPath: string;
00046|   /** teamscontext.md 現有內容（trim 後；不存在則為空字串）。 */
00047|   teamsCtxContent: string;
00048|   /** 過濾後的相對路徑清單（POSIX 斜線）。 */
00049|   allRelPaths: string[];
00050|   /** 80KB 批次後的原始碼區塊（每批是多個 `### rel\n```...```` 字串）。 */
00051|   batches: string[][];
00052|   /** 實際納入的原始碼總字元數。 */
00053|   totalBytes: number;
00054|   /** 實際讀入的檔案數（= 所有批次的檔案數總和）。 */
00055|   readCount: number;
00056|   /** 共用基礎 context（工作區路徑 + teamscontext + 檔案清單）。 */
00057|   baseCtx: string;
00058| }

00060| /**
00061|  * 掃描工作區：讀 teamscontext.md、列出所有原始碼檔案、逐檔讀入並切成 80KB 批次。
00062|  * 純資料產出，不發送任何 UI 訊息（由呼叫端依模式自行發送進度）。
00063|  */
00064| export async function scanWorkspaceForTeam(): Promise<TeamWorkspaceScan> {
00065|   const wsFolders = vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders ?? [];
00066|   const wsRoot = wsFolders.length > 0 ? wsFolders[0].uri.fsPath : process.cwd();
00067| 
00068|   const teamsCtxPath = path.join(wsRoot, 'teamscontext.md');
00069|   let teamsCtxContent = '';
00070|   try {
00071|     const tcBytes = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(teamsCtxPath));
00072|     teamsCtxContent = Buffer.from(tcBytes).toString('utf-8').trim();
00073|   } catch { /* 不存在則略過 */ }
00074| 
00075|   const allUris = await vscode.workspace.findFiles('**/*', SKIP_DIRS, FIND_LIMIT);
00076|   allUris.sort((a, b) => a.fsPath.localeCompare(b.fsPath));
00077|   const filteredUris = allUris.filter(uri => !SKIP_EXT.has(path.extname(uri.fsPath).toLowerCase()));
00078|   const allRelPaths = filteredUris.map(uri => path.relative(wsRoot, uri.fsPath).replace(/\\/g, '/'));
00079|   const fileListBlock = `【工作區檔案清單（${allRelPaths.length} 個）】\n${allRelPaths.map(p => `  - ${p}`).join('\n')}`;
00080| 
00081|   const batches: string[][] = [];
00082|   let curBatch: string[] = [];
00083|   let curBatchBytes = 0;
00084|   let totalBytes = 0;
00085|   for (const uri of filteredUris) {
00086|     const rel = path.relative(wsRoot, uri.fsPath).replace(/\\/g, '/');
00087|     try {
00088|       const bytes = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(uri);
00089|       let text = Buffer.from(bytes).toString('utf-8');
00090|       if (text.length > MAX_FILE) { text = text.slice(0, MAX_FILE) + `\n...（${rel} 已截斷，僅顯示前段）`; }
00091|       const entry = `### ${rel}\n\`\`\`\n${text}\n\`\`\``;
00092|       if (curBatchBytes + entry.length > BATCH_SIZE && curBatch.length > 0) {
00093|         batches.push(curBatch);
00094|         curBatch = []; curBatchBytes = 0;
00095|       }
00096|       curBatch.push(entry);
00097|       curBatchBytes += entry.length;
00098|       totalBytes += text.length;
00099|     } catch { /* 略過無法讀取的二進位檔 */ }
00100|   }
00101|   if (curBatch.length > 0) batches.push(curBatch);
00102|   const readCount = batches.reduce((s, b) => s + b.length, 0);
00103| 
00104|   const baseCtx = [
00105|     `【工作區路徑】${wsRoot}`,
00106|     teamsCtxContent ? `【teamscontext.md — 先前討論紀錄】\n${teamsCtxContent}` : '',
00107|     fileListBlock,
00108|   ].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n');
00109| 
00110|   return { wsRoot, teamsCtxPath, teamsCtxContent, allRelPaths, batches, totalBytes, readCount, baseCtx };
00111| }
00112| 
00113| /**
00114|  * 把掃描結果組裝成「逐批餵碼」的多輪對話歷史。
00115|  *   - 有批次：user(baseCtx+第1批) → assistant(已讀第N批) → user(第N+1批) → … → assistant(已讀完。{finalPrompt})
00116|  *   - 無批次且提供 emptyFallbackAssistant：user(baseCtx) → assistant(emptyFallbackAssistant)
00117|  *   - 無批次且未提供 fallback：回傳空陣列（manager 模式行為）
00118|  *
00119|  * @param finalPrompt 讀完後 assistant 收尾語（discussion="請提出問題。" / manager="請提出任務。"）
00120|  * @param emptyFallbackAssistant 無批次時的 assistant 回覆（僅 discussion 提供）
00121|  */
00122| export function buildBatchedInitHistory(
00123|   scan: TeamWorkspaceScan,
00124|   finalPrompt: string,
00125|   emptyFallbackAssistant?: string
00126| ): TeamHistoryEntry[] {
00127|   const { baseCtx, batches, allRelPaths, totalBytes } = scan;
00128|   const hist: TeamHistoryEntry[] = [];
00129|   if (batches.length > 0) {
00130|     hist.push({ role: 'user', content:
00131|       `${baseCtx}\n\n【第 1/${batches.length} 批原始碼（${batches[0].length} 個檔案）】\n\n${batches[0].join('\n\n')}`
00132|     });
00133|     for (let bi = 1; bi < batches.length; bi++) {
00134|       hist.push({ role: 'assistant', content: `已閱讀第 ${bi}/${batches.length} 批（${batches[bi - 1].length} 個檔案），繼續接收下一批。` });
00135|       hist.push({ role: 'user', content:
00136|         `【第 ${bi + 1}/${batches.length} 批原始碼（${batches[bi].length} 個檔案）】\n\n${batches[bi].join('\n\n')}`
00137|       });
00138|     }
00139|     hist.push({ role: 'assistant', content: `已完整閱讀全部 ${batches.length} 批共 ${allRelPaths.length} 個檔案（${Math.round(totalBytes / 1024)}KB）。${finalPrompt}` });
00140|   } else if (emptyFallbackAssistant !== undefined) {
00141|     hist.push({ role: 'user', content: baseCtx });
00142|     hist.push({ role: 'assistant', content: emptyFallbackAssistant });
00143|   }
00144|   return hist;
00145| }
00146| 
00147| /**
00148|  * 把掃描結果攤平成單一字串（供 Copilot 無多輪歷史的路徑使用）。
00149|  */

00198|       create_dir:          [{ key: 'path', op: 'write' }],
00199|     };
00200|     for (const { key, op } of toolRecords[toolName] ?? []) {
00201|       const rawPath = args[key] as string | undefined;
00202|       if (!rawPath) continue;

00204|       this.recordChange({ original: originalPath, shadow: this.mapToShadow(originalPath), op });

00039|     if (this._entries.length > ToolAuditLog.RUNTIME_MAX) { this._entries.shift(); }

00036| 
00037| // ─── Unified Diff helper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
00038| function computeUnifiedDiff(
00039|   aLines: string[], bLines: string[],
00040|   fileA: string, fileB: string,
00041|   contextLines: number
00042| ): string {
00043|   // 簡易 LCS-based unified diff
00044|   const m = aLines.length, n = bLines.length;
00045|   // DP LCS table (只存長度，用回溯)
00046|   const dp: number[][] = Array.from({ length: m + 1 }, () => new Array(n + 1).fill(0));
00047|   for (let i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
00048|     for (let j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
00049|       if (aLines[i - 1] === bLines[j - 1]) { dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] + 1; }
00050|       else { dp[i][j] = Math.max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1]); }
00051|     }
00052|   }
00053|   // Backtrack to get edit script
00054|   type Edit = { op: ' ' | '-' | '+'; line: string; ai: number; bi: number };
00055|   const edits: Edit[] = [];
00056|   let i = m, j = n;
00057|   while (i > 0 || j > 0) {
00058|     if (i > 0 && j > 0 && aLines[i-1] === bLines[j-1]) {
00059|       edits.push({ op: ' ', line: aLines[i-1], ai: i, bi: j }); i--; j--;
00060|     } else if (j > 0 && (i === 0 || dp[i][j-1] >= dp[i-1][j])) {
00061|       edits.push({ op: '+', line: bLines[j-1], ai: i, bi: j }); j--;
00062|     } else {
00063|       edits.push({ op: '-', line: aLines[i-1], ai: i, bi: j }); i--;
00064|     }
00065|   }
00066|   edits.reverse();
00067|   // Build hunks
00068|   const changed = new Set(edits.map((e, idx) => e.op !== ' ' ? idx : -1).filter(x => x >= 0));
00069|   if (changed.size === 0) { return ''; }
00070|   const inHunk = new Set<number>();
00071|   for (const c of changed) {
00072|     for (let k = Math.max(0, c - contextLines); k <= Math.min(edits.length - 1, c + contextLines); k++) {
00073|       inHunk.add(k);
00074|     }
00075|   }
00076|   const lines: string[] = [`--- ${fileA}`, `+++ ${fileB}`];
00077|   let inBlock = false, aStart = 0, bStart = 0, aCount = 0, bCount = 0;
00078|   const hunkLines: string[] = [];
00079|   const flushHunk = () => {
00080|     if (hunkLines.length) {
00081|       lines.push(`@@ -${aStart},${aCount} +${bStart},${bCount} @@`);
00082|       lines.push(...hunkLines);
00083|       hunkLines.length = 0; inBlock = false;
00084|     }
00085|   };
00086|   let aIdx = 1, bIdx = 1;
00087|   for (let k = 0; k < edits.length; k++) {
00088|     const e = edits[k];
00089|     if (inHunk.has(k)) {
00090|       if (!inBlock) {
00091|         flushHunk();
00092|         aStart = e.op === '+' ? aIdx : aIdx;
00093|         bStart = e.op === '-' ? bIdx : bIdx;
00094|         aCount = 0; bCount = 0; inBlock = true;
00095|       }
00096|       hunkLines.push(e.op + e.line);
00097|       if (e.op !== '+') { aCount++; aIdx++; }
00098|       if (e.op !== '-') { bCount++; bIdx++; }
00099|     } else {
00100|       if (inBlock) { flushHunk(); }
00101|       if (e.op !== '+') { aIdx++; }
00102|       if (e.op !== '-') { bIdx++; }
00103|     }
00104|   }
00105|   flushHunk();
00106|   return lines.join('\n');
00107| }
00108| 
00109| // ─── Diff stats helper ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
00110| function computeDiffStatsAndPatch(
00111|   before: string, after: string, filePath: string, maxPatchBytes = 6000
00112| ): { linesAdded: number; linesRemoved: number; patch: string } {
00113|   const aLines = before.split(/\r?\n/);
00114|   const bLines = after.split(/\r?\n/);
00115|   // 大檔案略過全 diff（LCS O(m*n) 太慢），只回傳行數差
00116|   if (aLines.length + bLines.length > 4000) {
00117|     return { linesAdded: Math.max(0, bLines.length - aLines.length), linesRemoved: Math.max(0, aLines.length - bLines.length), patch: '' };
00118|   }
00119|   const baseName = path.basename(filePath);
00120|   let patch = computeUnifiedDiff(aLines, bLines, baseName, baseName, 3);
00121|   if (patch.length > maxPatchBytes) { patch = patch.slice(0, maxPatchBytes) + '\n…（截斷）'; }
00122|   const pLines = patch.split('\n');
00123|   const linesAdded = pLines.filter(l => l.startsWith('+') && !l.startsWith('+++')).length;
00124|   const linesRemoved = pLines.filter(l => l.startsWith('-') && !l.startsWith('---')).length;
00125|   return { linesAdded, linesRemoved, patch };
00126| }

00270|   /** 遞迴收集目錄下的影像檔（jpg/jpeg/png/webp/bmp/gif），回傳絕對路徑陣列（達 limit 即停止）。 */
00271|   private static collectImageFiles(rootDir: string, limit: number): string[] {
00272|     const exts = new Set(['.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.webp', '.bmp', '.gif']);
00273|     const out: string[] = [];
00274|     const walk = (dir: string) => {
00275|       if (out.length >= limit) { return; }
00276|       let entries: import('fs').Dirent[];
00277|       try { entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }); } catch { return; }
00278|       for (const e of entries) {
00279|         if (out.length >= limit) { return; }
00280|         const full = path.join(dir, e.name);
00281|         if (e.isDirectory()) {
00282|           if (e.name.startsWith('.') || e.name === 'node_modules') { continue; }
00283|           walk(full);
00284|         } else if (exts.has(path.extname(e.name).toLowerCase())) {
00285|           out.push(full);
00286|         }
00287|       }
00288|     };
00289|     walk(rootDir);
00290|     return out;
00291|   }

00303|   /** 呼叫 Ollama 視覺模型 /api/chat（非串流），傳入多張 base64 影像，回傳 message.content 文字。 */
00304|   private static ollamaVisionChat(
00305|     baseUrl: string, model: string, prompt: string, imagesB64: string[], timeoutMs: number,
00306|   ): Promise<string> {
00307|     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
00308|       let url: URL;
00309|       try { url = new URL('/api/chat', baseUrl); } catch { reject(new Error(`Ollama URL 無效: ${baseUrl}`)); return; }
00310|       const protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
00311|       const buf = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({
00312|         model,
00313|         messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt, images: imagesB64 }],
00314|         stream: false,
00315|         options: { temperature: 0 },
00316|       }), 'utf8');
00317|       const options: http.RequestOptions = {
00318|         hostname: url.hostname,
00319|         port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434),
00320|         path: url.pathname,
00321|         method: 'POST',
00322|         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Length': buf.length },
00323|       };
00324|       const req = protocol.request(options, (res) => {
00325|         let data = '';
00326|         res.setEncoding('utf8');
00327|         res.on('data', (d: string) => { data += d; });
00328|         res.on('end', () => {
00329|           try {
00330|             const j = JSON.parse(data) as { message?: { content?: string }; error?: string };
00331|             if (j.error) { reject(new Error(j.error)); return; }
00332|             resolve((j.message?.content ?? '').trim());
00333|           } catch { reject(new Error(`回應解析失敗: ${data.slice(0, 200)}`)); }
00334|         });
00335|       });
00336|       req.on('error', (e: Error) => reject(e));
00337|       req.setTimeout(timeoutMs, () => { req.destroy(); reject(new Error(`Ollama 視覺推論逾時 (${timeoutMs}ms)`)); });
00338|       req.write(buf);
00339|       req.end();
00340|     });
00341|   }

00343|   /** 從模型回應中擷取第一個 JSON 物件並解析（容忍 markdown code fence 與前後雜訊）。 */
00344|   private static extractFirstJson(text: string): Record<string, unknown> | null {
00345|     if (!text) { return null; }
00346|     const fenced = text.match(/```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)```/i);
00347|     const candidate = fenced ? fenced[1] : text;
00348|     const start = candidate.indexOf('{');
00349|     const end = candidate.lastIndexOf('}');
00350|     if (start < 0 || end <= start) { return null; }
00351|     try { return JSON.parse(candidate.slice(start, end + 1)) as Record<string, unknown>; } catch { return null; }
00352|   }

00354|   /** 從 atlassian.atlascode 擷取 Jira auth (bearer token + baseApiUrl)。
00355|    *  只支援 Windows，使用 Python (內建模組) + Node.js crypto 解密。
00356|    *  cache：到期前 5 分鐘更新。
00357|    */
00358|   private async getAtlascodeJiraAuth(): Promise<{ baseApiUrl: string; accessToken: string } | null> {
00359|     if (this._atlasJiraCred && this._atlasJiraCred.expiry > Date.now() + 300_000) {
00360|       return this._atlasJiraCred;
00361|     }
00362|     try {
00363|       const appData = process.env['APPDATA'];
00364|       if (!appData) { return null; }
00365|       const localStatePath = path.join(appData, 'Code', 'Local State');
00366|       if (!fs.existsSync(localStatePath)) { return null; }
00367| 
00368|       // Python 腳本：使用內建模組讀 SQLite + DPAPI 解密 master key，輸出 JSON
00369|       // 路徑用 JSON.stringify 嵌入：Python 解析 "C:\\Users\\..." = C:\Users\... (正確)
00370|       const pyScript = [
00371|         'import sqlite3,json,ctypes,base64,os,sys',
00372|         `app=${JSON.stringify(appData)}`,
00373|         `db=os.path.join(app,'Code','User','globalStorage','state.vscdb')`,
00374|         `ls_path=os.path.join(app,'Code','Local State')`,
00375|         'with open(ls_path,encoding="utf-8") as f: ls=json.load(f)',
00376|         'enc=base64.b64decode(ls["os_crypt"]["encrypted_key"])[5:]',
00377|         'class B(ctypes.Structure): _fields_=[("n",ctypes.c_ulong),("p",ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_char))]',
00378|         'i=(ctypes.c_char*len(enc))(*enc); ib=B(len(enc),i); ob=B()',
00379|         'ok=ctypes.windll.crypt32.CryptUnprotectData(ctypes.byref(ib),None,None,None,None,0,ctypes.byref(ob))',
00380|         'if not ok: print(json.dumps({"error":"dpapi"})); sys.exit(1)',
00381|         'mk=list(ctypes.string_at(ob.p,ob.n)); ctypes.windll.kernel32.LocalFree(ob.p)',
00382|         'c=sqlite3.connect(db)',
00383|         // 嘗試多個 key 名稱，相容舊版 (v2.x) 與新版 (v3+) atlascode
00384|         'def find_sites(c):',
00385|         '    for k in ["atlassian.atlascode","atlassian.atlascode.v2","atlascode"]:', 
00386|         '        r=c.execute("SELECT value FROM ItemTable WHERE key=?",[k]).fetchone()',
00387|         '        if not r: continue',
00388|         '        d=json.loads(r[0])',
00389|         '        if isinstance(d,list) and d and isinstance(d[0],dict) and "baseApiUrl" in d[0]: return d',
00390|         '        if isinstance(d,dict):', 
00391|         '            for fld in ["jiraSites","jiraCloudSites","sites"]:',
00392|         '                lst=d.get(fld)',
00393|         '                if lst and isinstance(lst,list): return lst',
00394|         '    # 廣播搜尋包含 atlascode 的所有 key',
00395|         '    rows=c.execute("SELECT key,value FROM ItemTable WHERE key LIKE ?",["atlassian%"]).fetchall()',
00396|         '    for _,v in rows:',
00397|         '        try:',
00398|         '            d=json.loads(v)',
00399|         '            for fld in ["jiraSites","jiraCloudSites","sites"]:',
00400|         '                lst=d.get(fld,[]) if isinstance(d,dict) else []',
00401|         '                if lst and isinstance(lst[0],dict) and "baseApiUrl" in lst[0]: return lst',
00402|         '        except: pass',
00403|         '    return []',
00404|         'sites=find_sites(c)',
00405|         'if not sites: print(json.dumps({"error":"no_sites"})); sys.exit(1)',
00406|         's=sites[0]',
00407|         'cred_id=s.get("credentialId","")',
00408|         'if not cred_id: print(json.dumps({"error":"no_cred_id"})); sys.exit(1)',
00409|         'ck=\'secret://{"extensionId":"atlassian.atlascode","key":"jira-\'+cred_id+\'"}\'',
00410|         'er=c.execute("SELECT value FROM ItemTable WHERE key=?",[ck]).fetchone(); c.close()',
00411|         'if not er: print(json.dumps({"error":"no_cred"})); sys.exit(1)',
00412|         'ed=json.loads(er[0])',
00413|         'print(json.dumps({"mk":mk,"buf":ed["data"],"baseApiUrl":s["baseApiUrl"],"host":s.get("host","")}))',
00414|       ].join('\n');
00415| 
00416|       // 寫入 temp file 執行，避免 Windows stdin pipe hang 問題
00417|       // 嘗試 py (Windows Launcher) → python → python3
00418|       const tmpPy = path.join(appData, 'ami-atlas-auth-tmp.py');
00419|       fs.writeFileSync(tmpPy, pyScript, 'utf-8');
00420|       let raw = '';
00421|       let lastErr: unknown;
00422|       const pythonCmds = process.platform === 'win32' ? ['py', 'python'] : ['python3', 'python'];
00423|       try {
00424|         for (const cmd of pythonCmds) {
00425|           try {
00426|             raw = execSync(`${cmd} "${tmpPy}"`, { encoding: 'utf-8', timeout: 12_000 }).trim();
00427|             lastErr = undefined;
00428|             break;
00429|           } catch (e) { lastErr = e; }
00430|         }
00431|         if (lastErr) { throw lastErr; }
00432|       } finally {
00433|         try { fs.unlinkSync(tmpPy); } catch { /* ignore */ }
00434|       }
00435|       const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as {
00436|         error?: string; mk?: number[]; buf?: number[];
00437|         baseApiUrl?: string; host?: string;
00438|       };
00439|       if (parsed.error || !parsed.mk || !parsed.buf || !parsed.baseApiUrl) {
00440|         this._callbacks.log(`atlascode auth: ${parsed.error ?? 'missing fields'}`);
00441|         return null;
00442|       }
00443| 
00444|       // AES-256-GCM 解密：v10(3) + nonce(12) + ciphertext + tag(16)
00445|       const masterKey = Buffer.from(parsed.mk);
00446|       const buf = Buffer.from(parsed.buf);
00447|       const nonce = buf.slice(3, 15);
00448|       const ciphertext = buf.slice(15, buf.length - 16);
00449|       const tag = buf.slice(buf.length - 16);
00450|       const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv('aes-256-gcm', masterKey, nonce);
00451|       decipher.setAuthTag(tag);
00452|       const plain = Buffer.concat([decipher.update(ciphertext), decipher.final()]);
00453|       const cred = JSON.parse(plain.toString('utf-8')) as { access?: string; refresh?: string };
00454|       if (!cred.access) { return null; }
00455| 
00456|       // 解析 JWT expiry
00457|       let expiry = Date.now() + 3_600_000; // 預設 1h
00458|       try {
00459|         const payload = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(cred.access.split('.')[1], 'base64').toString('utf-8'));
00460|         if (payload.exp) { expiry = payload.exp * 1000; }
00461|       } catch { /* ignore */ }
00462| 
00463|       this._atlasJiraCred = { baseApiUrl: parsed.baseApiUrl, accessToken: cred.access, expiry };
00464|       return this._atlasJiraCred;
00465|     } catch (e) {
00466|       this._callbacks.log(`getAtlascodeJiraAuth error: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
00467|       return null;
00468|     }
00469|   }
00470|   /** 探索 Rovo Dev 本地 HTTP server (127.0.0.1:{port})，優先讀 env var，否則掃描 Windows 程序表。
00471|    *  正向結果快取 5 分鐘；負向結果快取 30 秒。*/
00472|   private async discoverRovoDevUrl(): Promise<{ url: string; token: string } | null> {
00473|     if (this._rovoDevCache && Date.now() < this._rovoDevCache.expiry) {
00474|       return { url: this._rovoDevCache.url, token: this._rovoDevCache.token };
00475|     }
00476|     if (!this._rovoDevCache && Date.now() < this._rovoDevNullUntil) { return null; }
00477| 
00478|     const envToken = process.env['ROVODEV_SERVE_SESSION_TOKEN'] ?? '';
00479| 
00480|     const tryUrl = async (url: string): Promise<boolean> => {
00481|       return new Promise(resolve => {
00482|         try {
00483|           const u = new URL('/healthcheck', url);
00484|           const headers: Record<string, string> = envToken ? { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${envToken}` } : {};
00485|           const req = http.request({ hostname: u.hostname, port: parseInt(u.port || '80'), path: u.pathname, method: 'GET', headers }, res => {
00486|             res.resume(); resolve(res.statusCode === 200);
00487|           });
00488|           req.on('error', () => resolve(false));
00489|           req.setTimeout(2000, () => { req.destroy(); resolve(false); });
00490|           req.end();
00491|         } catch { resolve(false); }
00492|       });
00493|     };
00494| 
00495|     // 1. Env var (Boysenberry mode)
00496|     const envPort = process.env['ROVODEV_PORT'];
00497|     if (envPort && /^\d+$/.test(envPort)) {
00498|       const url = `http://127.0.0.1:${envPort}`;
00499|       if (await tryUrl(url)) {
00500|         this._rovoDevCache = { url, token: envToken, expiry: Date.now() + 5 * 60_000 };
00501|         return { url, token: envToken };
00502|       }
00503|     }
00504| 
00505|     // 2. Windows: find atlassian_cli_rovodev.exe port via tasklist + netstat
00506|     if (process.platform === 'win32') {
00507|       const port = this.findRovoDevPortWindows();
00508|       if (port) {
00509|         const url = `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`;
00510|         if (await tryUrl(url)) {
00511|           this._rovoDevCache = { url, token: envToken, expiry: Date.now() + 5 * 60_000 };
00512|           return { url, token: envToken };
00513|         }
00514|       }
00515|     }
00516| 
00517|     this._rovoDevCache = undefined;
00518|     this._rovoDevNullUntil = Date.now() + 30_000;
00519|     return null;
00520|   }
00521|   /** 用 tasklist + netstat 同步取得 Rovo Dev 監聽 port (Windows)。*/
00522|   private findRovoDevPortWindows(): string | null {
00523|     try {
00524|       const taskOut = execSync('tasklist /FI "IMAGENAME eq atlassian_cli_rovodev.exe" /FO CSV /NH 2>nul',
00525|         { shell: 'cmd.exe', timeout: 3000, windowsHide: true }).toString();
00526|       const pidMatch = taskOut.match(/"atlassian_cli_rovodev\.exe","(\d+)"/);
00527|       if (!pidMatch) return null;
00528|       const pid = pidMatch[1];
00529|       const netOut = execSync('netstat -ano 2>nul | findstr " LISTENING"',
00530|         { shell: 'cmd.exe', timeout: 5000, windowsHide: true }).toString();
00531|       for (const line of netOut.split('\n')) {
00532|         if (!line.trimEnd().endsWith(pid)) { continue; }
00533|         const m = line.match(/127\.0\.0\.1:(\d+)/);
00534|         if (!m) { continue; }
00535|         const p = parseInt(m[1]);
00536|         if (p >= 40000 && p <= 41000) { return String(p); }
00537|       }
00538|       return null;
00539|     } catch { return null; }
00540|   }
00541|   /** 向 Rovo Dev 本地 HTTP server 提問並以 SSE stream 收集文字回覆。
00542|    *  回傳 AI 回覆文字，若無法連線則回傳 null。*/
00543|   private async callRovoDevApi(question: string): Promise<string | null> {
00544|     const target = await this.discoverRovoDevUrl();
00545|     if (!target) { return null; }
00546|     const { url, token } = target;
00547|     const reqHeaders: Record<string, string> = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'accept': 'text/event-stream' };
00548|     if (token) { reqHeaders['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`; }
00549| 
00550|     // Step 1: POST /v3/set_chat_message
00551|     const body = JSON.stringify({ message: question, context: [] });
00552|     const step1Ok = await new Promise<boolean>(resolve => {
00553|       try {
00554|         const u = new URL('/v3/set_chat_message', url);
00555|         const req = http.request({
00556|           hostname: u.hostname, port: parseInt(u.port || '80'),
00557|           path: u.pathname, method: 'POST',
00558|           headers: { ...reqHeaders, 'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(body) },
00559|         }, res => { res.resume(); resolve(res.statusCode !== undefined && res.statusCode < 400); });
00560|         req.on('error', () => resolve(false));
00561|         req.setTimeout(10000, () => { req.destroy(); resolve(false); });
00562|         req.write(body); req.end();
00563|       } catch { resolve(false); }
00564|     });
00565|     if (!step1Ok) {
00566|       // Auth || connection failed – invalidate cache so we re-discover next time
00567|       this._rovoDevCache = undefined; this._rovoDevNullUntil = 0;
00568|       return null;
00569|     }
00570| 
00571|     // Step 2: GET /v3/stream_chat (SSE) and collect text parts
00572|     return new Promise<string | null>(resolve => {
00573|       try {
00574|         const u = new URL('/v3/stream_chat?pause_on_call_tools_start=false&enable_deferred_tools=true', url);
00575|         const req = http.request({
00576|           hostname: u.hostname, port: parseInt(u.port || '80'),
00577|           path: u.pathname + u.search, method: 'GET',
00578|           headers: reqHeaders,
00579|         }, res => {
00580|           if (res.statusCode !== 200) { res.resume(); resolve(null); return; }
00581|           let sseBuffer = '';
00582|           const parts: string[] = [];
00583|           res.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => {
00584|             sseBuffer += chunk.toString('utf8');
00585|             const blocks = sseBuffer.split(/\r?\n\r?\n/g);
00586|             sseBuffer = blocks.pop() ?? '';
00587|             for (const block of blocks) {
00588|               if (block.startsWith(': ping')) { continue; }
00589|               const m = block.match(/^event: ([^\r\n]+)\r?\ndata: ([\s\S]*)$/);
00590|               if (!m) { continue; }
00591|               const kind = m[1].trim();
00592|               let data: Record<string, unknown> = {};
00593|               try { data = JSON.parse(m[2]); } catch { continue; }
00594|               if (kind === 'text') {
00595|                 const c = (data['content'] ?? data['content_delta'] ?? '') as string;
00596|                 if (c) { parts.push(c); }
00597|               } else if (kind === 'part_start') {
00598|                 const part = (data['part'] ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
00599|                 if (part['part_kind'] === 'text' && part['content']) { parts.push(part['content'] as string); }
00600|               } else if (kind === 'part_delta') {
00601|                 const delta = (data['delta'] ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
00602|                 if (delta['part_delta_kind'] === 'text' && delta['content_delta']) { parts.push(delta['content_delta'] as string); }
00603|               }
00604|             }
00605|           });
00606|           res.on('end', () => { resolve(parts.join('').trim() || null); });
00607|           res.on('error', () => resolve(null));
00608|         });
00609|         req.on('error', () => resolve(null));
00610|         req.setTimeout(60000, () => { req.destroy(); resolve(null); });
00611|         req.end();
00612|       } catch { resolve(null); }
00613|     });
00614|   }

00671|   public async executeTool(name: string, args: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<string> {
00672|     // 工具名稱正規化：將常見替代名稱映射至正式名稱
00673|     const resolved = ToolExecutor.TOOL_ALIASES[name] ?? name;
00674|     if (resolved !== name) {
00675|       this._callbacks.log(`executeTool: alias "${name}" → "${resolved}"`);
00676|       return this.executeTool(resolved, args);
00677|     }
00678|     const folders = vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders ?? [];
00679|     const wsRoot = folders[0]?.uri.fsPath ?? '';
00680|     const resolvePath = (p: string) => {
00681|       if (!p) { return wsRoot; }
00682|       if (path.isAbsolute(p)) { return p; }
00683|       // Check if the relative path exists under any workspace folder
00684|       for (const f of folders) {
00685|         const candidate = path.join(f.uri.fsPath, p);
00686|         // Return first folder that contains the relative prefix
00687|         const rel = p.split(/[\\/]/)[0];
00688|         if (rel) {
00689|           try { require('fs').accessSync(path.join(f.uri.fsPath, rel)); return candidate; } catch { /* try next */ }
00690|         }
00691|       }
00692|       return path.join(wsRoot, p);
00693|     };
00694| 
00695|     /**
00696|      * 三層優先順序路徑解析：
00697|      *  1. 絕對路徑 / 相對路徑（存在於磁碟）→ 直接使用
00698|      *  2. 找不到 → 查 VS Code 已開啟的 openTextDocuments（basename 或 相對路徑 suffix 比對）
00699|      *  3. 還找不到 → workspace.findFiles 在整個工作區搜尋
00700|      */
00701|     const resolvePathWithPriority = async (raw: string): Promise<string> => {
00702|       if (!raw) { return wsRoot; }
00703|       // ① 絕對路徑直接用
00704|       if (path.isAbsolute(raw)) {
00705|         try { require('fs').accessSync(raw); return raw; } catch { /* fall through */ }
00706|       }
00707|       // ① 相對路徑：先嘗試 workspace folder 解析
00708|       const candidate = resolvePath(raw);
00709|       try { require('fs').accessSync(candidate); return candidate; } catch { /* not on disk */ }
00710| 
00711|       // ② 已開啟的 editor documents（不須在磁碟，可能是 untitled 或虛擬 FS）
00712|       const rawBase = path.basename(raw).toLowerCase();
00713|       const rawNorm = raw.replace(/\\/g, '/').toLowerCase();
00714|       for (const doc of vscode.workspace.textDocuments) {
00715|         const docPath = doc.uri.fsPath;
00716|         const docNorm = docPath.replace(/\\/g, '/').toLowerCase();
00717|         if (docNorm.endsWith(rawNorm) || path.basename(docPath).toLowerCase() === rawBase) {
00718|           return docPath;
00719|         }
00720|       }
00721| 
00722|       // ③ workspace.findFiles 搜全工作區
00723|       try {
00724|         // 先嘗試精確 glob（保留原始路徑結構）
00725|         const exactGlob = `**/${raw.replace(/\\/g, '/')}`;
00726|         const found = await vscode.workspace.findFiles(exactGlob, '**/node_modules/**', 5);
00727|         if (found.length > 0) {
00728|           // 若多個結果，優先選最短路徑（最靠近根目錄）
00729|           found.sort((a, b) => a.fsPath.length - b.fsPath.length);
00730|           return found[0].fsPath;
00731|         }
00732|         // basename glob fallback
00733|         const baseGlob = `**/${rawBase}`;
00734|         const found2 = await vscode.workspace.findFiles(baseGlob, '**/node_modules/**', 5);
00735|         if (found2.length > 0) {
00736|           found2.sort((a, b) => a.fsPath.length - b.fsPath.length);
00737|           return found2[0].fsPath;
00738|         }
00739|       } catch { /* ignore findFiles error */ }
00740| 
00741|       // fallback：回傳原始 resolvePath 結果（讓呼叫端的 stat 報「找不到」）
00742|       return candidate;
00743|     };
00744| 
00745|     // Shadow 路由分流：若 args.mode==='shadow' 或影子模式已啟動，將寫入類工具導入暗存區
00746|     const _isShadowCall = (args as Record<string,unknown>)['mode'] === 'shadow';
00747|     const _isSandboxActive = this._sandbox.isActive();
00748|     if ((_isShadowCall || _isSandboxActive) && SHADOW_WRITE_TOOLS.has(name)) {
00749|       if (!this._sandbox.isActive()) {
00750|         this._sandbox.initShadow(Date.now().toString(36));
00751|       }
00752|       const shadowArgs = this._sandbox.remapArgs(name, args);
00753|       const provider = this._providerMap.get(name);
00754|       if (provider) {

00756|           callbacks: this._callbacks,
00757|           cache: this._cache,
00758|           audit: this._audit,
00759|           wsRoot,
00760|           folders,
00761|           requestPermission: (cat, desc, tool, diff) => this.requestPermission(cat, desc, tool ?? '', diff),
00762|           resolvePath,
00763|           resolvePathSmart: resolvePathWithPriority,
00764|           executeTool: (n, a) => this.executeTool(n, a),
00765|           handleWhatsApp: (n, a) => this._callbacks.handleWhatsAppTool(n, a),
00766|         };
00767|         return provider.execute(name, shadowArgs, ctx);
00768|       }
00769|     }
00770|     // 影子號令： sandbox_init / sandbox_verify / sandbox_commit / sandbox_rollback
00771|     if (name === 'sandbox_init') { this._sandbox.initShadow(args.session_id as string || Date.now().toString(36)); return '✅ 影子工作區已初始化，後續寫入類操作將進入暫存區等待審核'; }

00776| 
00777|     // Provider dispatch：已遷移的工具走 provider 路徑，其餘繼續走原始 switch
00778|     const _provider = this._providerMap.get(name);
00779|     if (_provider) {
00780|       const _ctx: ToolExecutionContext = {
00781|         callbacks: this._callbacks,
00782|         cache: this._cache,
00783|         audit: this._audit,
00784|         wsRoot,
00785|         folders,
00786|         requestPermission: (cat, desc, tool, diff) => this.requestPermission(cat, desc, tool ?? '', diff),
00787|         resolvePath,
00788|         resolvePathSmart: resolvePathWithPriority,
00789|         executeTool: (n, a) => this.executeTool(n, a),
00790|         handleWhatsApp: (n, a) => this._callbacks.handleWhatsAppTool(n, a),
00791|       };
00792|       return _provider.execute(name, args, _ctx);
00793|     }
00794| 
00795|     switch (name) {
00796|       case 'get_active_file': {
00797|         const editor = vscode.window.activeTextEditor;
00798|         if (!editor) { return '沒有開啟的檔案'; }

00800|       }

00869|       case 'read_file_smart': {

00883|

00890|           const rfsRegex = rfsPattern ? new RegExp(rfsPattern, 'i') : null;

00892| 
00893|           // 收集匹配行（含 context 支援）
00894|           const matchedLines: Array<{ lineNo: number; text: string; isContext?: boolean }> = [];
00895|           const ringBuffer: string[] = [];                // 用於 context_lines 的前置緩衝
00896|           const pendingCtxLineNos = new Set<number>();    // 標記需要輸出的後置 context 行號

00898| 
00899|           await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
00900|             const rl = readline.createInterface({
00901|               input: nodefs.createReadStream(rfsFpath, { encoding: 'utf8' }),
00902|               crlfDelay: Infinity,
00903|             });

00908| 
00909|             rl.on('line', (line: string) => {
00910|               lineNo++;

00913|

00928|               }

00936|                   for (let i = 0; i < ringBuffer.length; i++) {
00937|                     const ctxNo = lineNo - ringBuffer.length + i;
00938|                     if (!matchedLines.find(m => m.lineNo === ctxNo)) {
00939|                       matchedLines.push({ lineNo: ctxNo, text: ringBuffer[i], isContext: true });
00940|                     }
00941|                   }
00942|                   ringBuffer.length = 0;
00943|                   // 標記後置 context
00944|                   for (let j = 1; j <= rfsCtx; j++) pendingCtxLineNos.add(lineNo + j);
00945|                 }

00948|                 if (outputBytes > maxOutputBytes) { collecting = false; return; }

00951|                 if (pendingCtxLineNos.has(lineNo)) {
00952|                   pendingCtxLineNos.delete(lineNo);
00953|                   matchedLines.push({ lineNo, text: line, isContext: true });
00954|                   outputBytes += line.length + 1;
00955|                 }
00956|                 if (rfsCtx > 0 && rfsRegex) {
00957|                   ringBuffer.push(line);
00958|                   if (ringBuffer.length > rfsCtx) ringBuffer.shift();
00959|                 }
00960|               }
00961|             });

00963|               totalFileLines = lineNo;
00964|               // 處理 tail 模式結果

00967|                 tailLines.forEach((tl, i) => {
00968|                   matchedLines.push({ lineNo: tailStart + i, text: tl });
00969|                 });
00970|               }
00971|               resolve();
00972|             });
00973|             rl.on('error', reject);
00974|           });
00975| 
00976|           const header = `📄 ${rfsFpath}  (${fileSizeMb} MB, ${totalFileLines.toLocaleString()} 行)` +
00977|             (rfsPattern  ? `  pattern="${rfsPattern}"` : '') +
00978|             (rfsStartLine ? `  lines=${rfsStartLine}-${rfsEndLine ?? '∞'}` : '') +
00979|             (rfsHead     ? `  head=${rfsHead}` : '') +
00980|             (rfsTail     ? `  tail=${rfsTail}` : '') +
00981|             `  matched=${matchedLines.length} 行\n`;
00982| 
00983|           if (matchedLines.length === 0) {
00984|             return header + '（無匹配行）';
00985|           }
00986| 
00987|           let totalOut = 0;
00988|           const lines = matchedLines.map(m => {
00989|             totalOut += m.text.length + 1;
00990|             const pct = totalFileLines > 0 ? ` (${(m.lineNo * 100 / totalFileLines).toFixed(1)}%)` : '';
00991|             return `${m.isContext ? '  ' : ''}${String(m.lineNo).padStart(6)}${pct}: ${m.text}`;
00992|           });
00993| 
00994|           const truncated = totalOut > maxOutputBytes;
00995|           const body = lines.join('\n') + (truncated ? `\n…（已達 ${rfsMaxKb}KB 輸出上限，請縮小範圍或增大 max_kb）` : '');
00996|           return header + body;
00997|         } catch (e) {
00998|           return `read_file_smart 錯誤：${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`;
00999|         }

03286| function runDockerPython(pyCode: string, dockerImage: string, timeoutMs: number): Promise<string> {
03287|   return new Promise(res => {
03288|     try {
03289|       const { spawn } = require('child_process') as typeof import('child_process');
03290|       const proc = spawn('docker', ['run', '--rm', '-i', '--network=host', dockerImage, 'python', '-']);
03291|       let out = '', err = '';
03292|       proc.stdout.on('data', (d: Buffer) => { out += d.toString(); });
03293|       proc.stderr.on('data', (d: Buffer) => { err += d.toString(); });
03294|       proc.on('close', () => {
03295|         const combined = (out + (err ? '\n[stderr]\n' + err : '')).trim();
03296|         res(combined.slice(0, 10000) || '(無輸出)');
03297|       });
03298|       proc.on('error', (e: Error) => res(`Docker 錯誤: ${e.message} — 請確認 Docker Desktop 正在執行`));
03299|       const timer = setTimeout(() => { try { proc.kill(); } catch { /* noop */ } res('逾時 (' + timeoutMs + 'ms)'); }, timeoutMs);
03300|       proc.on('close', () => clearTimeout(timer));
03301|       proc.stdin.write(pyCode, 'utf-8');
03302|       proc.stdin.end();
03303|     } catch (e) {
03304|       res(`Docker 執行失敗: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
03305|     }
03306|   });
03307| }
03308| 
03309| /** 沙箱 Shell 執行助手：透過 `docker run --rm -i <image> sh -c "<cmd>"` 執行 shell 指令。
03310|  *  容器沒有工作區檔案（純命令執行隔離）。
03311|  */
03312| function runDockerShell(cmd: string, dockerImage: string, timeoutMs: number): Promise<string> {
03313|   return new Promise(res => {
03314|     try {
03315|       const { spawn } = require('child_process') as typeof import('child_process');
03316|       const proc = spawn('docker', ['run', '--rm', '--network=host', dockerImage, 'sh', '-c', cmd]);
03317|       let out = '', err = '';
03318|       proc.stdout.on('data', (d: Buffer) => { out += d.toString(); if ((out + err).length > 512000) { try { proc.kill(); } catch { /* noop */ } } });
03319|       proc.stderr.on('data', (d: Buffer) => { err += d.toString(); });
03320|       proc.on('close', () => {
03321|         const combined = (out + (err ? '\n[stderr]\n' + err : '')).trim();
03322|         const r = combined.length > 10000 ? combined.slice(0, 10000) + '\n…（已截斷）' : combined || '(無輸出)';
03323|         res(r);
03324|       });
03325|       proc.on('error', (e: Error) => res(`Docker 錯誤: ${e.message} — 請確認 Docker Desktop 正在執行且已拉取影像`));
03326|       const timer = setTimeout(() => { try { proc.kill(); } catch { /* noop */ } res(`逾時 (${timeoutMs}ms)`); }, timeoutMs);
03327|       proc.on('close', () => clearTimeout(timer));
03328|     } catch (e) {
03329|       res(`Docker 執行失敗: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
03330|     }
03331|   });
03332| }
03333|

00033| const AUTO_WRITE_TOOLS = new Set([
00034|   'write_file', 'replace_in_file', 'insert_in_file', 'replace_all_in_file',
00035|   'batch_replace', 'rename_file', 'copy_file', 'todo_write', 'memory_write',
00036| ]);

00038| // ── Effect-based rule DSL ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
00039| 
00040| export type ToolEffect = 'write' | 'shell' | 'network' | 'delete' | 'any';
00041| 
00042| /**
00043|  * Single ACL rule. Stored in `amiAiClaw.toolPolicyRules` (VS Code setting).
00044|  * Rules are evaluated top-to-bottom; first match wins.
00045|  * Effects: write=file mutations, shell=commands, network=HTTP/browser, delete=destructive.
00046|  * Pattern: glob for write/delete (file path); substring for shell (command) / network (URL).
00047|  */
00048| export interface PolicyRule {
00049|   effect: ToolEffect;
00050|   action: 'allow' | 'deny' | 'ask';
00051|   pattern?: string;
00052| }
00053| 
00054| const _WRITE_EFFECT = new Set([
00055|   'write_file','replace_in_file','insert_in_file','replace_all_in_file',
00056|   'batch_replace','rename_file','copy_file','todo_write','memory_write','lsp_rename_symbol',
00057| ]);
00058| const _SHELL_EFFECT  = new Set(['run_command','run_terminal','run_python']);
00059| const _NET_EFFECT    = new Set(['http_request','fetch_url','browser_navigate','browser_screenshot','browser_script']);
00060| 
00061| function _getEffect(toolName: string): ToolEffect | null {
00062|   if (_WRITE_EFFECT.has(toolName)) return 'write';
00063|   if (_SHELL_EFFECT.has(toolName)) return 'shell';
00064|   if (_NET_EFFECT.has(toolName))   return 'network';
00065|   if (toolName === 'delete_file')  return 'delete';
00066|   return null;
00067| }
00068| 
00069| /** Minimal glob: * = any non-separator chars, ** = anything including /. */
00070| function _globMatch(pattern: string, value: string): boolean {
00071|   const v = value.replace(/\\/g, '/');
00072|   const re = pattern
00073|     .replace(/\\/g, '/')
00074|     .replace(/[.+^${}()|[\]]/g, '\\$&')
00075|     .replace(/\*\*/g, '\x00')
00076|     .replace(/\*/g, '[^/]*')
00077|     .replace(/\x00/g, '.*');
00078|   // match against full path or path suffix (allows `src/**` to match `C:/ws/src/foo.ts`)
00079|   return new RegExp(`(^|/)${re}$`, 'i').test(v) || new RegExp(`^${re}$`, 'i').test(v);
00080| }
00081| 
00082| /** Evaluate ordered rules; returns first matching action or null. */
00083| export function evaluatePolicyRules(
00084|   rules: PolicyRule[],
00085|   effect: ToolEffect,
00086|   value: string,
00087| ): 'allow' | 'deny' | 'ask' | null {
00088|   for (const rule of rules) {
00089|     if (rule.effect !== effect && rule.effect !== 'any') continue;
00090|     if (!rule.pattern) return rule.action;
00091|     if (effect === 'write' || effect === 'delete') {
00092|       if (_globMatch(rule.pattern, value)) return rule.action;
00093|     } else {
00094|       if (value.toLowerCase().includes(rule.pattern.toLowerCase())) return rule.action;
00095|     }
00096|   }
00097|   return null;
00098| }
00099| 
00100| /**
00101|  * 工具權限政策：alwaysAllow 集合 + 一次性確認佇列（pending promise）。
00102|  * 把 forceConfirm / WA agent auto-allow / agentAutoApproveWrite / config alwaysAllowList
00103|  * 這幾條規則整合在 requestPermission 內。
00104|  */
00105| export class ToolPolicies {
00106|   private _alwaysAllow = new Set<string>();
00107|   private _pendingPermission: ((allow: boolean) => void) | null = null;
00108| 
00109|   public constructor(private readonly _cb: ToolPoliciesCallbacks) {}
00110| 
00111|   public getAlwaysAllow(): ReadonlySet<string> {
00112|     return this._alwaysAllow;
00113|   }
00114| 
00115|   public addAlwaysAllow(category: string): void {
00116|     this._alwaysAllow.add(category);
00117|   }
00118| 
00119|   public hasPending(): boolean {
00120|     return this._pendingPermission !== null;
00121|   }
00122| 
00123|   public resolvePending(allow: boolean): boolean {
00124|     if (!this._pendingPermission) { return false; }
00125|     const resolve = this._pendingPermission;
00126|     this._pendingPermission = null;
00127|     resolve(allow);
00128|     return true;
00129|   }
00130| 
00131|   public async requestPermission(
00132|     category: string,
00133|     description: string,
00134|     toolName = '',
00135|     diff?: ToolPermissionDiff,
00136|   ): Promise<boolean> {
00137|     // ── Effect-based rule DSL（最優先）───────────────────────────────────────
00138|     if (toolName) {
00139|       const ruleCfg = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw');
00140|       const rules = ruleCfg.get<PolicyRule[]>('toolPolicyRules') ?? [];
00141|       if (rules.length > 0) {
00142|         const effect = _getEffect(toolName);
00143|         if (effect) {
00144|           let matchValue = description;
00145|           if (effect === 'write' || effect === 'delete') {
00146|             matchValue = diff?.filePath ?? '';
00147|           } else if (effect === 'network') {
00148|             const m = description.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/);
00149|             if (m) matchValue = m[0];
00150|           }
00151|           const ruleDecision = evaluatePolicyRules(rules, effect, matchValue);
00152|           if (ruleDecision === 'allow') { this._cb.log(`Rule DSL allow: ${toolName} [${effect}] ${matchValue.slice(0,60)}`); return true; }
00153|           if (ruleDecision === 'deny')  { this._cb.log(`Rule DSL deny: ${toolName} [${effect}] ${matchValue.slice(0,60)}`);  return false; }
00154|           // 'ask' 跳過 AutoPilot，直接展示對話框
00155|           if (ruleDecision === 'ask') return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
00156|             this._pendingPermission = resolve;
00157|             this._cb.postToWebview({ type: 'permissionRequest', category, description, forceConfirm: true, diff });
00158|           });
00159|         }
00160|       }
00161|     }
00162|     // ── AutoPilot gateway（次優先，短路後續所有邏輯）───────────────────────
00163|     if (isAutoPilotActive() && this._cb.getAutoPilotServices) {
00164|       const services = this._cb.getAutoPilotServices();
00165|       const transcript = this._cb.getRecentTranscript?.() ?? [];
00166|       const wsFolders = (vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders ?? []).map(f => f.uri.fsPath);
00167|       try {
00168|         // Build full toolArgs for classifier (was: only filePath)
00169|         const apArgs: Record<string, unknown> = {};
00170|         if (diff) {
00171|           apArgs.path = diff.filePath;
00172|           if (diff.oldStr) apArgs.old_str = diff.oldStr;
00173|           if (diff.newStr) apArgs.new_str = diff.newStr;
00174|           if (diff.mode)   apArgs.mode    = diff.mode;
00175|         }
00176|         if ((toolName === 'run_command' || toolName === 'run_terminal') && !apArgs.command) {
00177|           apArgs.command = description.replace(/^[^:：]+[：:]\s*/, '');
00178|         }
00179|         if (!apArgs.url) { const urlM = description.match(/https?:\/\/\S+/); if (urlM) apArgs.url = urlM[0]; }
00180|         const decision = await decideAutoPilotAction({
00181|           toolName,
00182|           toolArgs: apArgs,
00183|           toolDisplay: description,
00184|           recentTranscript: transcript,
00185|           workspaceFolders: wsFolders,
00186|           services,
00187|         });
00188|         if (decision.kind === 'allow') {
00189|           this._cb.log(`AutoPilot allow: ${toolName} — ${decision.reason}`);
00190|           recordAutoPilotSuccess();
00191|           return true;
00192|         }
00193|         if (decision.kind === 'deny') {
00194|           this._cb.log(`AutoPilot deny: ${toolName} — ${decision.reason}`);
00195|           recordAutoPilotDenial({ toolName: toolName || category, display: description, reason: decision.reason, timestamp: Date.now() });
00196|           this._cb.postToWebview({ type: 'autoPilotDenied', tool: toolName, reason: decision.reason });
00197|           return false;
00198|         }
00199|         // pass-through / fallback-ask → 繼續走下面原本邏輯
00200|       } catch (e) {
00201|         this._cb.log(`AutoPilot gateway error（fallback to manual）: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
00202|       }
00203|     }
00204|     // ── 原本邏輯（不變）──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
00205|     const pcfg = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw');
00206|     const alwaysAllowList = pcfg.get<string[]>('toolAlwaysAllow') ?? [];
00207|     const alwaysConfirmList = pcfg.get<string[]>('toolAlwaysConfirm') ?? [];
00208|     const forceConfirm = toolName ? alwaysConfirmList.includes(toolName) : false;
00209| 
00210|     if (this._cb.isWaAgentMode() && !forceConfirm && category !== 'delete') {
00211|       this._cb.log(`WA agent: auto-allow tool category=${category} tool=${toolName || '(none)'}`);
00212|       return Promise.resolve(true);
00213|     }
00214|     if (pcfg.get<boolean>('agentAutoApproveWrite', false) && (category === 'write' || (toolName && AUTO_WRITE_TOOLS.has(toolName)))) {
00215|       return Promise.resolve(true);
00216|     }
00217|     if ((toolName && alwaysAllowList.includes(toolName)) || alwaysAllowList.includes(category)) {
00218|       return Promise.resolve(true);
00219|     }
00220|     if (!forceConfirm && this._alwaysAllow.has(category)) { return Promise.resolve(true); }
00221| 
00222|     return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
00223|       this._pendingPermission = resolve;
00224|       this._cb.postToWebview({ type: 'permissionRequest', category, description, forceConfirm, diff });
00225|     });
00226|   }
00227| }

00157| // ── TF-IDF tool search ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
00158| 
00159| function _tokenize(text: string): string[] {
00160|   return text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^\w\s]/g, ' ').split(/\s+/).filter(t => t.length > 1);
00161| }
00162| 
00163| /** Smoothed IDF: log((N+1)/(df+1)) + 1, computed once at module load. */
00164| const _idf: ReadonlyMap<string, number> = (() => {
00165|   const N = EXTRA_TOOLS.length;
00166|   const df = new Map<string, number>();
00167|   for (const tool of EXTRA_TOOLS) {
00168|     const terms = new Set(_tokenize(`${tool.function.name} ${tool.function.description}`));
00169|     for (const t of terms) df.set(t, (df.get(t) ?? 0) + 1);
00170|   }
00171|   const idf = new Map<string, number>();
00172|   for (const [term, count] of df) idf.set(term, Math.log((N + 1) / (count + 1)) + 1);
00173|   return idf;
00174| })();
00175| 
00176| function _tfidfVec(tokens: string[]): Map<string, number> {
00177|   const tf = new Map<string, number>();
00178|   for (const t of tokens) tf.set(t, (tf.get(t) ?? 0) + 1);
00179|   const vec = new Map<string, number>();
00180|   const len = tokens.length || 1;
00181|   // unseen terms get IDF = log((N+1)/1)+1 ≈ high weight for novel query terms
00182|   const unseenIdf = Math.log(EXTRA_TOOLS.length + 2) + 1;
00183|   for (const [t, count] of tf) vec.set(t, (count / len) * (_idf.get(t) ?? unseenIdf));
00184|   return vec;
00185| }
00186| 
00187| function _cosine(a: Map<string, number>, b: Map<string, number>): number {
00188|   let dot = 0, normA = 0, normB = 0;
00189|   for (const [t, v] of a) { dot += v * (b.get(t) ?? 0); normA += v * v; }
00190|   for (const v of b.values()) normB += v * v;
00191|   return normA === 0 || normB === 0 ? 0 : dot / (Math.sqrt(normA) * Math.sqrt(normB));
00192| }
00193| 
00194| /** Pre-computed TF-IDF vectors for all EXTRA_TOOLS (avoids recompute per query). */
00195| const _toolVecs: ReadonlyMap<string, Map<string, number>> = (() => {
00196|   const m = new Map<string, Map<string, number>>();
00197|   for (const tool of EXTRA_TOOLS) {
00198|     m.set(tool.function.name, _tfidfVec(_tokenize(`${tool.function.name} ${tool.function.description}`)));
00199|   }
00200|   return m;
00201| })();
00202| 
00203| /**
00204|  * TF-IDF + cosine similarity search over EXTRA_TOOLS.
00205|  * Returns up to topK tool definitions ranked by semantic relevance.
00206|  */
00207| export function searchExtraTools(query: string, topK = 5): typeof EXTRA_TOOLS {
00208|   const queryTokens = _tokenize(query);
00209|   if (queryTokens.length === 0) return EXTRA_TOOLS.slice(0, topK);
00210|   const queryVec = _tfidfVec(queryTokens);
00211|   const scored = EXTRA_TOOLS.map(tool => ({
00212|     tool,
00213|     score: _cosine(queryVec, _toolVecs.get(tool.function.name)!),
00214|   }));
00215|   return scored
00216|     .filter(s => s.score > 0)
00217|     .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
00218|     .slice(0, topK)
00219|     .map(s => s.tool);
00220| }

00126|   private _jiraRequest(url: string, method: string, header: string, body?: string): Promise<{status:number;data:string}> {
00127|     return new Promise(resolve => {
00128|       try {
00129|         const u = new URL(url); const isHttps = u.protocol === 'https:'; const proto = isHttps ? https : http;
00130|         const buf = body ? Buffer.from(body, 'utf8') : undefined;
00131|         const req = proto.request({
00132|           hostname: u.hostname, port: u.port ? parseInt(u.port) : (isHttps?443:80), path: u.pathname+u.search, method,
00133|           headers: { 'Authorization': header, 'Accept': 'application/json', 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(buf?{'Content-Length':buf.length}:{}) },
00134|         }, res => {
00135|           let data = '';
00136|           res.on('data', (c: Buffer) => { data += c; });
00137|           res.on('end', () => resolve({ status: res.statusCode ?? 0, data }));
00138|         });
00139|         req.on('error', (e: Error) => resolve({ status: 0, data: e.message }));
00140|         req.setTimeout(15000, () => { req.destroy(); resolve({ status: 0, data: '逾時 (15s)' }); });
00141|         if (buf) req.write(buf);
00142|         req.end();
00143|       } catch(e) { resolve({ status: 0, data: String(e) }); }
00144|     });
00145|   }

00303|   private async _discoverRovo(): Promise<{url:string;token:string}|null> {
00304|     if (this._rovoCache && Date.now() < this._rovoCache.expiry) return { url:this._rovoCache.url, token:this._rovoCache.token };

00309|         const u = new URL('/healthcheck', url);
00310|         const req = http.request({ hostname:u.hostname, port:parseInt(u.port||'80'), path:u.pathname, method:'GET', headers:envToken?{'Authorization':`Bearer ${envToken}`}:{} }, res => { res.resume(); resolve(res.statusCode===200); });
00311|         req.on('error',()=>resolve(false)); req.setTimeout(2000,()=>{req.destroy();resolve(false);}); req.end();

00316|     if (process.platform === 'win32') {

00327|   private async _callRovoApi(question: string): Promise<string|null> {

00010| interface BgTask {
00011|   id: string;
00012|   command: string;
00013|   cwd?: string;
00014|   status: 'running' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'killed';
00015|   pid?: number;
00016|   exitCode?: number;
00017|   outputPath: string;
00018|   startedAt: number;
00019|   endedAt?: number;
00020|   proc?: ChildProcess;
00021|   stream: fs.WriteStream;
00022| }

00024| // Module-level store — tasks persist across tool calls within a VS Code session
00025| const _tasks = new Map<string, BgTask>();
00026| let _seq = 0;
00027| 
00028| const TOOLS = new Set(['run_in_background', 'bg_task_status', 'bg_task_read', 'bg_task_kill']);

00030| export class BackgroundProvider implements IToolProvider {

00032| 
00033|   execute(name: string, args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ToolExecutionContext): Promise<string> {
00034|     switch (name) {
00035|       case 'run_in_background': return this._run(args, ctx);
00036|       case 'bg_task_status':    return this._status(args);
00037|       case 'bg_task_read':      return this._read(args);
00038|       case 'bg_task_kill':      return this._kill(args);
00039|       default: return Promise.resolve(`BackgroundProvider: unknown "${name}"`);
00040|     }
00041|   }
00042| 
00043|   private async _run(args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ToolExecutionContext): Promise<string> {
00044|     const command = String(args.command ?? '').trim();
00045|     if (!command) return 'command 為必填';
00046| 
00047|     const wsRoot = (vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders ?? [])[0]?.uri.fsPath ?? process.cwd();
00048|     const rawCwd = args.cwd as string;
00049|     const cwd = rawCwd
00050|       ? (path.isAbsolute(rawCwd) ? rawCwd : path.join(wsRoot, rawCwd))
00051|       : wsRoot;
00052| 
00053|     const allowed = await ctx.requestPermission('shell', `背景執行: ${command}`, 'run_in_background');
00054|     if (!allowed) return '使用者已拒絕執行操作';
00055| 
00056|     const taskId = `bg-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${++_seq}`;
00057|     const outputDir = path.join(wsRoot, '.amiclaw', 'outputs');
00058|     fs.mkdirSync(outputDir, { recursive: true });
00059|     const outputPath = path.join(outputDir, `${taskId}.txt`);
00060|     const stream = fs.createWriteStream(outputPath, { flags: 'w' });
00061| 
00062|     const isWin = process.platform === 'win32';
00063|     const proc = spawn(isWin ? 'cmd' : 'sh', isWin ? ['/c', command] : ['-c', command], {
00064|       cwd, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
00065|     });
00066| 
00067|     const task: BgTask = {
00068|       id: taskId, command, cwd, pid: proc.pid,
00069|       status: 'running', startedAt: Date.now(),
00070|       outputPath, stream, proc,
00071|     };
00072|     _tasks.set(taskId, task);
00073| 
00074|     proc.stdout?.on('data', (d: Buffer) => stream.write(d));
00075|     proc.stderr?.on('data', (d: Buffer) => stream.write(`[stderr] ${d}`));
00076|     proc.on('close', (code) => {
00077|       task.status = code === 0 ? 'completed' : 'failed';
00078|       task.exitCode = code ?? undefined;
00079|       task.endedAt = Date.now();
00080|       stream.end();
00081|     });
00082|     proc.on('error', (err) => {
00083|       task.status = 'failed';
00084|       task.endedAt = Date.now();
00085|       stream.write(`\n[error] ${err.message}\n`);
00086|       stream.end();
00087|     });
00088| 
00089|     return JSON.stringify({ taskId, pid: proc.pid, command, outputPath, status: 'running' });
00090|   }
00091| 
00092|   private async _status(args: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<string> {
00093|     const taskId = String(args.task_id ?? '').trim();
00094| 
00095|     if (!taskId) {
00096|       const list = Array.from(_tasks.values()).map(t => ({
00097|         id: t.id, command: t.command.slice(0, 70), status: t.status,
00098|         pid: t.pid, exitCode: t.exitCode,
00099|         elapsed: _elapsed(t),
00100|       }));
00101|       return list.length ? JSON.stringify(list, null, 2) : '無背景任務';
00102|     }
00103| 
00104|     const task = _tasks.get(taskId);
00105|     if (!task) return `找不到任務 ${taskId}`;
00106| 
00107|     let preview = '（尚無輸出）';
00108|     try {
00109|       const content = fs.readFileSync(task.outputPath, 'utf8');
00110|       const lines = content.split('\n');
00111|       preview = lines.slice(-80).join('\n').slice(0, 3000);
00112|     } catch { /* file may not exist yet */ }
00113| 
00114|     return JSON.stringify({
00115|       taskId: task.id, command: task.command, status: task.status,
00116|       pid: task.pid, exitCode: task.exitCode, elapsed: _elapsed(task),
00117|       outputPath: task.outputPath, outputPreview: preview,
00118|     }, null, 2);
00119|   }
00120| 
00121|   private async _read(args: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<string> {
00122|     const taskId = String(args.task_id ?? '').trim();
00123|     if (!taskId) return 'task_id 為必填';
00124|     const task = _tasks.get(taskId);
00125|     if (!task) return `找不到任務 ${taskId}`;
00126| 
00127|     try {
00128|       const content = fs.readFileSync(task.outputPath, 'utf8');
00129|       const lines = content.split('\n');
00130|       const tail   = Number(args.tail ?? 0);
00131|       const start  = Math.max(0, Number(args.start_line ?? 1) - 1);
00132|       const end    = args.end_line ? Math.min(lines.length, Number(args.end_line)) : lines.length;
00133| 
00134|       const result = tail > 0 ? lines.slice(-tail) : lines.slice(start, end);
00135|       const header = `[${taskId} | ${task.status} | ${lines.length} 行 | 顯示 L${start + 1}–${start + result.length}]\n`;
00136|       return header + result.join('\n');
00137|     } catch {
00138|       return `（輸出檔案尚未建立，任務狀態: ${task.status}）`;
00139|     }
00140|   }
00141| 
00142|   private async _kill(args: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<string> {
00143|     const taskId = String(args.task_id ?? '').trim();
00144|     if (!taskId) return 'task_id 為必填';
00145|     const task = _tasks.get(taskId);
00146|     if (!task) return `找不到任務 ${taskId}`;
00147|     if (task.status !== 'running') return `任務 ${taskId} 已結束（${task.status}）`;
00148| 
00149|     try {
00150|       task.proc?.kill('SIGTERM');
00151|       task.status = 'killed';
00152|       task.endedAt = Date.now();
00153|       task.stream.end();
00154|       return `✅ 任務 ${taskId} 已終止（PID ${task.pid}）`;
00155|     } catch (e) {
00156|       return `終止失敗：${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`;
00157|     }
00158|   }
00159| }
00160| 
00161| function _elapsed(t: BgTask): string {
00162|   const ms = (t.endedAt ?? Date.now()) - t.startedAt;
00163|   return t.endedAt
00164|     ? `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s`
00165|     : `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s (running)`;
00166| }

00224|   private static _visionChat(baseUrl: string, model: string, prompt: string, imagesB64: string[], timeoutMs: number): Promise<string> {
00225|     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
00226|       let url: URL; try { url = new URL('/api/chat', baseUrl); } catch { reject(new Error(`Ollama URL 無效: ${baseUrl}`)); return; }
00227|       const proto = url.protocol==='https:' ? https : http;
00228|       const buf = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ model, messages:[{role:'user',content:prompt,images:imagesB64}], stream:false, options:{temperature:0} }), 'utf8');
00229|       const opts = { hostname:url.hostname, port:url.port?parseInt(url.port,10):(url.protocol==='https:'?443:11434), path:url.pathname, method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Content-Length':buf.length} };
00230|       const req = proto.request(opts, res => {
00231|         let data=''; res.setEncoding('utf8');
00232|         res.on('data',(d:string)=>{data+=d;});
00233|         res.on('end',()=>{ try { const j=JSON.parse(data) as {message?:{content?:string};error?:string}; if (j.error) reject(new Error(j.error)); else resolve((j.message?.content??'').trim()); } catch { reject(new Error(`回應解析失敗: ${data.slice(0,200)}`)); } });
00234|       });
00235|       req.on('error',(e:Error)=>reject(e));
00236|       req.setTimeout(timeoutMs,()=>{ req.destroy(); reject(new Error(`Ollama 視覺推論逾時 (${timeoutMs}ms)`)); });
00237|       req.write(buf); req.end();
00238|     });
00239|   }

00241|   private static _extractJson(text: string): Record<string,unknown>|null {
00242|     if (!text) return null;
00243|     const fenced = text.match(/```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)```/i);
00244|     const candidate = fenced ? fenced[1] : text;
00245|     const m = candidate.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
00246|     if (!m) return null; try { return JSON.parse(m[0]) as Record<string,unknown>; } catch { return null; }
00247|   }

00004| import { spawn } from 'child_process';
00005| 
00006| export function runDockerPython(pyCode: string, dockerImage: string, timeoutMs: number): Promise<string> {
00007|   return new Promise(res => {
00008|     try {
00009|       const proc = spawn('docker', ['run', '--rm', '-i', '--network=host', dockerImage, 'python', '-']);
00010|       let out = '', err = '';
00011|       proc.stdout.on('data', (d: Buffer) => { out += d.toString(); });
00012|       proc.stderr.on('data', (d: Buffer) => { err += d.toString(); });
00013|       proc.on('close', () => res((out + (err ? '\n[stderr]\n' + err : '')).trim().slice(0, 10000) || '(無輸出)'));
00014|       proc.on('error', (e: Error) => res(`Docker 錯誤: ${e.message} — 請確認 Docker Desktop 正在執行`));
00015|       const timer = setTimeout(() => { try { proc.kill(); } catch { /* noop */ } res(`逾時 (${timeoutMs}ms)`); }, timeoutMs);
00016|       proc.on('close', () => clearTimeout(timer));
00017|       proc.stdin.write(pyCode, 'utf-8');
00018|       proc.stdin.end();
00019|     } catch (e) { res(`Docker 執行失敗: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`); }
00020|   });
00021| }

00023| export function runDockerShell(cmd: string, dockerImage: string, timeoutMs: number): Promise<string> {
00024|   return new Promise(res => {
00025|     try {
00026|       const proc = spawn('docker', ['run', '--rm', '--network=host', dockerImage, 'sh', '-c', cmd]);
00027|       let out = '', err = '';
00028|       proc.stdout.on('data', (d: Buffer) => { out += d.toString(); if ((out + err).length > 512000) { try { proc.kill(); } catch { /* noop */ } } });
00029|       proc.stderr.on('data', (d: Buffer) => { err += d.toString(); });
00030|       proc.on('close', () => {
00031|         const r = (out + (err ? '\n[stderr]\n' + err : '')).trim();
00032|         res((r.length > 10000 ? r.slice(0, 10000) + '\n…（已截斷）' : r) || '(無輸出)');
00033|       });
00034|       proc.on('error', (e: Error) => res(`Docker 錯誤: ${e.message} — 請確認 Docker Desktop 正在執行且已拉取影像`));
00035|       const timer = setTimeout(() => { try { proc.kill(); } catch { /* noop */ } res(`逾時 (${timeoutMs}ms)`); }, timeoutMs);
00036|       proc.on('close', () => clearTimeout(timer));
00037|     } catch (e) { res(`Docker 執行失敗: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`); }
00038|   });
00039| }

00009| // ── computeUnifiedDiff (moved from ToolExecutor top-level) ────────────────────
00010| function computeUnifiedDiff(aLines: string[], bLines: string[], fileA: string, fileB: string, contextLines: number): string {
00011|   const m = aLines.length, n = bLines.length;
00012|   const dp: number[][] = Array.from({ length: m + 1 }, () => new Array(n + 1).fill(0));
00013|   for (let i = 1; i <= m; i++) for (let j = 1; j <= n; j++) dp[i][j] = aLines[i-1] === bLines[j-1] ? dp[i-1][j-1]+1 : Math.max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1]);
00014|   type Edit = { op: ' '|'-'|'+'; line: string; ai: number; bi: number };
00015|   const edits: Edit[] = [];
00016|   let i = m, j = n;
00017|   while (i > 0 || j > 0) {
00018|     if (i > 0 && j > 0 && aLines[i-1] === bLines[j-1]) { edits.push({ op: ' ', line: aLines[i-1], ai: i, bi: j }); i--; j--; }
00019|     else if (j > 0 && (i === 0 || dp[i][j-1] >= dp[i-1][j])) { edits.push({ op: '+', line: bLines[j-1], ai: i, bi: j }); j--; }
00020|     else { edits.push({ op: '-', line: aLines[i-1], ai: i, bi: j }); i--; }
00021|   }
00022|   edits.reverse();
00023|   const changed = new Set(edits.map((e, idx) => e.op !== ' ' ? idx : -1).filter(x => x >= 0));
00024|   if (changed.size === 0) return '';
00025|   const inHunk = new Set<number>();
00026|   for (const c of changed) for (let k = Math.max(0, c-contextLines); k <= Math.min(edits.length-1, c+contextLines); k++) inHunk.add(k);
00027|   const lines: string[] = [`--- ${fileA}`, `+++ ${fileB}`];
00028|   let inBlock = false, aStart = 0, bStart = 0, aCount = 0, bCount = 0;
00029|   const hunkLines: string[] = [];
00030|   const flushHunk = () => { if (hunkLines.length) { lines.push(`@@ -${aStart},${aCount} +${bStart},${bCount} @@`); lines.push(...hunkLines); hunkLines.length = 0; inBlock = false; } };
00031|   let aIdx = 1, bIdx = 1;
00032|   for (let k = 0; k < edits.length; k++) {
00033|     const e = edits[k];
00034|     if (inHunk.has(k)) {
00035|       if (!inBlock) { flushHunk(); aStart = aIdx; bStart = bIdx; aCount = 0; bCount = 0; inBlock = true; }
00036|       hunkLines.push(e.op + e.line);
00037|       if (e.op !== '+') { aCount++; aIdx++; }
00038|       if (e.op !== '-') { bCount++; bIdx++; }
00039|     } else { if (inBlock) flushHunk(); if (e.op !== '+') aIdx++; if (e.op !== '-') bIdx++; }
00040|   }
00041|   flushHunk();
00042|   return lines.join('\n');
00043| }

00045| function computeDiffStatsAndPatch(
00046|   before: string, after: string, filePath: string, maxPatchBytes = 6000
00047| ): { linesAdded: number; linesRemoved: number; patch: string } {
00048|   const aLines = before.split(/\r?\n/);
00049|   const bLines = after.split(/\r?\n/);
00050|   if (aLines.length + bLines.length > 4000) {
00051|     return { linesAdded: Math.max(0, bLines.length - aLines.length), linesRemoved: Math.max(0, aLines.length - bLines.length), patch: '' };
00052|   }
00053|   const baseName = path.basename(filePath);
00054|   let patch = computeUnifiedDiff(aLines, bLines, baseName, baseName, 3);
00055|   if (patch.length > maxPatchBytes) { patch = patch.slice(0, maxPatchBytes) + '\n…（截斷）'; }
00056|   const pLines = patch.split('\n');
00057|   const linesAdded = pLines.filter(l => l.startsWith('+') && !l.startsWith('+++')).length;
00058|   const linesRemoved = pLines.filter(l => l.startsWith('-') && !l.startsWith('---')).length;
00059|   return { linesAdded, linesRemoved, patch };
00060| }

00142|   private async _readFileSmart(args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ToolExecutionContext): Promise<string> {
00143|     const fpath = await ctx.resolvePathSmart(args.path as string);
00144|     const pattern   = args.pattern    ? String(args.pattern)   : null;
00145|     const startLine = args.start_line ? Math.max(1, Number(args.start_line)) : null;
00146|     const endLine   = args.end_line   ? Math.max(1, Number(args.end_line))   : null;
00147|     const head      = args.head       ? Math.max(1, Number(args.head))       : null;
00148|     const tail      = args.tail       ? Math.max(1, Number(args.tail))       : null;
00149|     const ctxLines  = args.context_lines ? Math.max(0, Number(args.context_lines)) : 0;
00150|     const maxKb     = args.max_kb     ? Math.max(1, Math.min(512, Number(args.max_kb))) : 128;
00151|     try {
00152|       const nodefs   = require('fs') as typeof import('fs');
00153|       const readline = require('readline') as typeof import('readline');
00154|       let stat: import('fs').Stats;
00155|       try { stat = nodefs.statSync(fpath); } catch { return `錯誤：找不到檔案 ${fpath}`; }
00156|       const fileSizeMb = (stat.size/1024/1024).toFixed(1);
00157|       const regex = pattern ? new RegExp(pattern, 'i') : null;
00158|       const maxBytes = maxKb * 1024;
00159|       const matched: Array<{lineNo:number;text:string;isContext?:boolean}> = [];
00160|       const ring: string[] = [];
00161|       const pendingCtx = new Set<number>();
00162|       let totalLines = 0;
00163|       await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
00164|         const rl = readline.createInterface({ input: nodefs.createReadStream(fpath, {encoding:'utf8'}), crlfDelay: Infinity });
00165|         let lineNo = 0; let outBytes = 0; let collecting = true;
00166|         let tailBuf: string[] = tail ? [] : [];
00167|         rl.on('line', (line: string) => {
00168|           lineNo++;
00169|           if (!collecting) return;
00170|           if (tail) { tailBuf.push(line); if (tailBuf.length > tail) tailBuf.shift(); return; }
00171|           if (head && lineNo > head) { collecting = false; return; }
00172|           if (startLine && lineNo < startLine) { if (ctxLines > 0) { ring.push(line); if (ring.length > ctxLines) ring.shift(); } return; }
00173|           if (endLine && lineNo > endLine) { collecting = false; return; }
00174|           const isMatch = regex ? regex.test(line) : true;
00175|           if (isMatch) {
00176|             if (ctxLines > 0 && regex) {
00177|               for (let ri = 0; ri < ring.length; ri++) { const cn = lineNo-ring.length+ri; if (!matched.find(m=>m.lineNo===cn)) matched.push({lineNo:cn,text:ring[ri],isContext:true}); }
00178|               ring.length = 0;
00179|               for (let j = 1; j <= ctxLines; j++) pendingCtx.add(lineNo+j);
00180|             }
00181|             matched.push({lineNo,text:line});
00182|             outBytes += line.length+1;
00183|             if (outBytes > maxBytes) { collecting = false; return; }
00184|           } else {
00185|             if (pendingCtx.has(lineNo)) { pendingCtx.delete(lineNo); matched.push({lineNo,text:line,isContext:true}); outBytes += line.length+1; }
00186|             if (ctxLines > 0 && regex) { ring.push(line); if (ring.length > ctxLines) ring.shift(); }
00187|           }
00188|         });
00189|         rl.on('close', () => {
00190|           totalLines = lineNo;
00191|           if (tail && tailBuf.length > 0) { const s = lineNo-tailBuf.length+1; tailBuf.forEach((tl,i) => matched.push({lineNo:s+i,text:tl})); }
00192|           resolve();
00193|         });
00194|         rl.on('error', reject);
00195|       });
00196|       const hdr = `📄 ${fpath}  (${fileSizeMb} MB, ${totalLines.toLocaleString()} 行)${pattern?`  pattern="${pattern}"`:''}${startLine?`  lines=${startLine}-${endLine??'∞'}`:''}${head?`  head=${head}`:''}${tail?`  tail=${tail}`:''}  matched=${matched.length} 行\n`;
00197|       if (matched.length === 0) return hdr + '（無匹配行）';
00198|       let totalOut = 0;
00199|       const outputLines = matched.map(m => {
00200|         totalOut += m.text.length+1;
00201|         const pct = totalLines > 0 ? ` (${(m.lineNo*100/totalLines).toFixed(1)}%)` : '';
00202|         return `${m.isContext?'  ':''}${String(m.lineNo).padStart(6)}${pct}: ${m.text}`;
00203|       });
00204|       return hdr + outputLines.join('\n') + (totalOut > maxBytes ? `\n…（已達 ${maxKb}KB 上限）` : '');
00205|     } catch(e) { return `read_file_smart 錯誤：${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`; }
00206|   }

00209|   private async _grepFile(args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ToolExecutionContext): Promise<string> {

00262|         for (const m of sorted) { if (!deduped.length || deduped[deduped.length-1].lineNo!==m.lineNo) deduped.push(m); else if (!m.isCtx) deduped[deduped.length-1].isCtx=false; }

00271|             if (m.lineNo > prev+1 && prev !== -999) section += '   ——\n';

00284|   // ── read_files ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
00285|   private async _readFiles(args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ToolExecutionContext): Promise<string> {
