00290|     const maxTotalKb = Math.max(1, (args.max_total_kb as number) || 256) * 1024;
00291|     const truncated = rawPaths.slice(0, MAX_FILES);
00292|     const overflow = rawPaths.length > MAX_FILES ? rawPaths.length - MAX_FILES : 0;
00293|     const parts: string[] = []; let totalBytes = 0; const summary: string[] = [];
00294|     for (const p of truncated) {
00295|       if (totalBytes >= maxTotalKb) { summary.push(`⚠️ 已達總量上限 ${(maxTotalKb/1024)}KB，後續檔案跳過`); break; }
00296|       const fpath = await ctx.resolvePathSmart(p);
00297|       try {
00298|         const bytes = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath));
00299|         let text = Buffer.from(bytes).toString('utf8');
00300|         if (text.length > maxPerKb) { text = text.slice(0, maxPerKb) + `\n…（${path.basename(fpath)} 已截斷 ${Math.round(maxPerKb/1024)}KB）`; }
00301|         parts.push(`=== ${fpath} ===\n${text}`);
00302|         totalBytes += text.length;
00303|       } catch { parts.push(`=== ${fpath} ===\n錯誤：找不到或無法讀取`); }
00304|     }
00305|     if (overflow > 0) summary.push(`⚠️ paths 數量超過上限 ${MAX_FILES}，未處理 ${overflow} 個檔案。`);
00306|     return summary.join('\n') + '\n\n' + parts.join('\n');
00307|   }

00378|   // ── batch_replace ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
00379|   private async _batchReplace(args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ToolExecutionContext): Promise<string> {
00380|     const brPattern = args.pattern as string; const brReplace = args.replace as string;
00381|     const brGlob = (args.include as string) || '**/*';
00382|     const brFlags = ((args.flags as string) || 'g').includes('g') ? (args.flags as string || 'g') : (args.flags as string || 'g') + 'g';
00383|     if (!brPattern || brReplace === undefined) return '請提供 pattern 與 replace 參數';
00384|     if (!await ctx.requestPermission('write', `批次取代: /${brPattern}/ → "${brReplace.slice(0,40)}" (${brGlob})`, 'batch_replace')) return '使用者已拒絕操作';
00385|     let brRe: RegExp; try { brRe = new RegExp(brPattern, brFlags); } catch(e) { return `正規表達式錯誤: ${e}`; }
00386|     const uris = await vscode.workspace.findFiles(new vscode.RelativePattern(ctx.wsRoot, brGlob), '{**/node_modules/**,**/.git/**,**/out/**,**/dist/**}', 2000);
00387|     const results: string[] = []; let total = 0;
00388|     for (const uri of uris) {
00389|       try {
00390|         const original = Buffer.from(await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(uri)).toString('utf8');
00391|         const updated = original.replace(brRe, brReplace);
00392|         if (updated !== original) {
00393|           await vscode.workspace.fs.writeFile(uri, Buffer.from(updated, 'utf8'));
00394|           ctx.cache.delete(`rf:${uri.fsPath}`);
00395|           const brStats = computeDiffStatsAndPatch(original, updated, uri.fsPath);
00396|           ctx.callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'fileModified', filePath: uri.fsPath, op: 'replace', ts: Date.now(), ...brStats });
00397|           results.push(`  ${path.relative(ctx.wsRoot, uri.fsPath).replace(/\\/g,'/')}  (${(original.match(new RegExp(brPattern, brFlags)) || []).length} 處)`);
00398|           total++;
00399|         }
00400|       } catch { /* skip binary */ }
00401|     }
00402|     return total === 0 ? `找不到符合的內容 (/${brPattern}/ in ${brGlob})` : `批次取代完成，共修改 ${total} 個檔案:\n${results.join('\n')}`;
00403|   }

00517|   // ── file_info ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
00518|   private async _fileInfo(args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ToolExecutionContext): Promise<string> {
00519|     const fpath = ctx.resolvePath(args.path as string || ''); if (!fpath) return '請提供 path 參數';
00520|     try {
00521|       const [stat, bytes] = await Promise.all([vscode.workspace.fs.stat(vscode.Uri.file(fpath)), vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath))]);
00522|       const buf = Buffer.from(bytes);
00523|       let encoding = 'UTF-8';
00524|       if (buf[0]===0xEF&&buf[1]===0xBB&&buf[2]===0xBF) encoding='UTF-8 BOM';
00525|       else if (buf[0]===0xFF&&buf[1]===0xFE) encoding='UTF-16 LE BOM';
00526|       else if (buf[0]===0xFE&&buf[1]===0xFF) encoding='UTF-16 BE BOM';
00527|       const text = buf.toString('utf8'); const lineCount = text.split('\n').length;
00528|       const crlf = (text.match(/\r\n/g)||[]).length; const lf = (text.match(/(?<!\r)\n/g)||[]).length;
00529|       const mtime = new Date(stat.mtime).toISOString().replace('T',' ').slice(0,19);
00530|       return [`路徑: ${fpath}`,`類型: ${(stat.type&vscode.FileType.Directory)?'目錄':'檔案'}`,`大小: ${stat.size} bytes (${(stat.size/1024).toFixed(1)} KB)`,`行數: ${lineCount}`,`行尾: ${crlf>lf?'CRLF':'LF'} (CRLF:${crlf} / LF:${lf})`,`編碼: ${encoding}`,`修改時間: ${mtime} UTC`].join('\n');
00531|     } catch(e) { return `file_info 錯誤: ${e}`; }
00532|   }

00567|   // ── read_workspace ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
00568|   private async _readWorkspace(args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ToolExecutionContext): Promise<string> {
00569|     const include = (args.include as string) || '**/*.{ts,js,tsx,jsx,py,cs,java,go,rs,cpp,c,h,inf,dec,dsc,fdf,uni,nasm,asm,asl,md,json,yaml,yml,txt}';
00570|     const extraExclude = ((args.exclude as string) || '').split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
00571|     const excludeGlob = '{' + ['**/node_modules/**','**/.git/**','**/dist/**','**/out/**','**/build/**','**/.next/**','**/__pycache__/**','**/*.min.js','**/*.map', ...extraExclude].join(',') + '}';
00572|     const maxFileBytes = Math.max(1, (args.max_file_kb as number) || 128) * 1024;
00573|     const maxTotalBytes = Math.max(1, (args.max_total_kb as number) || 512) * 1024;
00574|     const offset = Math.max(0, Number(args.offset) || 0);
00575|     const allUris = await vscode.workspace.findFiles(include, excludeGlob, 2000);
00576|     const binaryExts = new Set(['.png','.jpg','.jpeg','.gif','.ico','.webp','.bmp','.vsix','.zip','.tar','.gz','.exe','.dll','.so','.dylib','.wasm','.pdf','.db','.sqlite']);
00577|     const candidates = allUris.filter(u => !binaryExts.has(path.extname(u.fsPath).toLowerCase()));
00578|     const sliced = candidates.slice(offset);
00579|     const parts: string[] = []; let totalBytes = 0; let truncated = false; let processed = 0;
00580|     for (const uri of sliced) {
00581|       processed++;
00582|       if (processed % 10 === 0) ctx.callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'agentStepProgress', text: `📂 read_workspace 進度 ${processed}/${sliced.length} (≈${Math.round(totalBytes/1024)}KB)` });
00583|       let content: string;
00584|       try {
00585|         const raw = Buffer.from(await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(uri));
00586|         content = raw.length > maxFileBytes ? raw.toString('utf8', 0, maxFileBytes) + `\n…（已截斷，原始檔案 ${Math.round(raw.length/1024)} KB）` : raw.toString('utf8');
00587|       } catch { continue; }
00588|       const entry = `### ${vscode.workspace.asRelativePath(uri)}\n\`\`\`\n${content}\n\`\`\``;
00589|       if (totalBytes + Buffer.byteLength(entry, 'utf8') > maxTotalBytes) { truncated = true; processed--; break; }
00590|       totalBytes += Buffer.byteLength(entry, 'utf8'); parts.push(entry);
00591|     }
00592|     const nextOffset = offset + processed; const remaining = Math.max(0, candidates.length - nextOffset);
00593|     const header = `工作區共 ${candidates.length} 個檔案，本批讀取 ${parts.length} 個（offset=${offset}→${nextOffset}，合計 ≈${Math.round(totalBytes/1024)} KB）${truncated?'，已達容量上限提早停止':''}`;
00594|     const hint = remaining > 0 ? `\n💡 剩餘 ${remaining} 個檔案未讀取，如需繼續請再次呼叫 read_workspace 並使用 offset=${nextOffset}。` : '\n✅ 所有符合條件的檔案已讀取完畢。';
00595|     return header + hint + '\n\n' + parts.join('\n\n');
00596|   }

00004| import * as vscode from 'vscode';

00008| const TOOLS = new Set(['git_status', 'git_diff', 'git_log', 'git_commit']);

00010| export class GitProvider implements IToolProvider {
00011|   readonly tools: ReadonlySet<string> = TOOLS;
00012| 
00013|   execute(name: string, args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ToolExecutionContext): Promise<string> {
00014|     const wsRoot = (vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders ?? [])[0]?.uri.fsPath ?? process.cwd();
00015|     switch (name) {
00016|       case 'git_status':  return this._status(args, wsRoot);
00017|       case 'git_diff':    return this._diff(args, wsRoot);
00018|       case 'git_log':     return this._log(args, wsRoot);
00019|       case 'git_commit':  return this._commit(args, wsRoot, ctx);
00020|       default: return Promise.resolve(`GitProvider: unknown tool "${name}"`);
00021|     }
00022|   }
00023| 
00024|   private _status(args: Record<string, unknown>, wsRoot: string): Promise<string> {
00025|     const cwd = (args.path as string)
00026|       ? (require('path') as typeof import('path')).resolve(args.path as string)
00027|       : wsRoot;
00028|     return new Promise(resolve => {
00029|       exec('git status', { cwd, timeout: 10000 }, (_err, stdout, stderr) =>
00030|         resolve((stdout || stderr || '（無輸出）').trim().slice(0, 8000)));
00031|     });
00032|   }
00033| 
00034|   private _diff(args: Record<string, unknown>, wsRoot: string): Promise<string> {
00035|     const staged = (args.staged as boolean) ? '--cached ' : '';
00036|     const file   = (args.file as string) || '';
00037|     const cmd    = ('git diff ' + staged + file).trim();
00038|     return new Promise(resolve => {
00039|       exec(cmd, { cwd: wsRoot, timeout: 15000 }, (_err, stdout, stderr) =>
00040|         resolve(((stdout || stderr || '').trim() || '（無變更）').slice(0, 16000)));
00041|     });
00042|   }
00043| 
00044|   private _log(args: Record<string, unknown>, wsRoot: string): Promise<string> {
00045|     const count = Math.min(Number(args.count || 20), 100);
00046|     const file  = (args.file as string) ? ('-- ' + args.file) : '';
00047|     const cmd   = ('git log --oneline -' + count + ' ' + file).trim();
00048|     return new Promise(resolve => {
00049|       exec(cmd, { cwd: wsRoot, timeout: 10000 }, (_err, stdout, stderr) =>
00050|         resolve((stdout || stderr || '（無歷史）').trim().slice(0, 8000)));
00051|     });
00052|   }
00053| 
00054|   private async _commit(
00055|     args: Record<string, unknown>,
00056|     wsRoot: string,
00057|     ctx: ToolExecutionContext,
00058|   ): Promise<string> {
00059|     const msg = ((args.message as string) || '').trim();
00060|     if (!msg) return '請提供 commit message';
00061|     const allowed = await ctx.requestPermission('run', `Git Commit: ${msg}`, 'git_commit');
00062|     if (!allowed) return '使用者已拒絕 git commit 操作';
00063|     const safeMsg = msg.replace(/"/g, '\\"');
00064|     const addAll  = (args.add_all as boolean) !== false;
00065|     const cmd     = addAll
00066|       ? `git add -A && git commit -m "${safeMsg}"`
00067|       : `git commit -m "${safeMsg}"`;
00068|     return new Promise(resolve => {
00069|       exec(cmd, { cwd: wsRoot, timeout: 30000, shell: true as unknown as string }, (_err, stdout, stderr) => {
00070|         const out = (stdout || '') + (stderr ? (stdout ? '\n[stderr]\n' : '[stderr]\n') + stderr : '');
00071|         resolve((out.trim() || '（無輸出）').slice(0, 4000));
00072|       });
00073|     });
00074|   }

00010| /** 注入每個 Provider 的執行期共享上下文（不含 Provider 私有狀態） */
00011| export interface ToolExecutionContext {

00029| /**
00030|  * 工具供應商（Provider）介面。
00031|  *
00032|  * 每個 Provider 封裝同一業務域的一組工具，
00033|  * 持有自己的私有狀態（如 Jira token、WhatsApp socket）。
00034|  *
00035|  * 設計原則：
00036|  * - `tools` 為靜態集合，ToolExecutor 用它做 O(1) dispatch

00039|  */
00040| export interface IToolProvider {
00041|   readonly tools: ReadonlySet<string>;
00042|   execute(
00043|     name: string,
00044|     args: Record<string, unknown>,
00045|     ctx: ToolExecutionContext,
00046|   ): Promise<string>;

00027|   private _http(urlStr: string, method: string, auth: string, postBody?: string, extraHdrs: Record<string, string> = {}): Promise<HttpResult> {
00028|     return new Promise(res => {
00029|       let pu: URL;
00030|       try { pu = new URL(urlStr); } catch { res({ status: 0, body: '無效 URL: ' + urlStr }); return; }
00031|       const isHttps = pu.protocol === 'https:';
00032|       const proto = isHttps ? https : http;
00033|       const bodyBuf = postBody ? Buffer.from(postBody, 'utf8') : undefined;
00034|       const opts = {
00035|         hostname: pu.hostname, port: pu.port || (isHttps ? 443 : 80),
00036|         path: pu.pathname + pu.search, method,
00037|         headers: {
00038|           'Accept': 'application/json',
00039|           ...(auth ? { 'Authorization': auth } : {}),
00040|           ...(bodyBuf ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded', 'Content-Length': bodyBuf.length } : {}),
00041|           ...extraHdrs,
00042|         },
00043|       };
00044|       let rb = '';
00045|       const req = proto.request(opts, r => {
00046|         r.setEncoding('utf8');
00047|         r.on('data', (d: string) => { rb += d; });
00048|         r.on('end', () => res({ status: r.statusCode ?? 0, body: rb, location: r.headers.location as string | undefined }));
00049|       });
00050|       req.on('error', (e: Error) => res({ status: 0, body: '網路錯誤: ' + e.message }));
00051|       req.setTimeout(15000, () => { req.destroy(); res({ status: 0, body: '超時 (15s)' }); });
00052|       if (bodyBuf) { req.write(bodyBuf); }
00053|       req.end();
00054|     });
00055|   }

00063|       let cb = '';
00064|       const req = proto.request(opts, r => {

00066|         r.on('data', (d: string) => { cb += d; });
00067|         r.on('end', () => { try { const j = JSON.parse(cb) as Record<string, string>; res({ field: j.crumbRequestField, value: j.crumb }); } catch { res(null); } });
00068|       });
00069|       req.on('error', () => res(null));
00070|       req.setTimeout(5000, () => { req.destroy(); res(null); });

00186|     const log = lr.status === 200 ? lr.body.split('\n').slice(-logLines).join('\n').slice(0, 8000) : '(無法取得 log)';
00187|     return `${info}\n\n=== Console Log (後 ${logLines} 行) ===\n${log}`;
00188|   }

00125|       }

00172|         (s as vscode.DocumentSymbol).children !== undefined;

00177|           if (s.children.length) flatten(s.children, depth + 1);
00178|         }
00179|       };
00180| 
00181|       if (isDocSym(symbols[0])) {
00182|         flatten(symbols as vscode.DocumentSymbol[], 0);
00183|       } else {
00184|         for (const s of symbols as vscode.SymbolInformation[]) {
00185|           lines.push(`${kindName(s.kind)} ${s.name}  ${vscode.workspace.asRelativePath(s.location.uri)}:L${s.location.range.start.line + 1}`);
00186|         }

00031|   private _fetchUrl(args: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<string> {
00032|     const rawUrl = (args.url as string || '').trim();
00033|     if (!rawUrl) return Promise.resolve('請提供 url 參數');
00034|     try { new URL(rawUrl); } catch { return Promise.resolve(`無效的 URL: ${rawUrl}`); }
00035|     return new Promise<string>(resolve => {
00036|       const protocol = rawUrl.startsWith('https') ? https : http;
00037|       let buf = '';
00038|       const req = protocol.get(rawUrl, { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (AmiClaw-Agent)' } }, res => {
00039|         if (res.statusCode && res.statusCode >= 300 && res.statusCode < 400 && res.headers.location) { resolve(`重導到: ${res.headers.location} (請再呼叫 fetch_url)`); return; }

00041|         res.on('data', (d: string) => { buf += d; if (buf.length > 300000) res.destroy(); });
00042|         res.on('end', () => resolve(buf.replace(/<script[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi,'').replace(/<style[\s\S]*?<\/style>/gi,'').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/[ \t]{2,}/g,' ').replace(/\n{3,}/g,'\n\n').trim().slice(0, 12000)));
00043|         res.on('error', (e: Error) => resolve(`網路錯誤: ${e.message}`));
00044|       });
00045|       req.on('error', (e: Error) => resolve(`網路錯誤: ${e.message}`));

00047|     });

00056|   private async _httpRequest(args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ToolExecutionContext): Promise<string> {
00057|     const method = ((args.method as string) || 'GET').toUpperCase();
00058|     const reqUrl = (args.url as string || '').trim(); if (!reqUrl) return '請提供 url 參數';
00059|     const reqHeaders = (args.headers as Record<string,string>) || {};
00060|     const reqBody = args.body ? String(args.body) : undefined;
00061|     const reqTimeout = Number(args.timeout || 15000);
00062|     if (method !== 'GET' && method !== 'HEAD') {
00063|       if (!await ctx.requestPermission('run', `HTTP ${method}: ${reqUrl}`, 'http_request')) return '使用者已拒絕 HTTP 請求';
00064|     }
00065|     return new Promise<string>(resolve => {
00066|       let parsedUrl: URL; try { parsedUrl = new URL(reqUrl); } catch { resolve('無效的 URL'); return; }
00067|       const protocol = parsedUrl.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
00068|       const bodyBuf = reqBody ? Buffer.from(reqBody, 'utf8') : undefined;
00069|       const options = {
00070|         hostname: parsedUrl.hostname, port: parsedUrl.port || (parsedUrl.protocol==='https:'?443:80),
00071|         path: parsedUrl.pathname + parsedUrl.search, method,
00072|         headers: { 'User-Agent':'AmiClaw-Agent/1.0', 'Accept':'application/json, text/plain, */*', ...(bodyBuf?{'Content-Type':'application/json','Content-Length':bodyBuf.length}:{}), ...reqHeaders },
00073|       };
00074|       let buf = '';
00075|       const req = protocol.request(options, res => {
00076|         res.setEncoding('utf8');
00077|         res.on('data', (d: string) => { buf += d; if (buf.length > 100000) res.destroy(); });
00078|         res.on('end', () => { const hdrs = Object.entries(res.headers).slice(0,8).map(([k,v])=>`${k}: ${v}`).join('\n'); resolve(`HTTP ${res.statusCode} ${res.statusMessage}\n${hdrs}\n\n${buf.trim().slice(0,8000)}`); });
00079|         res.on('error', (e: Error) => resolve(`回應錯誤: ${e.message}`));
00080|       });
00081|       req.on('error', (e: Error) => resolve(`網路錯誤: ${e.message}`));
00082|       req.setTimeout(reqTimeout, () => { req.destroy(); resolve(`超時 (${reqTimeout}ms)`); });
00083|       if (bodyBuf) req.write(bodyBuf);
00084|       req.end();
00085|     });

00034|   private async _vscodeAction(args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ToolExecutionContext): Promise<string> {
00035|     const wsRoot = (vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders ?? [])[0]?.uri.fsPath ?? '';
00036|     const resolvePath = (p: string) => path.isAbsolute(p) ? p : path.join(wsRoot, p);
00037|     const action = (args.action as string) || '';
00038|     if (action === 'open_file') {
00039|       const fpath = resolvePath(args.path as string || '');
00040|       const doc = await vscode.workspace.openTextDocument(vscode.Uri.file(fpath));
00041|       const editor = await vscode.window.showTextDocument(doc, { preview: true });
00042|       if (args.line) {
00043|         const pos = new vscode.Position(Math.max(0, Number(args.line) - 1), 0);
00044|         editor.selection = new vscode.Selection(pos, pos);
00045|         editor.revealRange(new vscode.Range(pos, pos), vscode.TextEditorRevealType.InCenter);
00046|       }
00047|       return `已開啟 ${fpath}${args.line ? ` 第 ${args.line} 行` : ''}`;
00048|     }
00049|     if (action === 'get_workspace_info') {
00050|       const wsFolders = vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders ?? [];
00051|       const openDocs  = vscode.workspace.textDocuments.filter(d => !d.isUntitled && d.uri.scheme === 'file');
00052|       return `工作區: ${wsFolders.map(f => f.uri.fsPath).join(', ') || '(none)'}\n開啟中檔案:\n${openDocs.map(d => d.uri.fsPath).join('\n') || '(none)'}`;
00053|     }
00054|     if (action === 'show_notification') {
00055|       vscode.window.showInformationMessage(String(args.message ?? ''));
00056|       return '已顯示通知';
00057|     }
00058|     if (action === 'run_command') {
00059|       await vscode.commands.executeCommand(args.command as string, ...(Array.isArray(args.args) ? args.args : []));
00060|       return `已執行 VS Code 指令: ${args.command}`;
00061|     }
00062|     return `未知 vscode_action: ${action}`;
00063|   }
00064| 
00065|   private _manageTodo(args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ToolExecutionContext): string {
00066|     const action = (args.action as string) || 'list';
00067|     if (action === 'add') {
00068|       const text = args.text as string;
00069|       if (!text) return '請提供 todo 內容 (text 參數)';
00070|       this._todos.push({ id: this._todos.length + 1, text, done: false });
00071|       ctx.callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'agentTodoUpdate', todos: [...this._todos] });
00072|       return `已新增 Todo #${this._todos.length}: ${text}`;
00073|     }
00074|     if (action === 'done') {
00075|       const id   = Number(args.id);
00076|       const item = this._todos.find(t => t.id === id);
00077|       if (!item) return `找不到 Todo #${id}`;
00078|       item.done = true;
00079|       ctx.callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'agentTodoUpdate', todos: [...this._todos] });
00080|       return `✅ Todo #${id} 已完成: ${item.text}`;
00081|     }
00082|     if (action === 'clear') {
00083|       this._todos = [];
00084|       ctx.callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'agentTodoUpdate', todos: [] });
00085|       return 'Todo 清單已清空';
00086|     }
00087|     if (this._todos.length === 0) return 'Todo 清單是空的，請先用 add 新增任務';
00088|     return this._todos.map(t => `${t.done ? '✅' : '⏳'} #${t.id}: ${t.text}`).join('\n');
00089|   }
00090| }

00779|       function inferProviderFromModelId(modelId) {
00780|         if (!modelId) return 'ollama';
00781|         if (modelId.indexOf('copilot::') === 0 || modelId.indexOf('copilot/') === 0) return 'copilot';
00782|         if (modelId.indexOf('openai::') === 0) return 'openai';
00783|         return 'ollama';
00784|       }
00785| 
00786|       // 判斷模型是否支援 thinking（與 ollama-chat.ts 的 supportsThinking 邏輯保持同步）
00787|       // 注意：本檔位於 TS template literal 內，regex 中的反斜線需用 \\ 雙跳脫
00788|       function modelSupportsThinking(modelId, label) {
00789|         function check(s) {
00790|           if (!s) return false;
00791|           var raw = String(s).toLowerCase();
00792|           // strip provider prefixes and ollama multi-server encoding
00793|           raw = raw.replace(/^copilot::/, '');
00794|           if (raw.indexOf('openai::') === 0) { var pp = raw.indexOf('||'); raw = pp !== -1 ? raw.slice(pp + 2) : raw.slice(8); }
00795|           var sp = raw.indexOf('||'); if (sp !== -1) raw = raw.slice(sp + 2);
00796|           if (raw.charAt(0) === '[') { var rb = raw.indexOf(']'); if (rb !== -1) raw = raw.slice(rb + 1).replace(/^\\s+/, ''); }
00797|           // check for reasoning models (o1/o3/o4 series and thinking/reasoning keywords)
00798|           if (raw.indexOf('thinking') !== -1 || raw.indexOf('reasoning') !== -1) return true;
00799|           var _rm = raw.replace(/^[a-z0-9]+[/:._-]/, ''); // strip prefix for shortname check
00800|           if (_rm.indexOf('o1') === 0 || _rm.indexOf('o3') === 0 || _rm.indexOf('o4') === 0) return true;
00801|           if (raw.indexOf('/o1') !== -1 || raw.indexOf('/o3') !== -1 || raw.indexOf('/o4') !== -1) return true;
00802|           if (raw.indexOf(':o1') !== -1 || raw.indexOf(':o3') !== -1 || raw.indexOf(':o4') !== -1) return true;
00803|           // strip hf.co/<user>/ prefix and any path prefix for shortname check
00804|           var m = raw;
00805|           if (raw.indexOf('hf.co/') !== -1) { var hfSlash = raw.lastIndexOf('/'); m = hfSlash !== -1 ? raw.slice(hfSlash + 1) : raw; }
00806|           else { var lastSlash = raw.lastIndexOf('/'); if (lastSlash !== -1) m = raw.slice(lastSlash + 1); }
00807|           if (m.indexOf('coder') !== -1 || m.indexOf('-instruct') !== -1 || m.indexOf(':instruct') !== -1) return false;
00808|           return m.indexOf('deepseek-r1') === 0 || m.indexOf('deepseek-r2') === 0 ||
00809|             m.indexOf('qwq') === 0 ||
00810|             (m.indexOf('qwen3') === 0 && m.indexOf('coder') === -1) ||
00811|             m.indexOf(':thinking') !== -1 || m.indexOf('-thinking') !== -1 ||
00812|             m.indexOf('think') !== -1 || m.indexOf('-r1') !== -1 || m.indexOf(':r1') !== -1 ||
00813|             m.indexOf('r1-') !== -1 || /^r1[:.-]/.test(m);
00814|         }
00815|         return check(modelId) || check(label);
00816|       }

02028|       function escHtml(s) { return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;'); }
02029|       function renderInline(txt) {
02030|         // 先跳脫 HTML，再套用 inline 語法
02031|         txt = escHtml(txt);
02032|         // $$...$$ → 行內數學（保護，避免後面 $...$ 匹配）
02033|         var PH = '\x02';
02034|         txt = txt.replace(/\\$\\$([^$\\n]+?)\\$\\$/g, function(_,m){ return '<code class="math-inline">'+m+'</code>'; });
02035|         // $...$ → 行內數學
02036|         txt = txt.replace(/\\$([^$\\n]{1,80}?)\\$/g, function(_,m){ return '<code class="math-inline">'+m+'</code>'; });
02037|         // **bold**
02038|         txt = txt.replace(/\\*\\*([^*\\n]+?)\\*\\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
02039|         txt = txt.replace(/__([^_\\n]+?)__/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
02040|         // *italic*  (skip *** and **)
02041|         txt = txt.replace(/(?<!\\*)\\*([^*\\n]+?)\\*(?!\\*)/g, '<em>$1</em>');
02042|         // inline code (backtick)
02043|         var BTCK = String.fromCharCode(96);
02044|         var btRe = new RegExp(BTCK + '([^' + BTCK + '\\n]+?)' + BTCK, 'g');
02045|         txt = txt.replace(btRe, function(_,c){ return '<code>'+c+'</code>'; });
02046|         return txt;
02047|       }

02054|         return h+'</tbody></table>';

02100|       // -- parseBlocks + makeCodeBlock + highlightCode --------------------------
02101|       function parseBlocks(text) {
02102|         var TICK = String.fromCharCode(96, 96, 96);
02103|         var parts = []; var rest = text;
02104|         while (true) {
02105|           var s = rest.indexOf(TICK);
02106|           if (s === -1) { if (rest) parts.push({ t: 'text', v: rest }); break; }
02107|           if (s > 0) parts.push({ t: 'text', v: rest.slice(0, s) });
02108|           rest = rest.slice(s + 3);
02109|           var nl = rest.indexOf('\\n');
02110|           var lang = nl !== -1 ? rest.slice(0, nl).trim() : '';
02111|           if (nl !== -1) rest = rest.slice(nl + 1);
02112|           var e = rest.indexOf(TICK);
02113|           var code = e !== -1 ? rest.slice(0, e) : rest;
02114|           parts.push({ t: 'code', lang: lang, v: code });
02115|           rest = e !== -1 ? rest.slice(e + 3) : '';
02116|         }
02117|         return parts.length ? parts : [{ t: 'text', v: text }];
02118|       }

02453|       function handleCompactUpdate(msg) {
02454|         var phase = msg.phase || '';
02455|         if (phase === 'microcompact' || phase === 'l2l3') {
02456|           // Intermediate stages: just show a transient progress step (reuses agentStep styling)
02457|           var stageName = phase === 'microcompact' ? '\uD83D\uDDDC\uFE0F Microcompact' : '\uD83E\uDDF9 L2/L3';
02458|           appendAgentStep(phase === 'microcompact' ? '\uD83D\uDDDC\uFE0F' : '\uD83E\uDDF9',
02459|             stageName + '\uFF1A\u91CB\u51FA \u2248' + (msg.freed || 0) + ' chars\uFF08\u5269 \u2248' + (msg.tokensNow || 0) + ' tok\uFF09', '', false);
02460|           finalizeAgentStep(null, false);
02461|           return;
02462|         }
02463|         if (phase === 'llm-running') {
02464|           _compactTokensBefore = msg.tokensBefore || 0;
02465|           _compactBarNode = appendCompactBar(msg.tokensBefore, msg.threshold, msg.messagesBefore);
02466|           return;
02467|         }
02468|         if (phase === 'done' || phase === 'error') {
02469|           if (!_compactBarNode) {
02470|             // done without llm-running (microcompact/drop only) — create bar now
02471|             _compactBarNode = appendCompactBar(msg.tokensBefore, msg.threshold, msg.messagesBefore);
02472|           }
02473|           finalizeCompactBar(_compactBarNode, msg);
02474|           _compactBarNode = null;
02475|           chat.scrollTop = chat.scrollHeight;
02476|         }
02477|       }

03218|       function updateModelSelect(models, current) {
03219|         if (!modelSelect) return;

03233|         });

03236|         providerOrder.forEach(function(groupKey) {

03246|             if (model.multiplier) opt.dataset.multiplier = model.multiplier;

03623|       // ── LTM 條目編輯器 與 分類標籤 ──────────────────────────────────────────
03624|       var _ltmFilterTag = '';
03625|       function parseLtmToEntries(text) {
03626|         var lines = (text || '').split('\\n'), entries = [];
03627|         for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
03628|           var line = lines[i].trim(); if (!line) continue;
03629|           var m = line.match(/^#(\S+)\s+([\s\S]*)$/);
03630|           if (m) { entries.push({ tag: m[1], text: m[2] }); }
03631|           else { entries.push({ tag: '', text: line }); }
03632|         }
03633|         return entries;
03634|       }
03635|       function entriesToLtm(entries) {
03636|         return entries.map(function(e) { return e.tag ? '#' + e.tag + ' ' + e.text : e.text; }).join('\\n');
03637|       }

03737|       function buildUnifiedDiff(before, after) {
03738|         var NO_BEFORE = !before && after;
03739|         var bLines = NO_BEFORE ? [] : (before || '').split('\\n');
03740|         var aLines = (after  || '').split('\\n');
03741|         var result = [];
03742|         var LIMIT = 300;
03743|         var bi = 0, ai = 0;
03744|         while (bi < bLines.length || ai < aLines.length) {
03745|           if (result.length >= LIMIT) { result.push({ t: '~', s: '... (' + (bLines.length + aLines.length - bi - ai) + ' more lines)' }); break; }
03746|           var bl = bi < bLines.length ? bLines[bi] : null;
03747|           var al = ai < aLines.length ? aLines[ai] : null;
03748|           if (bl === null) { result.push({ t: '+', s: al }); ai++; }
03749|           else if (al === null) { result.push({ t: '-', s: bl }); bi++; }
03750|           else if (bl === al) { result.push({ t: ' ', s: bl }); bi++; ai++; }
03751|           else { result.push({ t: '-', s: bl }); result.push({ t: '+', s: al }); bi++; ai++; }
03752|         }
03753|         // Trim context: only keep lines near changes (+/-)
03754|         var CTX = 3;
03755|         var keep = {};
03756|         for (var ri = 0; ri < result.length; ri++) {
03757|           if (result[ri].t !== ' ') {
03758|             for (var d = -CTX; d <= CTX; d++) { if (ri + d >= 0 && ri + d < result.length) keep[ri + d] = true; }
03759|           }
03760|         }
03761|         var trimmed = [], lastKept = -1;
03762|         for (var ri = 0; ri < result.length; ri++) {
03763|           if (keep[ri]) {
03764|             if (lastKept >= 0 && ri > lastKept + 1) trimmed.push({ t: '~', s: '' });
03765|             trimmed.push(result[ri]);
03766|             lastKept = ri;
03767|           }
03768|         }
03769|         return trimmed.length > 0 ? trimmed : [{ t: ' ', s: '(no changes)' }];
03770|       }

03772|       function showDiffPanel(diff) {
03773|         var panel = document.getElementById('permDiffPanel');
03774|         if (!panel) return;
03775|         if (!diff) { panel.classList.remove('has-diff'); return; }
03776|         panel.classList.add('has-diff');
03777|         var before = diff.before || '';
03778|         var after  = diff.after  || '';
03779|         // Unified pane
03780|         var unifiedPre = document.querySelector('#diffPaneUnified pre');
03781|         if (unifiedPre) {
03782|           unifiedPre.innerHTML = '';
03783|           var lines = buildUnifiedDiff(before, after);
03784|           for (var li = 0; li < lines.length; li++) {
03785|             var item = lines[li];
03786|             var span = document.createElement('span');
03787|             var prefix = item.t === '+' ? '+  ' : item.t === '-' ? '-  ' : item.t === '~' ? '   ' : '   ';
03788|             span.className = item.t === '+' ? 'diff-line-add' : item.t === '-' ? 'diff-line-del' : 'diff-line-ctx';
03789|             span.textContent = prefix + (item.s || '') + '\\n';
03790|             unifiedPre.appendChild(span);
03791|           }
03792|         }
03793|         // Before pane
03794|         var beforePre = document.querySelector('#diffPaneBefore pre');
03795|         if (beforePre) { beforePre.textContent = before || '(new file)'; }
03796|         // After pane
03797|         var afterPre = document.querySelector('#diffPaneAfter pre');
03798|         if (afterPre) { afterPre.textContent = after; }
03799|       }
